```yaml
  6: # - AWS_ASSUME_EXTERNAL_ID: ExternalId for cross-account role assumption security
  7: # - TF_VAR_POSTGRESQL_PASSWORD: PostgreSQL database password
  8: # - TF_VAR_REDIS_PASSWORD: Redis password for SMS OTP storage
  9: # - TF_VAR_OPENLDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD: OpenLDAP admin password (for backend ldap-admin-secret)
 10: #
 11: # Optional (first admin user seed - when all are set, a one-time Job seeds the first admin):
 12: # - ADMIN_SEED_USERNAME, ADMIN_SEED_EMAIL, ADMIN_SEED_FIRST_NAME, ADMIN_SEED_LAST_NAME
 13: # - ADMIN_SEED_PHONE_COUNTRY_CODE, ADMIN_SEED_PHONE_NUMBER
 14: # (Password for seed admin = same as TF_VAR_OPENLDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD; do not log these values.)
 15: #
 16: # Note: GitHub workflows use repository secrets, while bash scripts use AWS Secrets Manager.
 17: # The secrets listed above must be configured in GitHub repository settings.
 18: on:
 19:   workflow_dispatch:
 20:     inputs:
 21:       region:
 22:         description: 'Select AWS Region'
 23:         required: true
 24:         type: choice
 25:         default: 'us-east-1: N. Virginia'
 26:         options:
 27:           - 'us-east-1: N. Virginia'
 28:           - 'us-east-2: Ohio'
 29:       environment:
 30:         description: 'Select Environment'
 31:         required: true
 32:         type: choice
 33:         default: prod
 34:         options:
 35:           - prod
 36:           - dev
 37: jobs:
 38:   SetRegion:
 39:     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
 40:     permissions:
 41:       contents: read
 42:     outputs:
 43:       region_code: ${{ steps.set_region.outputs.region_code }}
 44:     steps:
 45:       - name: Set Region
 46:         id: set_region
 47:         run: |
 48:           SELECTED_REGION="${{ inputs.region }}"
 49:           echo "region_code=${SELECTED_REGION%%:*}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
 50:   ApplicationProvision:
 51:     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
 52:     needs:
 53:       - SetRegion
 54:     permissions:
 55:       contents: write
 56:       actions: write
 57:       id-token: write
 58:     env:
 59:       AWS_REGION: ${{ needs.SetRegion.outputs.region_code }}
 60:       # Note: TF_VAR environment variables are case-sensitive and must match variable names in variables.tf
 61:       # Secrets in GitHub remain uppercase, but environment variables must be lowercase
 62:       # PostgreSQL password for User management database
 63:       TF_VAR_postgresql_database_password: ${{ secrets.TF_VAR_POSTGRESQL_PASSWORD }}
 64:       # Redis password for SMS OTP storage
 65:       TF_VAR_redis_password: ${{ secrets.TF_VAR_REDIS_PASSWORD }}
 66:       # OpenLDAP admin password for backend LDAP bind (ldap-admin-secret)
 67:       TF_VAR_openldap_admin_password: ${{ secrets.TF_VAR_OPENLDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD }}
 68:       # First admin seed (optional; when all set, one-time Job seeds first admin with same password as LDAP)
 69:       TF_VAR_admin_seed_username: ${{ secrets.ADMIN_SEED_USERNAME }}
 70:       TF_VAR_admin_seed_email: ${{ secrets.ADMIN_SEED_EMAIL }}
 71:       TF_VAR_admin_seed_first_name: ${{ secrets.ADMIN_SEED_FIRST_NAME }}
 72:       TF_VAR_admin_seed_last_name: ${{ secrets.ADMIN_SEED_LAST_NAME }}
 73:       TF_VAR_admin_seed_phone_country_code: ${{ secrets.ADMIN_SEED_PHONE_COUNTRY_CODE }}
 74:       TF_VAR_admin_seed_phone_number: ${{ secrets.ADMIN_SEED_PHONE_NUMBER }}
 75:     defaults:
 76:       run:
 77:         working-directory: ./application
 78:     steps:
 79:       - name: Checkout the repo code
 80:         uses: actions/checkout@v4
 81:       - name: Setup terraform
 82:         uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3
 83:         with:
 84:           terraform_version: 1.14.0
 85:       - name: Install jq
 86:         run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq
 87:       - name: Export environment variables for set-k8s-env.sh
 88:         run: |
 89:           # Export required variables for set-k8s-env.sh (matching setup-application.sh)
 90:           echo "BACKEND_FILE=backend.hcl" >> $GITHUB_ENV
 91:           echo "VARIABLES_FILE=variables.tfvars" >> $GITHUB_ENV
 92:           echo "ENVIRONMENT=${{ inputs.environment }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
 93:           echo "TERRAFORM_WORKSPACE=${{ env.AWS_REGION }}-${{ inputs.environment }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
 94:           echo "BACKEND_PREFIX=${{ vars.BACKEND_PREFIX }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
 95:           # Determine deployment account role ARN based on environment
 96:           if [ "${{ inputs.environment }}" = "prod" ]; then
 97:             echo "DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN=${{ secrets.AWS_PRODUCTION_ACCOUNT_ROLE_ARN }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
 98:           else
 99:             echo "DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN=${{ secrets.AWS_DEVELOPMENT_ACCOUNT_ROLE_ARN }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
100:           fi
101:           echo "EXTERNAL_ID=${{ secrets.AWS_ASSUME_EXTERNAL_ID }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
102:           # Export state account role ARN for Route53/ACM access
103:           echo "STATE_ACCOUNT_ROLE_ARN=${{ secrets.AWS_STATE_ACCOUNT_ROLE_ARN }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
104:       - name: Configure AWS credentials (State Account)
105:         uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
106:         with:
107:           role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_STATE_ACCOUNT_ROLE_ARN }}
108:           role-session-name: GitHubActions-ApplicationProvision-State
109:           aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
110:       - name: Create backend_infra backend.hcl from placeholder
111:         run: |
112:           # Create backend_infra/backend.hcl if it doesn't exist
113:           # This is needed for application/providers.tf and application_infra/providers.tf to read backend_infra state configuration
114:           if [ ! -f "../backend_infra/backend.hcl" ]; then
115:             cp ../backend_infra/tfstate-backend-values-template.hcl ../backend_infra/backend.hcl
116:             sed -i -e "s|<BACKEND_BUCKET_NAME>|${{ vars.BACKEND_BUCKET_NAME }}|g" \
117:             -e "s|<BACKEND_PREFIX>|${{ vars.BACKEND_PREFIX }}|g" \
118:             -e "s|<AWS_REGION>|${{ env.AWS_REGION }}|g" \
119:             ../backend_infra/backend.hcl
120:             echo "Created ../backend_infra/backend.hcl:"
121:             cat ../backend_infra/backend.hcl
122:           else
123:             echo "../backend_infra/backend.hcl already exists. Skipping creation."
124:           fi
125:       - name: Create application_infra backend.hcl from placeholder
126:         run: |
127:           # Create application_infra/backend.hcl if it doesn't exist
128:           # This is needed for terraform init in the Check ArgoCD capability status step
129:           if [ ! -f "../application_infra/backend.hcl" ]; then
130:             cp ../application_infra/tfstate-backend-values-template.hcl ../application_infra/backend.hcl
131:             sed -i -e "s|<BACKEND_BUCKET_NAME>|${{ vars.BACKEND_BUCKET_NAME }}|g" \
132:             -e "s|<APPLICATION_INFRA_PREFIX>|${{ vars.APPLICATION_INFRA_PREFIX }}|g" \
133:             -e "s|<AWS_REGION>|${{ env.AWS_REGION }}|g" \
134:             ../application_infra/backend.hcl
135:             echo "Created ../application_infra/backend.hcl:"
136:             cat ../application_infra/backend.hcl
137:           else
138:             echo "../application_infra/backend.hcl already exists. Skipping creation."
139:           fi
140:       - name: Check ArgoCD capability status
141:         id: check_argocd
142:         working-directory: ./application_infra
143:         run: |
144:           WORKSPACE="${{ env.AWS_REGION }}-${{ inputs.environment }}"
145:           # Ensure assume-github-role.sh is executable (needed for ArgoCD module external data source)
146:           chmod +x ../scripts/assume-github-role.sh
147:           # Initialize terraform if needed
148:           if [ ! -d ".terraform" ]; then
149:             echo "Initializing application_infra terraform for status check..."
150:             if ! terraform init -backend-config="backend.hcl"; then
151:               echo "::error::Failed to initialize application_infra terraform"
152:               exit 1
153:             fi
154:           fi
155:           # Select workspace
156:           if ! terraform workspace select "$WORKSPACE"; then
157:             echo "::error::Failed to select workspace $WORKSPACE in application_infra"
158:             exit 1
159:           fi
160:           # Get ArgoCD capability status output
161:           ARGOCD_STATUS=$(terraform output -raw argocd_capability_status 2>/dev/null)
162:           EXIT_CODE=$?
163:           # Fail if status output command failed
164:           if [ $EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ]; then
165:             echo "::error::ArgoCD capability status not available (failed to retrieve from application_infra)"
166:             echo "::error::Please ensure ArgoCD capability is deployed in application_infra before deploying applications."
167:             exit 1
168:           fi
169:           # Trim whitespace and set output
170:           ARGOCD_STATUS=$(echo "$ARGOCD_STATUS" | tr -d '[:space:]')
171:           echo "status=$ARGOCD_STATUS" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
172:           # Fail if status is empty or null
173:           if [ -z "$ARGOCD_STATUS" ] || [ "$ARGOCD_STATUS" = "null" ]; then
174:             echo "::error::ArgoCD capability status is not set or is null"
175:             echo "::error::Please ensure ArgoCD capability is deployed and active in application_infra before deploying applications."
176:             exit 1
177:           fi
178:           echo "ArgoCD capability status: $ARGOCD_STATUS"
179:       - name: Validate ArgoCD status
180:         run: |
181:           if [ "${{ steps.check_argocd.outputs.status }}" != "ACTIVE" ]; then
182:             echo "::error::ArgoCD capability status is '${{ steps.check_argocd.outputs.status }}', but expected 'ACTIVE'"
183:             echo "::error::Please ensure ArgoCD capability is fully deployed and active before deploying applications."
184:             exit 1
185:           fi
186:           echo "✅ ArgoCD capability is ACTIVE - proceeding with deployment"
187:       - name: Create backend.hcl from placeholder
188:         run: |
189:           # Only create if it doesn't exist (matching setup-application.sh behavior)
190:           if [ ! -f "backend.hcl" ]; then
191:             cp tfstate-backend-values-template.hcl backend.hcl
192:             sed -i -e "s|<BACKEND_BUCKET_NAME>|${{ vars.BACKEND_BUCKET_NAME }}|g" \
193:             -e "s|<APPLICATION_PREFIX>|${{ vars.APPLICATION_PREFIX }}|g" \
194:             -e "s|<AWS_REGION>|${{ env.AWS_REGION }}|g" \
195:             backend.hcl
196:             echo "Created backend.hcl:"
197:             cat backend.hcl
198:           else
199:             echo "backend.hcl already exists. Skipping creation."
200:           fi
201:       - name: Terraform init
202:         run: terraform init -backend-config=backend.hcl
203:       - name: Terraform workspace
204:         run: |
205:           WORKSPACE="${{ env.AWS_REGION }}-${{ inputs.environment }}"
206:           terraform workspace select $WORKSPACE || terraform workspace new $WORKSPACE
207:       - name: Terraform validate
208:         run: terraform validate
209:       - name: Set Kubernetes environment variables
210:         run: |
211:           # set-k8s-env.sh expects State Account credentials to be active for S3 operations
212:           # It will assume Deployment Account role internally for EKS operations
213:           # Use the infrastructure's set-k8s-env.sh script (shared between infrastructure and application)
214:           chmod +x ../scripts/set-k8s-env.sh
215:           source ../scripts/set-k8s-env.sh
216:           # Export as TF_VAR_ environment variables for Terraform
217:           echo "TF_VAR_kubernetes_master=$KUBERNETES_MASTER" >> $GITHUB_ENV
218:           echo "TF_VAR_kube_config_path=$KUBE_CONFIG_PATH" >> $GITHUB_ENV
219:       - name: Extract image tags from Helm values
220:         run: |
221:           # Extract backend image tag (required - must not be 'latest' or empty)
222:           BACKEND_VALUES_FILE="backend/helm/ldap-2fa-backend/values.yaml"
223:           if [ ! -f "$BACKEND_VALUES_FILE" ]; then
224:             echo "::error::Backend Helm values file not found at $BACKEND_VALUES_FILE"
225:             echo "::error::Run the 'Backend Build and Push' workflow first to build and push the backend image."
226:             exit 1
227:           fi
228:           BACKEND_IMAGE_TAG=$(grep -E '^[[:space:]]*tag:' "$BACKEND_VALUES_FILE" | head -n 1 | sed -E 's/.*tag:[[:space:]]*//' | sed 's/^"//' | sed "s/^'//" | sed 's/"$//' | sed "s/'$//" | tr -d '\r')
229:           if [ -z "$BACKEND_IMAGE_TAG" ] || [ "$BACKEND_IMAGE_TAG" = "latest" ]; then
230:             echo "::error::Could not extract valid backend image tag from $BACKEND_VALUES_FILE"
231:             echo "::error::Found tag: '${BACKEND_IMAGE_TAG:-<empty>}'"
232:             echo "::error::Run the 'Backend Build and Push' workflow first. It will update values.yaml with the correct tag."
233:             exit 1
234:           fi
235:           echo "TF_VAR_backend_image_tag=$BACKEND_IMAGE_TAG" >> $GITHUB_ENV
236:           echo "✅ Using backend image tag: $BACKEND_IMAGE_TAG"
237:           # Extract frontend image tag (required - must not be 'latest' or empty)
238:           FRONTEND_VALUES_FILE="frontend/helm/ldap-2fa-frontend/values.yaml"
239:           if [ ! -f "$FRONTEND_VALUES_FILE" ]; then
240:             echo "::error::Frontend Helm values file not found at $FRONTEND_VALUES_FILE"
241:             echo "::error::Run the 'Frontend Build and Push' workflow first to build and push the frontend image."
242:             exit 1
243:           fi
244:           FRONTEND_IMAGE_TAG=$(grep -E '^[[:space:]]*tag:' "$FRONTEND_VALUES_FILE" | head -n 1 | sed -E 's/.*tag:[[:space:]]*//' | sed 's/^"//' | sed "s/^'//" | sed 's/"$//' | sed "s/'$//" | tr -d '\r')
245:           if [ -z "$FRONTEND_IMAGE_TAG" ] || [ "$FRONTEND_IMAGE_TAG" = "latest" ]; then
246:             echo "::error::Could not extract valid frontend image tag from $FRONTEND_VALUES_FILE"
247:             echo "::error::Found tag: '${FRONTEND_IMAGE_TAG:-<empty>}'"
248:             echo "::error::Run the 'Frontend Build and Push' workflow first. It will update values.yaml with the correct tag."
249:             exit 1
250:           fi
251:           echo "TF_VAR_frontend_image_tag=$FRONTEND_IMAGE_TAG" >> $GITHUB_ENV
252:           echo "✅ Using frontend image tag: $FRONTEND_IMAGE_TAG"
253:       - name: Configure AWS credentials (State Account for Terraform)
254:         uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
255:         with:
256:           role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_STATE_ACCOUNT_ROLE_ARN }}
257:           role-session-name: GitHubActions-ApplicationProvision-Terraform
258:           aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
259:       - name: Ensure get-eks-token.sh is executable
260:         run: chmod +x ../scripts/get-eks-token.sh
261:       - name: Terraform plan
262:         run: terraform plan -var-file="variables.tfvars" -out terraform.tfplan
263:       - name: Provision application
264:         run: terraform apply -auto-approve terraform.tfplan
```

## File: .github/workflows/releasing_terraform_lock.yaml
```yaml
  1: name: Release Terraform Lock
  2: # Use this workflow to force-unlock Terraform state after a crash or interrupted run.
  3: # Required GitHub Repository Secrets:
  4: # - AWS_STATE_ACCOUNT_ROLE_ARN: IAM role ARN for backend state operations
  5: #
  6: # Required GitHub Repository Variables:
  7: # - BACKEND_BUCKET_NAME, BACKEND_PREFIX (backend_infra)
  8: # - APPLICATION_INFRA_PREFIX (application_infra)
  9: # - APPLICATION_PREFIX (application)
 10: on:
 11:   workflow_dispatch:
 12:     inputs:
 13:       region:
 14:         description: 'Select AWS Region'
 15:         required: true
 16:         type: choice
 17:         default: 'us-east-1: N. Virginia'
 18:         options:
 19:           - 'us-east-1: N. Virginia'
 20:           - 'us-east-2: Ohio'
 21:       environment:
 22:         description: 'Select Environment'
 23:         required: true
 24:         type: choice
 25:         default: prod
 26:         options:
 27:           - prod
 28:           - dev
 29:       level:
 30:         description: 'Terraform layer to unlock (selects backend, workspace, and permissions)'
 31:         required: true
 32:         type: choice
 33:         default: application_infra
 34:         options:
 35:           - backend_infra
 36:           - application_infra
 37:           - application
 38:       lock_id:
 39:         description: 'Lock ID to release (from terraform plan/apply error or DynamoDB lock table)'
 40:         required: true
 41:         type: string
 42: jobs:
 43:   SetRegion:
 44:     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
 45:     permissions:
 46:       contents: read
 47:     outputs:
 48:       region_code: ${{ steps.set_region.outputs.region_code }}
 49:     steps:
 50:       - name: Set Region
 51:         id: set_region
 52:         run: |
 53:           SELECTED_REGION="${{ inputs.region }}"
 54:           echo "region_code=${SELECTED_REGION%%:*}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
 55:   ReleaseLock:
 56:     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
 57:     needs:
 58:       - SetRegion
 59:     permissions:
 60:       contents: read
 61:       id-token: write
 62:     env:
 63:       AWS_REGION: ${{ needs.SetRegion.outputs.region_code }}
 64:       LOCK_LEVEL: ${{ inputs.level }}
 65:       LOCK_ID: ${{ inputs.lock_id }}
 66:     steps:
 67:       - name: Set working directory for level
 68:         id: set_work_dir
 69:         run: |
 70:           echo "work_dir=./${{ inputs.level }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
 71:           echo "Releasing Terraform lock for level: ${{ inputs.level }}"
 72:       - name: Checkout the repo code
 73:         uses: actions/checkout@v4
 74:       - name: Setup Terraform
 75:         uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3
 76:         with:
 77:           terraform_version: 1.14.0
 78:       - name: Configure AWS credentials (State Account)
 79:         uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
 80:         with:
 81:           role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_STATE_ACCOUNT_ROLE_ARN }}
 82:           role-session-name: GitHubActions-ReleaseTerraformLock-${{ inputs.level }}
 83:           aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
 84:       - name: Create backend_infra backend.hcl
 85:         if: inputs.level == 'backend_infra' || inputs.level == 'application_infra' || inputs.level == 'application'
 86:         run: |
 87:           DIR=backend_infra
 88:           if [ ! -f "$DIR/backend.hcl" ]; then
 89:             cp "$DIR/tfstate-backend-values-template.hcl" "$DIR/backend.hcl"
 90:             sed -i -e "s|<BACKEND_BUCKET_NAME>|${{ vars.BACKEND_BUCKET_NAME }}|g" \
 91:               -e "s|<BACKEND_PREFIX>|${{ vars.BACKEND_PREFIX }}|g" \
 92:               -e "s|<AWS_REGION>|${{ env.AWS_REGION }}|g" \
 93:               "$DIR/backend.hcl"
 94:             echo "Created $DIR/backend.hcl"
 95:           else
 96:             echo "$DIR/backend.hcl already exists."
 97:           fi
 98:       - name: Create application_infra backend.hcl
 99:         if: inputs.level == 'application_infra' || inputs.level == 'application'
100:         run: |
101:           DIR=application_infra
102:           if [ ! -f "$DIR/backend.hcl" ]; then
103:             cp "$DIR/tfstate-backend-values-template.hcl" "$DIR/backend.hcl"
104:             sed -i -e "s|<BACKEND_BUCKET_NAME>|${{ vars.BACKEND_BUCKET_NAME }}|g" \
105:               -e "s|<APPLICATION_INFRA_PREFIX>|${{ vars.APPLICATION_INFRA_PREFIX }}|g" \
106:               -e "s|<AWS_REGION>|${{ env.AWS_REGION }}|g" \
107:               "$DIR/backend.hcl"
108:             echo "Created $DIR/backend.hcl"
109:           else
110:             echo "$DIR/backend.hcl already exists."
111:           fi
112:       - name: Create application backend.hcl
113:         if: inputs.level == 'application'
114:         run: |
115:           DIR=application
116:           if [ ! -f "$DIR/backend.hcl" ]; then
117:             cp "$DIR/tfstate-backend-values-template.hcl" "$DIR/backend.hcl"
118:             sed -i -e "s|<BACKEND_BUCKET_NAME>|${{ vars.BACKEND_BUCKET_NAME }}|g" \
119:               -e "s|<APPLICATION_PREFIX>|${{ vars.APPLICATION_PREFIX }}|g" \
120:               -e "s|<AWS_REGION>|${{ env.AWS_REGION }}|g" \
121:               "$DIR/backend.hcl"
122:             echo "Created $DIR/backend.hcl"
123:           else
124:             echo "$DIR/backend.hcl already exists."
125:           fi
126:       - name: Terraform init
127:         working-directory: ${{ steps.set_work_dir.outputs.work_dir }}
128:         run: terraform init -backend-config=backend.hcl
129:       - name: Terraform workspace select
130:         working-directory: ${{ steps.set_work_dir.outputs.work_dir }}
131:         run: |
132:           WORKSPACE="${{ env.AWS_REGION }}-${{ inputs.environment }}"
133:           terraform workspace select "$WORKSPACE" || terraform workspace new "$WORKSPACE"
134:       - name: Release Terraform lock
135:         working-directory: ${{ steps.set_work_dir.outputs.work_dir }}
136:         run: |
137:           terraform force-unlock -force "${{ env.LOCK_ID }}"
138:           echo "Lock ${{ env.LOCK_ID }} released for ${{ inputs.level }} (${{ env.AWS_REGION }}-${{ inputs.environment }})."
```

## File: application/backend/helm/ldap-2fa-backend/templates/configmap.yaml
```yaml
 1: apiVersion: v1
 2: kind: ConfigMap
 3: metadata:
 4:   name: {{ include "ldap-2fa-backend.fullname" . }}-config
 5:   labels:
 6:     {{- include "ldap-2fa-backend.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
 7: data:
 8:   # LDAP Configuration
 9:   LDAP_HOST: {{ .Values.ldap.host | quote }}
10:   LDAP_PORT: {{ .Values.ldap.port | quote }}
11:   LDAP_USE_SSL: {{ .Values.ldap.useSsl | quote }}
12:   LDAP_BASE_DN: {{ .Values.ldap.baseDn | quote }}
13:   LDAP_ADMIN_DN: {{ .Values.ldap.adminDn | quote }}
14:   LDAP_USER_SEARCH_BASE: {{ .Values.ldap.userSearchBase | quote }}
15:   LDAP_USER_SEARCH_FILTER: {{ .Values.ldap.userSearchFilter | quote }}
16:   LDAP_ADMIN_GROUP_DN: {{ .Values.ldapAdmin.groupDn | quote }}
17:   LDAP_USERS_GID: {{ .Values.ldapAdmin.usersGid | quote }}
18:   LDAP_UID_START: {{ .Values.ldapAdmin.uidStart | quote }}
19:   # Database Configuration
20:   {{- if not .Values.database.externalSecret.enabled }}
21:   DATABASE_URL: {{ .Values.database.url | quote }}
22:   {{- else if not .Values.database.externalSecret.urlKey }}
23:   # When external secret provides only password, app builds URL from these + DATABASE_PASSWORD
24:   DATABASE_HOST: {{ .Values.database.host | quote }}
25:   DATABASE_PORT: {{ .Values.database.port | quote }}
26:   DATABASE_USER: {{ .Values.database.user | quote }}
27:   DATABASE_NAME: {{ .Values.database.name | quote }}
28:   {{- end }}
29:   # Email/SES Configuration

31:   SES_SENDER_EMAIL: {{ .Values.email.senderEmail | quote }}
32:   EMAIL_VERIFICATION_EXPIRY_HOURS: {{ .Values.email.verificationExpiryHours | quote }}
33:   APP_URL: {{ .Values.email.appUrl | quote }}
34:   # MFA/TOTP Configuration
35:   TOTP_ISSUER: {{ .Values.mfa.issuer | quote }}
36:   TOTP_DIGITS: {{ .Values.mfa.digits | quote }}
37:   TOTP_INTERVAL: {{ .Values.mfa.interval | quote }}
38:   TOTP_ALGORITHM: {{ .Values.mfa.algorithm | quote }}
39:   # SMS/SNS Configuration
40:   ENABLE_SMS_2FA: {{ .Values.sms.enabled | quote }}

42:   SMS_SENDER_ID: {{ .Values.sms.senderId | quote }}
43:   SMS_TYPE: {{ .Values.sms.smsType | quote }}
44:   SMS_CODE_LENGTH: {{ .Values.sms.codeLength | quote }}
45:   SMS_CODE_EXPIRY_SECONDS: {{ .Values.sms.codeExpirySeconds | quote }}
46:   SMS_MESSAGE_TEMPLATE: {{ .Values.sms.messageTemplate | quote }}
47:   # Application Configuration
48:   APP_NAME: {{ .Values.app.name | quote }}

50:   LOG_LEVEL: {{ .Values.app.logLevel | quote }}
51:   {{- if .Values.app.corsOrigins }}
52:   CORS_ORIGINS: {{ .Values.app.corsOrigins | quote }}
53:   {{- end }}
54:   # Redis Configuration
```

## File: application/backend/helm/ldap-2fa-backend/templates/NOTES.txt
```
 1: LDAP 2FA Backend API has been deployed!
 2: 
 3: 1. Get the application URL:
 4: {{- if .Values.ingress.enabled }}
 5: {{- range $host := .Values.ingress.hosts }}
 6:   {{- range .paths }}
 7:   https://{{ $host.host }}{{ .path }}
 8:   {{- end }}
 9: {{- end }}
10: {{- else if contains "NodePort" .Values.service.type }}
11:   export NODE_PORT=$(kubectl get --namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }} -o jsonpath="{.spec.ports[0].nodePort}" services {{ include "ldap-2fa-backend.fullname" . }})
12:   export NODE_IP=$(kubectl get nodes --namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }} -o jsonpath="{.items[0].status.addresses[0].address}")
13:   echo http://$NODE_IP:$NODE_PORT
14: {{- else if contains "LoadBalancer" .Values.service.type }}
15:   NOTE: It may take a few minutes for the LoadBalancer IP to be available.
16:         You can watch the status by running:
17:         kubectl get --namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }} svc -w {{ include "ldap-2fa-backend.fullname" . }}
18:   export SERVICE_IP=$(kubectl get svc --namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }} {{ include "ldap-2fa-backend.fullname" . }} --template "{{"{{ range (index .status.loadBalancer.ingress 0) }}{{.}}{{ end }}"}}")
19:   echo http://$SERVICE_IP:{{ .Values.service.port }}
20: {{- else if contains "ClusterIP" .Values.service.type }}
21:   kubectl --namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }} port-forward svc/{{ include "ldap-2fa-backend.fullname" . }} 8000:{{ .Values.service.port }}
22:   echo "Visit http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/healthz"
23: {{- end }}
24: 
25: 2. API Endpoints (two-step login):
26:    - Health Check:     GET  /api/healthz
27:    - App config:       GET  /api/app-config        (isActive, mode; frontend uses on load)
28:    - Login step 1:     POST /api/auth/login/start   (username, password, optional remember_me)
29:    - TOTP setup:       POST /api/auth/login/totp-setup (challenge_token, when not enrolled)
30:    - Login step 2:     POST /api/auth/login/verify (challenge_token, mfa_method, verification_code)
31:    - Send SMS code:    POST /api/auth/sms/send-code (challenge_token)
32:    - Forgot password:  POST /api/auth/forgot-password (email)
33:    - Reset password:   POST /api/auth/reset-password (token, username, new_password, confirm_password)
34:    - Re-enroll MFA:    POST /api/auth/enroll
35: 
36: 3. Test the health endpoint:
37:    curl -s https://{{ (index .Values.ingress.hosts 0).host }}/api/healthz | jq
38: 
39: 4. Login (step 1):
40:    curl -X POST https://{{ (index .Values.ingress.hosts 0).host }}/api/auth/login/start \
41:      -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
42:      -d '{"username": "testuser", "password": "testpassword", "remember_me": false}'
43: 
44: 5. Complete login (step 2, after MFA code):
45:    curl -X POST https://{{ (index .Values.ingress.hosts 0).host }}/api/auth/login/verify \
46:      -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
47:      -d '{"challenge_token": "<from step 1>", "mfa_method": "totp", "verification_code": "123456"}'
```

## File: application/backend/src/app/database/connection.py
```python
  1: """Database connection and session management."""
  2: import logging
  3: from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
  4: from typing import AsyncGenerator
  5: from sqlalchemy import text
  6: from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import (
  7:     AsyncSession,
  8:     async_sessionmaker,
  9:     create_async_engine,
 10: )
 11: from sqlalchemy.pool import NullPool
 12: from app.config import get_settings
 13: logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
 14: def _migrate_verification_tokens_target_value(sync_conn):
 15:     """
 16:     Add target_value column to verification_tokens if missing (PostgreSQL).
 17:     Used for profile email/phone change flows (eml_chg, phn_chg token types).
 18:     """
 19:     # Check if table exists and column is missing (idempotent)
 20:     r = sync_conn.execute(
 21:         text(
 22:             "SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns "
 23:             "WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'verification_tokens' AND column_name = 'target_value'"
 24:         )
 25:     )
 26:     if r.scalar() is not None:
 27:         return
 28:     r = sync_conn.execute(
 29:         text(
 30:             "SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.tables "
 31:             "WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'verification_tokens'"
 32:         )
 33:     )
 34:     if r.scalar() is None:
 35:         return
 36:     sync_conn.execute(text("ALTER TABLE verification_tokens ADD COLUMN target_value VARCHAR(255) NULL"))
 37:     logger.info("Added column verification_tokens.target_value")
 38: async def _migrate_user_mfa_methods_backfill(engine):
 39:     """
 40:     Backfill user_mfa_methods from users.mfa_method and users.totp_secret.
 41:     Idempotent: only inserts if user has legacy MFA and no row exists yet.
 42:     """
 43:     from sqlalchemy import select
 44:     from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import async_sessionmaker, AsyncSession
 45:     from app.database.models import User, UserMFAMethod
 46:     session_factory = async_sessionmaker(
 47:         bind=engine,
 48:         class_=AsyncSession,
 49:         expire_on_commit=False,
 50:         autocommit=False,
 51:         autoflush=False,
 52:     )
 53:     async with session_factory() as session:
 54:         result = await session.execute(
 55:             select(User).where(
 56:                 (User.mfa_method.isnot(None)) & (User.mfa_method != "")
 57:             )
 58:         )
 59:         users = result.scalars().all()
 60:         for user in users:
 61:             # Check if this user already has any mfa_methods row
 62:             existing = await session.execute(
 63:                 select(UserMFAMethod).where(UserMFAMethod.user_id == user.id)
 64:             )
 65:             if existing.scalars().first() is not None:
 66:                 continue
 67:             if user.mfa_method == "totp" and user.totp_secret:
 68:                 session.add(
 69:                     UserMFAMethod(
 70:                         user_id=user.id,
 71:                         method="totp",
 72:                         totp_secret=user.totp_secret,
 73:                     )
 74:                 )
 75:             elif user.mfa_method == "sms":
 76:                 session.add(
 77:                     UserMFAMethod(
 78:                         user_id=user.id,
 79:                         method="sms",
 80:                         phone_country_code=user.phone_country_code,
 81:                         phone_number=user.phone_number,
 82:                     )
 83:                 )
 84:         await session.commit()
 85:         if users:
 86:             logger.info("Backfilled user_mfa_methods for %d user(s)", len(users))
 87: # Global engine and session factory
 88: _engine = None
 89: AsyncSessionLocal: async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession] | None = None
 90: async def init_db() -> None:
 91:     """Initialize database connection and create tables."""
 92:     global _engine, AsyncSessionLocal
 93:     settings = get_settings()
 94:     logger.info("Initializing database connection to: %s", settings.database_url.split('@')[-1])
 95:     _engine = create_async_engine(
 96:         settings.database_url,
 97:         echo=settings.debug,
 98:         poolclass=NullPool,  # Use NullPool for async
 99:     )
100:     AsyncSessionLocal = async_sessionmaker(
101:         bind=_engine,
102:         class_=AsyncSession,
103:         expire_on_commit=False,
104:         autocommit=False,
105:         autoflush=False,
106:     )
107:     # Create tables
108:     from app.database.models import Base
109:     async with _engine.begin() as conn:
110:         await conn.run_sync(Base.metadata.create_all)
111:         await conn.run_sync(_migrate_verification_tokens_target_value)
112:     await _migrate_user_mfa_methods_backfill(_engine)
113:     logger.info("Database initialized successfully")
114: async def close_db() -> None:
115:     """Close database connection."""
116:     global _engine, AsyncSessionLocal
117:     if _engine:
118:         await _engine.dispose()
119:         _engine = None
120:         AsyncSessionLocal = None
121:         logger.info("Database connection closed")
122: async def get_async_session() -> AsyncGenerator[AsyncSession, None]:
123:     """Get an async database session."""
124:     if AsyncSessionLocal is None:
125:         raise RuntimeError("Database not initialized. Call init_db() first.")
126:     async with AsyncSessionLocal() as session:
127:         try:
128:             yield session
129:             await session.commit()
130:         except Exception:
131:             await session.rollback()
132:             raise
133: @asynccontextmanager
134: async def get_db() -> AsyncGenerator[AsyncSession, None]:
135:     """Context manager for database sessions."""
136:     if AsyncSessionLocal is None:
137:         raise RuntimeError("Database not initialized. Call init_db() first.")
138:     async with AsyncSessionLocal() as session:
139:         try:
140:             yield session
141:             await session.commit()
142:         except Exception:
143:             await session.rollback()
144:             raise
```

## File: application/frontend/helm/ldap-2fa-frontend/templates/NOTES.txt
```
 1: LDAP 2FA Frontend has been deployed!
 2: 
 3: 1. Get the application URL:
 4: {{- if .Values.ingress.enabled }}
 5: {{- range $host := .Values.ingress.hosts }}
 6:   {{- range .paths }}
 7:   https://{{ $host.host }}{{ .path }}
 8:   {{- end }}
 9: {{- end }}
10: {{- else if contains "NodePort" .Values.service.type }}
11:   export NODE_PORT=$(kubectl get --namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }} -o jsonpath="{.spec.ports[0].nodePort}" services {{ include "ldap-2fa-frontend.fullname" . }})
12:   export NODE_IP=$(kubectl get nodes --namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }} -o jsonpath="{.items[0].status.addresses[0].address}")
13:   echo http://$NODE_IP:$NODE_PORT
14: {{- else if contains "LoadBalancer" .Values.service.type }}
15:   NOTE: It may take a few minutes for the LoadBalancer IP to be available.
16:         You can watch the status by running:
17:         kubectl get --namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }} svc -w {{ include "ldap-2fa-frontend.fullname" . }}
18:   export SERVICE_IP=$(kubectl get svc --namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }} {{ include "ldap-2fa-frontend.fullname" . }} --template "{{"{{ range (index .status.loadBalancer.ingress 0) }}{{.}}{{ end }}"}}")
19:   echo http://$SERVICE_IP:{{ .Values.service.port }}
20: {{- else if contains "ClusterIP" .Values.service.type }}
21:   kubectl --namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }} port-forward svc/{{ include "ldap-2fa-frontend.fullname" . }} 8080:{{ .Values.service.port }}
22:   echo "Visit http://127.0.0.1:8080"
23: {{- end }}
24: 
25: 2. Features:
26:    - Two-step login: username/password then MFA screen (Authenticator app or SMS, single code field); optional Remember me and Forgot your password
27:    - Forgot password: request reset link by email; reset-password view from email link (#reset-password?token=...&username=...)
28:    - One-time TOTP setup with QR code when user chooses Authenticator and is not enrolled
29:    - Responsive design with dark mode support
30: 
31: 3. The frontend communicates with the backend via relative URLs:
32:    - /api/healthz - Health check
33:    - /api/app-config - Application state (isActive, mode); used on load to enable/disable login form
34:    - /api/auth/login/start - Step 1 login (optional remember_me)
35:    - /api/auth/login/totp-setup - TOTP setup when not enrolled
36:    - /api/auth/login/verify - Step 2 MFA verification
37:    - /api/auth/sms/send-code - Send SMS code (with challenge token)
38:    - /api/auth/forgot-password - Request password reset link
39:    - /api/auth/reset-password - Set new password from email link
40: 
41: 4. Ensure the backend is deployed and accessible at the same host:
42:    kubectl get ingress -n {{ .Release.Namespace }}
```

## File: application/helm/redis-values.tpl.yaml
```yaml
 1: # Redis Helm Values Template
 2: # Used by Terraform to configure Bitnami Redis deployment
 3: # for SMS OTP code storage
 4: # Based on official Bitnami Redis Helm chart values structure
 5: #
 6: # Service name is <release-name>-master (e.g. talo-tf-us-east-1-redis-prod-master).
 7: # Backend REDIS_HOST is set from Terraform (module.redis.redis_host) via ArgoCD.
 8: # Override default image to use ECR repository
 9: image:
10:   registry: "${ecr_registry}"
11:   repository: "${ecr_repository}"
12:   tag: "${image_tag}"
13:   pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
14: # Standalone architecture (no HA needed for OTP cache)
15: architecture: standalone
16: # Authentication configuration
17: auth:
18:   enabled: true
19:   # Reference Kubernetes secret created by Terraform
20:   # (password sourced from GitHub Secrets → TF_VAR_redis_password)
21:   existingSecret: "${secret_name}"
22:   existingSecretPasswordKey: "redis-password"
23: # Master configuration
24: master:
25:   # Persistence for data recovery across restarts
26:   persistence:
27:     enabled: ${persistence_enabled}
28: %{ if storage_class_name != "" ~}
29:     storageClass: "${storage_class_name}"
30: %{ endif ~}
31:     size: "${storage_size}"
32:   # Resource limits
33:   resources:
34:     requests:
35:       cpu: "${resources_requests_cpu}"
36:       memory: "${resources_requests_memory}"
37:     limits:
38:       cpu: "${resources_limits_cpu}"
39:       memory: "${resources_limits_memory}"
40:   # Security context - run as non-root
41:   containerSecurityContext:
42:     enabled: true
43:     runAsUser: 1001
44:     runAsNonRoot: true
45:     allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
46:   podSecurityContext:
47:     enabled: true
48:     fsGroup: 1001
49:   # Service configuration
50:   service:
51:     type: ClusterIP
52:     ports:
53:       redis: 6379
54: # Disable replicas (standalone mode)
55: replica:
56:   replicaCount: 0
57: # Metrics (optional for production monitoring)
58: metrics:
59:   enabled: ${metrics_enabled}
60: # Redis configuration optimized for OTP cache
61: commonConfiguration: |-
62:   # Enable RDB persistence for data recovery
63:   save 900 1
64:   save 300 10
65:   save 60 10000
66:   # Disable AOF (not needed for OTP cache)
67:   appendonly no
68:   # Max memory policy - evict keys with TTL first
69:   maxmemory-policy volatile-lru
70:   # Connection timeout
71:   timeout 300
```

## File: application/modules/redis/outputs.tf
```hcl
 1: output "redis_enabled" {
 2:   description = "Whether Redis is enabled"
 3:   value       = var.enable_redis
 4: }
 5: 
 6: output "redis_host" {
 7:   description = "Redis service hostname (Bitnami chart: release-name-master)"
 8:   value       = var.enable_redis ? "${local.name}-master.${var.namespace}.svc.cluster.local" : ""
 9: }
10: 
11: output "redis_port" {
12:   description = "Redis service port"
13:   value       = 6379
14: }
15: 
16: output "redis_namespace" {
17:   description = "Kubernetes namespace where Redis is deployed"
18:   value       = var.enable_redis ? var.namespace : ""
19: }
20: 
21: output "redis_password_secret_name" {
22:   description = "Name of the Kubernetes secret containing Redis password"
23:   value       = var.enable_redis ? var.secret_name : ""
24: }
25: 
26: output "redis_password_secret_key" {
27:   description = "Key in the secret for Redis password"
28:   value       = "redis-password"
29: }
30: 
31: output "redis_connection_url" {
32:   description = "Redis connection URL (without password)"
33:   value       = var.enable_redis ? "redis://${local.name}-master.${var.namespace}.svc.cluster.local:6379/0" : ""
34: }
```

## File: application/monitor-deployments.sh
```bash
  1: #!/usr/bin/env bash
  2: set -euo pipefail
  3: # Colors for output
  4: RED='\033[0;31m'
  5: GREEN='\033[0;32m'
  6: YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
  7: BLUE='\033[0;34m'
  8: NC='\033[0m' # No Color
  9: # Polling configuration (override via environment variables)
 10: POLL_INTERVAL=${POLL_INTERVAL:-30}
 11: TIMEOUT=${TIMEOUT:-1800}  # 30 minutes default
 12: # Print colored output
 13: print_color() {
 14:     local color=$1
 15:     shift
 16:     echo -e "${color}$@${NC}"
 17: }
 18: print_header() {
 19:     print_color "$BLUE" "\n========================================="
 20:     print_color "$BLUE" "$1"
 21:     print_color "$BLUE" "=========================================\n"
 22: }
 23: print_success() {
 24:     print_color "$GREEN" "✓ $1"
 25: }
 26: print_warning() {
 27:     print_color "$YELLOW" "⚠ $1"
 28: }
 29: print_error() {
 30:     print_color "$RED" "✗ $1"
 31: }
 32: # Prompt for region
 33: echo "Select AWS Region:"
 34: echo "1) us-east-1"
 35: echo "2) us-east-2"
 36: read -p "Enter choice [1-2]: " region_choice
 37: case $region_choice in
 38:     1)
 39:         REGION="us-east-1"
 40:         ;;
 41:     2)
 42:         REGION="us-east-2"
 43:         ;;
 44:     *)
 45:         print_error "Invalid choice. Exiting."
 46:         exit 1
 47:         ;;
 48: esac
 49: # Prompt for environment
 50: echo ""
 51: echo "Select Environment:"
 52: echo "1) prod"
 53: echo "2) dev"
 54: read -p "Enter choice [1-2]: " env_choice
 55: case $env_choice in
 56:     1)
 57:         ENVIRONMENT="prod"
 58:         ;;
 59:     2)
 60:         ENVIRONMENT="dev"
 61:         ;;
 62:     *)
 63:         print_error "Invalid choice. Exiting."
 64:         exit 1
 65:         ;;
 66: esac
 67: print_header "Monitoring Application Deployments for $ENVIRONMENT in $REGION"
 68: # Check if jq is installed
 69: if ! command -v jq &> /dev/null; then
 70:     print_error "jq is not installed. Please install jq to continue."
 71:     exit 1
 72: fi
 73: # Retrieve role ARNs from AWS Secrets Manager (use selected region)
 74: print_color "$BLUE" "Retrieving AWS role ARNs from Secrets Manager..."
 75: # Get github-role secret containing all role ARNs
 76: GITHUB_ROLE_SECRET=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value \
 77:     --secret-id github-role \
 78:     --region "$REGION" \
 79:     --query 'SecretString' \
 80:     --output text)
 81: if [ -z "$GITHUB_ROLE_SECRET" ]; then
 82:     print_error "Failed to retrieve github-role secret from Secrets Manager"
 83:     exit 1
 84: fi
 85: # Extract role ARNs from JSON secret
 86: STATE_ACCOUNT_ROLE_ARN=$(echo "$GITHUB_ROLE_SECRET" | jq -r '.AWS_STATE_ACCOUNT_ROLE_ARN')
 87: if [ -z "$STATE_ACCOUNT_ROLE_ARN" ] || [ "$STATE_ACCOUNT_ROLE_ARN" = "null" ]; then
 88:     print_error "AWS_STATE_ACCOUNT_ROLE_ARN not found in github-role secret"
 89:     exit 1
 90: fi
 91: print_success "Retrieved State Account role ARN"
 92: # Get deployment account role ARN based on environment
 93: if [ "$ENVIRONMENT" = "prod" ]; then
 94:     DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN=$(echo "$GITHUB_ROLE_SECRET" | jq -r '.AWS_PRODUCTION_ACCOUNT_ROLE_ARN')
 95:     DEPLOYMENT_TYPE="production"
 96: else
 97:     DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN=$(echo "$GITHUB_ROLE_SECRET" | jq -r '.AWS_DEVELOPMENT_ACCOUNT_ROLE_ARN')
 98:     DEPLOYMENT_TYPE="development"
 99: fi
100: if [ -z "$DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN" ] || [ "$DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN" = "null" ]; then
101:     print_error "Failed to retrieve ${DEPLOYMENT_TYPE} account role ARN from github-role secret"
102:     exit 1
103: fi
104: print_success "Retrieved Deployment Account role ARN ($DEPLOYMENT_TYPE)"
105: # Get ExternalId
106: EXTERNAL_ID=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value \
107:     --secret-id external-id \
108:     --region "$REGION" \
109:     --query 'SecretString' \
110:     --output text)
111: if [ -z "$EXTERNAL_ID" ]; then
112:     print_error "Failed to retrieve ExternalId from Secrets Manager"
113:     exit 1
114: fi
115: print_success "Retrieved ExternalId for role assumption"
116: # Assume deployment account role
117: print_color "$BLUE" "\nAssuming Deployment Account role..."
118: CREDENTIALS=$(aws sts assume-role \
119:     --role-arn "$DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN" \
120:     --role-session-name "MonitorApplication-$ENVIRONMENT" \
121:     --external-id "$EXTERNAL_ID" \
122:     --duration-seconds 3600 \
123:     --output json)
124: export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$CREDENTIALS" | jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId')
125: export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$CREDENTIALS" | jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey')
126: export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$CREDENTIALS" | jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken')
127: export AWS_REGION="$REGION"
128: print_success "Successfully assumed Deployment Account role"
129: # Get cluster name from backend_infra state
130: print_color "$BLUE" "\nRetrieving cluster information from backend_infra state..."
131: # Re-assume state account role to access S3
132: STATE_CREDENTIALS=$(aws sts assume-role \
133:     --role-arn "$STATE_ACCOUNT_ROLE_ARN" \
134:     --role-session-name "MonitorApplication-State" \
135:     --duration-seconds 3600 \
136:     --output json)
137: STATE_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$STATE_CREDENTIALS" | jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId')
138: STATE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$STATE_CREDENTIALS" | jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey')
139: STATE_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$STATE_CREDENTIALS" | jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken')
140: # Get backend bucket name and prefix from GitHub repository variables or environment
141: # BACKEND_PREFIX is the backend_infra state key (e.g. backend_state/terraform.tfstate)
142: if ! command -v gh &> /dev/null; then
143:     # Fallback: try to get from environment or prompt user
144:     if [ -z "${BACKEND_BUCKET_NAME:-}" ]; then
145:         read -p "Enter backend bucket name: " BACKEND_BUCKET
146:     else
147:         BACKEND_BUCKET="$BACKEND_BUCKET_NAME"
148:     fi
149:     if [ -z "${BACKEND_PREFIX:-}" ]; then
150:         read -p "Enter backend state prefix (e.g. backend_state/terraform.tfstate): " BACKEND_PREFIX
151:     fi
152: else
153:     # Uses current repository when run from repo root or with gh auth
154:     BACKEND_BUCKET=$(gh variable list --json name,value --jq '.[] | select(.name == "BACKEND_BUCKET_NAME") | .value' 2>/dev/null || echo "")
155:     BACKEND_PREFIX=$(gh variable list --json name,value --jq '.[] | select(.name == "BACKEND_PREFIX") | .value' 2>/dev/null || echo "")
156:     if [ -z "$BACKEND_BUCKET" ]; then
157:         print_error "BACKEND_BUCKET_NAME variable not found in GitHub repository"
158:         read -p "Enter backend bucket name: " BACKEND_BUCKET
159:     fi
160:     if [ -z "$BACKEND_PREFIX" ]; then
161:         print_error "BACKEND_PREFIX variable not found in GitHub repository"
162:         read -p "Enter backend state prefix (e.g. backend_state/terraform.tfstate): " BACKEND_PREFIX
163:     fi
164: fi
165: # Allow environment override
166: BACKEND_BUCKET="${BACKEND_BUCKET_NAME:-$BACKEND_BUCKET}"
167: BACKEND_PREFIX="${BACKEND_PREFIX:-backend_state/terraform.tfstate}"
168: if [ -z "$BACKEND_BUCKET" ]; then
169:     print_error "Backend bucket name is required"
170:     exit 1
171: fi
172: if [ -z "$BACKEND_PREFIX" ]; then
173:     print_error "Backend state prefix (BACKEND_PREFIX) is required"
174:     exit 1
175: fi
176: print_success "Backend bucket: $BACKEND_BUCKET"
177: print_success "Backend state prefix: $BACKEND_PREFIX"
178: # Download state file to get cluster name (correct TF state path for backend_infra workspace)
179: STATE_S3_KEY="env:/${REGION}-${ENVIRONMENT}/${BACKEND_PREFIX}"
180: TEMP_STATE_FILE=$(mktemp)
181: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$STATE_ACCESS_KEY_ID" \
182: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$STATE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY" \
183: AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$STATE_SESSION_TOKEN" \
184: aws s3 cp "s3://${BACKEND_BUCKET}/${STATE_S3_KEY}" "$TEMP_STATE_FILE"
185: CLUSTER_NAME=$(jq -r '.outputs.cluster_name.value' "$TEMP_STATE_FILE")
186: rm -f "$TEMP_STATE_FILE"
187: if [ -z "$CLUSTER_NAME" ] || [ "$CLUSTER_NAME" = "null" ]; then
188:     print_error "Failed to retrieve cluster name from backend_infra state"
189:     exit 1
190: fi
191: print_success "Cluster name: $CLUSTER_NAME"
192: # Switch back to deployment account credentials
193: export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$CREDENTIALS" | jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId')
194: export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$CREDENTIALS" | jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey')
195: export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$CREDENTIALS" | jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken')
196: # Update kubeconfig
197: print_color "$BLUE" "\nUpdating kubeconfig..."
198: KUBE_CONFIG_PATH="${HOME}/.kube/config"
199: mkdir -p "$(dirname "$KUBE_CONFIG_PATH")"
200: aws eks update-kubeconfig \
201:     --region "$REGION" \
202:     --name "$CLUSTER_NAME" \
203:     --kubeconfig "$KUBE_CONFIG_PATH"
204: export KUBECONFIG="$KUBE_CONFIG_PATH"
205: print_success "Kubeconfig updated successfully"
206: # ===================== Report tracking =====================
207: REPORT_NAMES=()
208: REPORT_STATUSES=()
209: REPORT_RETRIES=()
210: REPORT_DURATIONS=()
211: # Temp directory for capturing check output and diagnostics
212: REPORT_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
213: trap 'rm -rf "$REPORT_DIR"' EXIT
214: record_result() {
215:     REPORT_NAMES+=("$1")
216:     REPORT_STATUSES+=("$2")
217:     REPORT_RETRIES+=("$3")
218:     REPORT_DURATIONS+=("$4")
219: }
220: # Strip ANSI escape codes from text
221: strip_ansi() {
222:     sed $'s/\033\[[0-9;]*m//g'
223: }
224: # Collect additional diagnostics for failed/timed-out checks
225: collect_diagnostics() {
226:     local check_name="$1"
227:     local diag_file="$2"
228:     {
229:         case "$check_name" in
230:             "PostgreSQL Helm Release")
231:                 echo "=== Helm Releases (ldap-2fa namespace) ==="
232:                 helm list -n ldap-2fa 2>&1 || true
233:                 local release_name
234:                 release_name=$(helm list -n ldap-2fa -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.[] | select(.name | contains("postgresql")) | .name' 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
235:                 if [ -n "${release_name:-}" ]; then
236:                     echo ""
237:                     echo "=== Helm History: $release_name ==="
238:                     helm history "$release_name" -n ldap-2fa 2>&1 || true
239:                 fi
240:                 echo ""
241:                 echo "=== Recent Events (ldap-2fa namespace, warnings/errors) ==="
242:                 kubectl get events -n ldap-2fa --sort-by=.lastTimestamp --field-selector=type!=Normal 2>&1 || true
243:                 ;;
244:             "PostgreSQL Pods")
245:                 echo "=== Pod Descriptions ==="
246:                 kubectl describe pods -n ldap-2fa -l app.kubernetes.io/name=postgresql 2>&1 || true
247:                 echo ""
248:                 echo "=== Pod Logs (last 100 lines) ==="
249:                 for pod in $(kubectl get pods -n ldap-2fa -l app.kubernetes.io/name=postgresql -o name 2>/dev/null); do
250:                     echo "--- $pod ---"
251:                     kubectl logs "$pod" -n ldap-2fa --tail=100 --all-containers 2>&1 || true
252:                 done
253:                 echo ""
254:                 echo "=== Recent Events (ldap-2fa namespace, warnings/errors) ==="
255:                 kubectl get events -n ldap-2fa --sort-by=.lastTimestamp --field-selector=type!=Normal 2>&1 || true
256:                 ;;
257:             "Redis Helm Release")
258:                 echo "=== Helm Releases (redis namespace) ==="
259:                 helm list -n redis 2>&1 || true
260:                 local release_name
261:                 release_name=$(helm list -n redis -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.[] | select(.name | contains("redis")) | .name' 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
262:                 if [ -n "${release_name:-}" ]; then
263:                     echo ""
264:                     echo "=== Helm History: $release_name ==="
265:                     helm history "$release_name" -n redis 2>&1 || true
266:                 fi
267:                 echo ""
268:                 echo "=== Recent Events (redis namespace, warnings/errors) ==="
269:                 kubectl get events -n redis --sort-by=.lastTimestamp --field-selector=type!=Normal 2>&1 || true
270:                 ;;
271:             "Redis Pods")
272:                 echo "=== Pod Descriptions ==="
273:                 kubectl describe pods -n redis -l app.kubernetes.io/name=redis 2>&1 || true
274:                 echo ""
275:                 echo "=== Pod Logs (last 100 lines) ==="
276:                 for pod in $(kubectl get pods -n redis -l app.kubernetes.io/name=redis -o name 2>/dev/null); do
277:                     echo "--- $pod ---"
278:                     kubectl logs "$pod" -n redis --tail=100 --all-containers 2>&1 || true
279:                 done
280:                 echo ""
281:                 echo "=== Recent Events (redis namespace, warnings/errors) ==="
282:                 kubectl get events -n redis --sort-by=.lastTimestamp --field-selector=type!=Normal 2>&1 || true
283:                 ;;
284:             "2FA Backend Pods")
285:                 echo "=== Pod Descriptions ==="
286:                 kubectl describe pods -n 2fa-app -l app.kubernetes.io/name=ldap-2fa-backend 2>&1 || true
287:                 echo ""
288:                 echo "=== Pod Logs (last 100 lines) ==="
289:                 for pod in $(kubectl get pods -n 2fa-app -l app.kubernetes.io/name=ldap-2fa-backend -o name 2>/dev/null); do
290:                     echo "--- $pod ---"
291:                     kubectl logs "$pod" -n 2fa-app --tail=100 --all-containers 2>&1 || true
292:                 done
293:                 echo ""
294:                 echo "=== Recent Events (2fa-app namespace, warnings/errors) ==="
295:                 kubectl get events -n 2fa-app --sort-by=.lastTimestamp --field-selector=type!=Normal 2>&1 || true
296:                 ;;
297:             "2FA Frontend Pods")
298:                 echo "=== Pod Descriptions ==="
299:                 kubectl describe pods -n 2fa-app -l app.kubernetes.io/name=ldap-2fa-frontend 2>&1 || true
300:                 echo ""
301:                 echo "=== Pod Logs (last 100 lines) ==="
302:                 for pod in $(kubectl get pods -n 2fa-app -l app.kubernetes.io/name=ldap-2fa-frontend -o name 2>/dev/null); do
303:                     echo "--- $pod ---"
304:                     kubectl logs "$pod" -n 2fa-app --tail=100 --all-containers 2>&1 || true
305:                 done
306:                 echo ""
307:                 echo "=== Recent Events (2fa-app namespace, warnings/errors) ==="
308:                 kubectl get events -n 2fa-app --sort-by=.lastTimestamp --field-selector=type!=Normal 2>&1 || true
309:                 ;;
310:             "Backend Namespace Secrets")
311:                 echo "=== All Secrets in 2fa-app namespace ==="
312:                 kubectl get secrets -n 2fa-app 2>&1 || true
313:                 echo ""
314:                 echo "=== Expected secrets: ldap-admin-secret, postgresql-secret, redis-secret ==="
315:                 for secret in ldap-admin-secret postgresql-secret redis-secret; do
316:                     if kubectl get secret "$secret" -n 2fa-app &> /dev/null; then
317:                         echo "  ✓ $secret exists"
318:                     else
319:                         echo "  ✗ $secret NOT FOUND"
320:                     fi
321:                 done
322:                 ;;
323:             "Admin-Seed Job")
324:                 echo "=== Job Description ==="
325:                 kubectl describe job admin-seed-job -n 2fa-app 2>&1 || true
326:                 echo ""
327:                 echo "=== Job Pod Logs ==="
328:                 for pod in $(kubectl get pods -n 2fa-app -l app.kubernetes.io/name=admin-seed -o name 2>/dev/null); do
329:                     echo "--- $pod ---"
330:                     kubectl logs "$pod" -n 2fa-app --tail=200 2>&1 || true
331:                 done
332:                 echo ""
333:                 echo "=== Recent Events (2fa-app namespace, warnings/errors) ==="
334:                 kubectl get events -n 2fa-app --sort-by=.lastTimestamp --field-selector=type!=Normal 2>&1 || true
335:                 ;;
336:             "ArgoCD Applications")
337:                 echo "=== ArgoCD Application Details ==="
338:                 for app_name in ldap-2fa-backend ldap-2fa-frontend; do
339:                     echo "--- $app_name ---"
340:                     kubectl describe application "$app_name" -n argocd 2>&1 || echo "Not found"
341:                 done
342:                 echo ""
343:                 echo "=== Recent Events (argocd namespace, warnings/errors) ==="
344:                 kubectl get events -n argocd --sort-by=.lastTimestamp --field-selector=type!=Normal 2>&1 || true
345:                 ;;
346:         esac
347:     } > "$diag_file" 2>&1
348: }
349: # Write structured report file for agent investigation
350: write_report_file() {
351:     local report_file="$1"
352:     {
353:         echo "============================================="
354:         echo "DEPLOYMENT MONITOR REPORT"
355:         echo "============================================="
356:         echo "Layer:         application"
357:         echo "Region:        $REGION"
358:         echo "Environment:   $ENVIRONMENT"
359:         echo "Cluster:       $CLUSTER_NAME"
360:         echo "Timestamp:     $(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')"
361:         echo "Timeout:       ${TIMEOUT}s"
362:         echo "Poll interval: ${POLL_INTERVAL}s"
363:         echo ""
364:         # Summary table
365:         echo "============================================="
366:         echo "CHECK SUMMARY"
367:         echo "============================================="
368:         printf "%-30s  %-12s  %-9s  %-10s\n" "CHECK" "STATUS" "RETRIES" "DURATION"
369:         printf "%-30s  %-12s  %-9s  %-10s\n" \
370:             "$(printf '%0.s-' $(seq 1 30))" \
371:             "$(printf '%0.s-' $(seq 1 12))" \
372:             "$(printf '%0.s-' $(seq 1 9))" \
373:             "$(printf '%0.s-' $(seq 1 10))"
374:         local passed=0 failed=0 timed_out=0
375:         for i in "${!REPORT_NAMES[@]}"; do
376:             local name="${REPORT_NAMES[$i]}"
377:             local status="${REPORT_STATUSES[$i]}"
378:             local retries="${REPORT_RETRIES[$i]}"
379:             local dur="${REPORT_DURATIONS[$i]}"
380:             local dur_min=$(( dur / 60 ))
381:             local dur_sec=$(( dur % 60 ))
382:             printf "%-30s  %-12s  %-9s  %-10s\n" "$name" "$status" "$retries" "${dur_min}m ${dur_sec}s"
383:             case "$status" in
384:                 PASSED)    passed=$((passed + 1)) ;;
385:                 FAILED)    failed=$((failed + 1)) ;;
386:                 TIMED_OUT) timed_out=$((timed_out + 1)) ;;
387:             esac
388:         done
389:         echo ""
390:         local total=${#REPORT_NAMES[@]}
391:         echo "Total: $total  |  Passed: $passed  |  Failed: $failed  |  Timed out: $timed_out"
392:         echo ""
393:         # Detailed output for each check
394:         echo "============================================="
395:         echo "DETAILED CHECK OUTPUT"
396:         echo "============================================="
397:         for i in "${!REPORT_NAMES[@]}"; do
398:             local name="${REPORT_NAMES[$i]}"
399:             local status="${REPORT_STATUSES[$i]}"
400:             local output_file="$REPORT_DIR/${i}_output.txt"
401:             local diag_file="$REPORT_DIR/${i}_diag.txt"
402:             echo ""
403:             echo "--- $name [$status] ---"
404:             if [ -f "$output_file" ] && [ -s "$output_file" ]; then
405:                 echo "[Check Output]"
406:                 strip_ansi < "$output_file"
407:             fi
408:             if [ -f "$diag_file" ] && [ -s "$diag_file" ]; then
409:                 echo ""
410:                 echo "[Diagnostics]"
411:                 strip_ansi < "$diag_file"
412:             fi
413:         done
414:         # Informational sections
415:         if [ -f "$REPORT_DIR/informational.txt" ] && [ -s "$REPORT_DIR/informational.txt" ]; then
416:             echo ""
417:             echo "============================================="
418:             echo "INFORMATIONAL (collected once)"
419:             echo "============================================="
420:             strip_ansi < "$REPORT_DIR/informational.txt"
421:         fi
422:         echo ""
423:         echo "============================================="
424:         echo "PROJECT CONTEXT"
425:         echo "============================================="
426:         echo "Repository: ldap-2fa-on-k8s"
427:         echo "Layer:      application"
428:         echo "Key files for investigation:"
429:         echo "  - application/main.tf"
430:         echo "  - application/variables.tf"
431:         echo "  - application/variables.tfvars"
432:         echo "  - application/providers.tf"
433:         echo "  - application/modules/postgresql/"
434:         echo "  - application/modules/redis/"
435:         echo "  - application/modules/ses/"
436:         echo "  - application/modules/sns/"
437:         echo "  - application/modules/argocd_app/"
438:         echo "  - application/helm/postgresql-values.tpl.yaml"
439:         echo "  - application/helm/redis-values.tpl.yaml"
440:         echo "  - application/backend/helm/ldap-2fa-backend/"
441:         echo "  - application/frontend/helm/ldap-2fa-frontend/"
442:         echo "  - application/backend/src/"
443:         echo "  - application/backend/Dockerfile"
444:         echo "  - application/frontend/Dockerfile"
445:         echo ""
446:         echo "============================================="
447:         echo "END REPORT"
448:         echo "============================================="
449:     } > "$report_file"
450: }
451: print_report() {
452:     print_header "Detailed Check Report"
453:     local name_width=30
454:     local status_width=12
455:     local retries_width=9
456:     local duration_width=10
457:     printf "%-${name_width}s  %-${status_width}s  %-${retries_width}s  %-${duration_width}s\n" \
458:         "CHECK" "STATUS" "RETRIES" "DURATION"
459:     printf "%-${name_width}s  %-${status_width}s  %-${retries_width}s  %-${duration_width}s\n" \
460:         "$(printf '%0.s-' $(seq 1 $name_width))" \
461:         "$(printf '%0.s-' $(seq 1 $status_width))" \
462:         "$(printf '%0.s-' $(seq 1 $retries_width))" \
463:         "$(printf '%0.s-' $(seq 1 $duration_width))"
464:     local passed=0 failed=0 timed_out=0
465:     for i in "${!REPORT_NAMES[@]}"; do
466:         local name="${REPORT_NAMES[$i]}"
467:         local status="${REPORT_STATUSES[$i]}"
468:         local retries="${REPORT_RETRIES[$i]}"
469:         local dur="${REPORT_DURATIONS[$i]}"
470:         local dur_min=$(( dur / 60 ))
471:         local dur_sec=$(( dur % 60 ))
472:         local dur_str="${dur_min}m ${dur_sec}s"
473:         local color="$GREEN"
474:         case "$status" in
475:             PASSED)    color="$GREEN"; passed=$((passed + 1)) ;;
476:             FAILED)    color="$RED";   failed=$((failed + 1)) ;;
477:             TIMED_OUT) color="$RED";   timed_out=$((timed_out + 1)) ;;
478:         esac
479:         printf "%-${name_width}s  ${color}%-${status_width}s${NC}  %-${retries_width}s  %-${duration_width}s\n" \
480:             "$name" "$status" "$retries" "$dur_str"
481:     done
482:     echo ""
483:     local total=${#REPORT_NAMES[@]}
484:     echo "Total: $total  |  Passed: $passed  |  Failed: $failed  |  Timed out: $timed_out"
485: }
486: # Polling helper: retries a check function until it passes or timeout is reached.
487: # Tracks retries, duration, and final status for the report.
488: # Captures check output for the report file and collects diagnostics on failure.
489: # Usage: wait_for_check "Display Name" check_function [args...]
490: # Returns 0 on success, 1 on timeout/failure.
491: wait_for_check() {
492:     local check_name=$1
493:     shift
494:     local retries=0
495:     local check_start=$(date +%s)
496:     local check_idx=${#REPORT_NAMES[@]}
497:     local output_file="$REPORT_DIR/${check_idx}_output.txt"
498:     local diag_file="$REPORT_DIR/${check_idx}_diag.txt"
499:     : > "$output_file"
500:     : > "$diag_file"
501:     while true; do
502:         if "$@" 2>&1 | tee "$output_file"; then
503:             local check_duration=$(( $(date +%s) - check_start ))
504:             record_result "$check_name" "PASSED" "$retries" "$check_duration"
505:             return 0
506:         fi
507:         retries=$((retries + 1))
508:         local elapsed=$(( $(date +%s) - START_TIME ))
509:         if [ $elapsed -ge $TIMEOUT ]; then
510:             local check_duration=$(( $(date +%s) - check_start ))
511:             record_result "$check_name" "TIMED_OUT" "$retries" "$check_duration"
512:             print_error "Timeout reached waiting for: $check_name"
513:             collect_diagnostics "$check_name" "$diag_file"
514:             return 1
515:         fi
516:         local remaining=$(( TIMEOUT - elapsed ))
517:         local remaining_min=$(( remaining / 60 ))
518:         local remaining_sec=$(( remaining % 60 ))
519:         print_color "$YELLOW" "\n$check_name not ready (attempt $retries). Retrying in ${POLL_INTERVAL}s... (${remaining_min}m ${remaining_sec}s remaining)"
520:         sleep $POLL_INTERVAL
521:     done
522: }
523: # Function to check pod status
524: check_pods() {
525:     local namespace=$1
526:     local label=$2
527:     local resource_name=$3
528:     print_header "Checking $resource_name in namespace: $namespace"
529:     if ! kubectl get namespace "$namespace" &> /dev/null; then
530:         print_warning "Namespace '$namespace' does not exist"
531:         return 1
532:     fi
533:     local pods=$(kubectl get pods -n "$namespace" -l "$label" -o json 2>/dev/null)
534:     if [ -z "$pods" ] || [ "$(echo "$pods" | jq '.items | length')" -eq 0 ]; then
535:         print_warning "No pods found with label '$label' in namespace '$namespace'"
536:         return 1
537:     fi
538:     # Count pods by status
539:     local total=$(echo "$pods" | jq '.items | length')
540:     local running=$(echo "$pods" | jq '[.items[] | select(.status.phase == "Running")] | length')
541:     local pending=$(echo "$pods" | jq '[.items[] | select(.status.phase == "Pending")] | length')
542:     local failed=$(echo "$pods" | jq '[.items[] | select(.status.phase == "Failed")] | length')
543:     echo "Total pods: $total"
544:     echo "Running: $running"
545:     echo "Pending: $pending"
546:     echo "Failed: $failed"
547:     # Show pod details
548:     echo ""
549:     kubectl get pods -n "$namespace" -l "$label" -o wide
550:     # Check if all pods are running
551:     if [ "$running" -eq "$total" ]; then
552:         print_success "All $resource_name pods are running"
553:         return 0
554:     else
555:         print_warning "Not all $resource_name pods are running"
556:         return 1
557:     fi
558: }
559: # Function to check helm releases
560: check_helm_release() {
561:     local namespace=$1
562:     local release_name_pattern=$2
563:     local resource_name=$3
564:     print_header "Checking Helm Release: $resource_name"
565:     if ! kubectl get namespace "$namespace" &> /dev/null; then
566:         print_warning "Namespace '$namespace' does not exist"
567:         return 1
568:     fi
569:     local releases=$(helm list -n "$namespace" -o json 2>/dev/null)
570:     if [ -z "$releases" ] || [ "$(echo "$releases" | jq '. | length')" -eq 0 ]; then
571:         print_warning "No Helm releases found in namespace '$namespace'"
572:         return 1
573:     fi
574:     # Filter releases matching pattern
575:     local matching_release=$(echo "$releases" | jq -r ".[] | select(.name | contains(\"$release_name_pattern\")) | .name" | head -1)
576:     if [ -z "$matching_release" ]; then
577:         print_warning "No Helm release matching pattern '$release_name_pattern' found"
578:         return 1
579:     fi
580:     echo "Release: $matching_release"
581:     helm status "$matching_release" -n "$namespace"
582:     local status=$(echo "$releases" | jq -r ".[] | select(.name == \"$matching_release\") | .status")
583:     if [ "$status" = "deployed" ]; then
584:         print_success "$resource_name is deployed"
585:         return 0
586:     else
587:         print_warning "$resource_name status: $status"
588:         return 1
589:     fi
590: }
591: # Function to check Kubernetes secrets
592: check_secrets() {
593:     local namespace=$1
594:     local resource_name=$2
595:     shift 2
596:     local secret_names=("$@")
597:     print_header "Checking Kubernetes Secrets: $resource_name"
598:     if ! kubectl get namespace "$namespace" &> /dev/null; then
599:         print_warning "Namespace '$namespace' does not exist"
600:         return 1
601:     fi
602:     local all_ok=true
603:     for secret_name in "${secret_names[@]}"; do
604:         if kubectl get secret -n "$namespace" "$secret_name" &> /dev/null; then
605:             print_success "Secret '$secret_name' exists in namespace '$namespace'"
606:         else
607:             print_warning "Secret '$secret_name' NOT found in namespace '$namespace'"
608:             all_ok=false
609:         fi
610:     done
611:     if [ "$all_ok" = true ]; then
612:         return 0
613:     else
614:         return 1
615:     fi
616: }
617: # Function to check admin-seed job
618: check_admin_seed_job() {
619:     local namespace=$1
620:     print_header "Checking Admin-Seed Job"
621:     if ! kubectl get namespace "$namespace" &> /dev/null; then
622:         print_warning "Namespace '$namespace' does not exist"
623:         return 1
624:     fi
625:     local job=$(kubectl get job admin-seed-job -n "$namespace" -o json 2>/dev/null)
626:     if [ -z "$job" ]; then
627:         print_warning "admin-seed-job not found in namespace '$namespace' (may not be configured)"
628:         return 0
629:     fi
630:     local succeeded=$(echo "$job" | jq -r '.status.succeeded // 0')
631:     local failed=$(echo "$job" | jq -r '.status.failed // 0')
632:     local active=$(echo "$job" | jq -r '.status.active // 0')
633:     echo "Succeeded: $succeeded"
634:     echo "Failed: $failed"
635:     echo "Active: $active"
636:     # Show job pods
637:     echo ""
638:     kubectl get pods -n "$namespace" -l "app.kubernetes.io/name=admin-seed" -o wide 2>/dev/null || true
639:     if [ "$succeeded" -ge 1 ]; then
640:         print_success "admin-seed-job completed successfully"
641:         return 0
642:     elif [ "$active" -ge 1 ]; then
643:         print_warning "admin-seed-job is still running"
644:         return 1
645:     else
646:         print_warning "admin-seed-job has not completed successfully (failed: $failed)"
647:         return 1
648:     fi
649: }
650: # Function to check ArgoCD Applications (if ArgoCD is enabled)
651: check_argocd_applications() {
652:     print_header "Checking ArgoCD Applications"
653:     if ! kubectl get namespace argocd &> /dev/null; then
654:         print_warning "ArgoCD namespace not found - ArgoCD may not be enabled"
655:         return 0
656:     fi
657:     # Check if ArgoCD Application CRD exists
658:     if ! kubectl api-resources --api-group=argoproj.io 2>/dev/null | grep -q "applications"; then
659:         print_warning "ArgoCD Application CRD not found - ArgoCD may not be fully deployed"
660:         return 0
661:     fi
662:     local apps_found=false
663:     for app_name in "ldap-2fa-backend" "ldap-2fa-frontend"; do
664:         local app=$(kubectl get application "$app_name" -n argocd -o json 2>/dev/null)
665:         if [ -z "$app" ]; then
666:             print_warning "ArgoCD Application '$app_name' not found"
667:             continue
668:         fi
669:         apps_found=true
670:         local health=$(echo "$app" | jq -r '.status.health.status // "Unknown"')
671:         local sync=$(echo "$app" | jq -r '.status.sync.status // "Unknown"')
672:         echo "Application: $app_name"
673:         echo "  Health: $health"
674:         echo "  Sync:   $sync"
675:         if [ "$health" = "Healthy" ] && [ "$sync" = "Synced" ]; then
676:             print_success "ArgoCD Application '$app_name' is healthy and synced"
677:         else
678:             print_warning "ArgoCD Application '$app_name' - health: $health, sync: $sync"
679:         fi
680:     done
681:     if [ "$apps_found" = false ]; then
682:         print_warning "No ArgoCD Applications found for 2FA app"
683:         return 1
684:     fi
685:     return 0
686: }
687: # Monitor all deployments (watch mode: poll each check until healthy or timeout)
688: STATUS=0
689: START_TIME=$(date +%s)
690: print_color "$BLUE" "\nPolling interval: ${POLL_INTERVAL}s | Timeout: $(( TIMEOUT / 60 ))m"
691: # Check PostgreSQL
692: wait_for_check "PostgreSQL Helm Release" check_helm_release "ldap-2fa" "postgresql" "PostgreSQL" || STATUS=1
693: wait_for_check "PostgreSQL Pods" check_pods "ldap-2fa" "app.kubernetes.io/name=postgresql" "PostgreSQL" || STATUS=1
694: # Check Redis
695: wait_for_check "Redis Helm Release" check_helm_release "redis" "redis" "Redis" || STATUS=1
696: wait_for_check "Redis Pods" check_pods "redis" "app.kubernetes.io/name=redis" "Redis" || STATUS=1
697: # Check 2FA Backend pods
698: wait_for_check "2FA Backend Pods" check_pods "2fa-app" "app.kubernetes.io/name=ldap-2fa-backend" "2FA Backend" || STATUS=1
699: # Check 2FA Frontend pods
700: wait_for_check "2FA Frontend Pods" check_pods "2fa-app" "app.kubernetes.io/name=ldap-2fa-frontend" "2FA Frontend" || STATUS=1
701: # Check Kubernetes secrets in backend namespace
702: wait_for_check "Backend Namespace Secrets" check_secrets "2fa-app" "Backend Namespace Secrets" \
703:     "ldap-admin-secret" \
704:     "postgresql-secret" \
705:     "redis-secret" || STATUS=1
706: # Check admin-seed job
707: wait_for_check "Admin-Seed Job" check_admin_seed_job "2fa-app" || STATUS=1
708: # Check ArgoCD Applications
709: wait_for_check "ArgoCD Applications" check_argocd_applications || STATUS=1
710: # Informational check (run once after all polling completes)
711: {
712:     print_header "Checking 2FA Application Ingress Resources"
713:     kubectl get ingress -n 2fa-app 2>&1 || print_warning "No Ingress resources found in 2fa-app namespace"
714: } 2>&1 | tee "$REPORT_DIR/informational.txt"
715: # Report and summary
716: print_report
717: # Write report file
718: SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
719: REPORT_TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
720: REPORT_FILE="${SCRIPT_DIR}/monitor-report-${REGION}-${ENVIRONMENT}-${REPORT_TIMESTAMP}.txt"
721: write_report_file "$REPORT_FILE"
722: ELAPSED=$(( $(date +%s) - START_TIME ))
723: ELAPSED_MIN=$(( ELAPSED / 60 ))
724: ELAPSED_SEC=$(( ELAPSED % 60 ))
725: print_header "Monitoring Summary (completed in ${ELAPSED_MIN}m ${ELAPSED_SEC}s)"
726: if [ $STATUS -eq 0 ]; then
727:     print_success "All application deployments are healthy!"
728: else
729:     print_warning "Some application deployments have issues. Review the report above for details."
730: fi
731: print_color "$BLUE" "\nReport saved to: $REPORT_FILE"
732: print_color "$BLUE" "Submit this file to an agent for failure investigation and code fix suggestions."
733: exit $STATUS
```

```
 51: {{- end -}}
 52: 
 53: {{/*
 54: Return the proper OpenLDAP image name.
 55: Supports image.registry, image.repository, image.tag.
 56: */}}
 57: {{- define "openldap.image" -}}
 58: {{- if .Values.image.registry -}}
 59: {{- printf "%s/%s:%s" .Values.image.registry .Values.image.repository (.Values.image.tag | toString) -}}
 60: {{- else -}}

 91: e.g., "ldap.example.com" -> "dc=ldap,dc=example,dc=com"

107: {{- end -}}

111: */}}
112: {{- define "openldap.server" -}}
113: {{- printf "%s.%s" .Release.Name .Release.Namespace -}}
114: {{- end -}}
115: 
116: {{/*
117: Generate LDAP_REPLICATION_HOSTS value for osixia multi-master replication.
118: Produces: #DIFFUSION2BASH:[ldap://pod-0.headless.ns.svc.cluster.local ldap://pod-1.headless.ns.svc.cluster.local ...]
119: */}}
120: {{- define "openldap.replicationHosts" -}}
121: {{- $name := include "openldap.fullname" . -}}
122: {{- $namespace := .Release.Namespace -}}
123: {{- $cluster := .Values.replication.clusterName -}}
124: {{- $nodeCount := .Values.replicaCount | int -}}
125: {{- $hosts := list -}}
126: {{- range $i := until $nodeCount -}}
127:   {{- $hosts = append $hosts (printf "'ldap://%s-%d.%s-headless.%s.svc.%s'" $name $i $name $namespace $cluster) -}}
128: {{- end -}}
129: #PYTHON2BASH:[{{ join ", " $hosts }}]
130: {{- end -}}
131: 
132: {{/*
133: Render a value that contains template.
134: */}}
135: {{- define "openldap.tplValue" -}}
136: {{- if typeIs "string" .value -}}
137:   {{- tpl .value .context -}}
138: {{- else -}}
139:   {{- tpl (.value | toYaml) .context -}}
140: {{- end -}}
141: {{- end -}}
```

## File: application_infra/charts/openldap-stack-ha/templates/configmap-env.yaml
```yaml
 1: #
 2: # ConfigMap for osixia/openldap environment variables.
 3: # Ref: https://github.com/osixia/docker-openldap#environment-variables
 4: #
 5: apiVersion: v1
 6: kind: ConfigMap
 7: metadata:
 8:   name: {{ template "openldap.fullname" . }}-env
 9:   labels:
10:     {{- include "openldap.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
11:     {{- with .Values.extraLabels }}
12:     {{- toYaml . | nindent 4 }}
13:     {{- end }}
14: data:
15:   # Core LDAP configuration
16:   LDAP_DOMAIN: {{ .Values.ldapDomain | quote }}
17:   LDAP_ORGANISATION: {{ .Values.ldapOrganisation | quote }}
18:   # TLS configuration (osixia auto-generates self-signed certs when enabled)
19:   LDAP_TLS: {{ .Values.tls.enabled | quote }}
20:   LDAP_TLS_ENFORCE: {{ .Values.tls.enforce | quote }}
21:   LDAP_TLS_VERIFY_CLIENT: {{ .Values.tls.verifyClient | quote }}
22:   LDAP_TLS_CRT_FILENAME: {{ .Values.tls.certFilename | quote }}
23:   LDAP_TLS_KEY_FILENAME: {{ .Values.tls.keyFilename | quote }}
24:   LDAP_TLS_CA_CRT_FILENAME: {{ .Values.tls.caFilename | quote }}
25:   {{- if .Values.replication.enabled }}
26:   # osixia native multi-master replication
27:   LDAP_REPLICATION: "true"
28:   LDAP_REPLICATION_CONFIG_SYNCPROV: {{ .Values.replication.configSyncprov | quote }}
29:   LDAP_REPLICATION_DB_SYNCPROV: {{ .Values.replication.dbSyncprov | quote }}
30:   LDAP_REPLICATION_HOSTS: {{ include "openldap.replicationHosts" . | quote }}
31:   {{- end }}
32:   # Additional user-provided env vars
33:   {{- range $key, $val := .Values.env }}
34:   {{ $key }}: {{ $val | quote }}
35:   {{- end }}
```

## File: application_infra/modules/alb/main.tf
```hcl
  1: # *** EKS Auto mode has its own load balancer driver ***
  2: # So there is no need to configure AWS Load Balancer Controller
  3: 
  4: # *** EKS Auto Mode takes care of IAM permissions ***
  5: # There is no need to attach AWSLoadBalancerControllerIAMPolicy to the EKS Node IAM Role
  6: 
  7: locals {
  8:   # ingress_alb_name            = "${var.prefix}-${var.region}-${var.ingress_alb_name}-${var.env}"
  9:   # service_alb_name            = "${var.prefix}-${var.region}-${var.service_alb_name}-${var.env}"
 10:   ingressclass_alb_name       = "${var.prefix}-${var.region}-${var.ingressclass_alb_name}-${var.env}"
 11:   ingressclassparams_alb_name = "${var.prefix}-${var.region}-${var.ingressclassparams_alb_name}-${var.env}"
 12: }
 13: 
 14: # Kubernetes Ingress and Service resources commented out
 15: # These are not needed - OpenLDAP Helm chart creates its own Ingress resources
 16: # which will use the IngressClass defined below
 17: 
 18: # resource "kubernetes_ingress_v1" "ingress_alb" {
 19: #   metadata {
 20: #     name      = local.ingress_alb_name
 21: #     namespace = "default"

 40: #     ingress_class_name = local.ingressclass_alb_name
 41: #
 42: #     rule {

 47: #

 51: #               port {

 53: #               }
 54: #             }
 55: #           }
```
