## File: application_infra/destroy-application-infra.sh
```bash
  1: #!/bin/bash
  2: # Script to configure backend.hcl and variables.tfvars with user-selected region and environment
  3: # and run Terraform destroy commands
  4: # Usage: ./destroy-application-infra.sh  (from application_infra/) or ./application_infra/destroy-application-infra.sh (from repo root)
  5: set -euo pipefail
  6: # Run from script directory so placeholder and Terraform files are found (works when called from repo root or application_infra)
  7: SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
  8: cd "$SCRIPT_DIR"
  9: # Clean up any existing AWS credentials from environment to prevent conflicts
 10: # This ensures the script starts with a clean slate and uses the correct credentials
 11: unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID 2>/dev/null || true
 12: unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY 2>/dev/null || true
 13: unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN 2>/dev/null || true
 14: unset AWS_PROFILE 2>/dev/null || true
 15: # Colors for output
 16: RED='\033[0;31m'
 17: GREEN='\033[0;32m'
 18: YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
 19: NC='\033[0m' # No Color
 20: # Configuration
 21: PLACEHOLDER_FILE="tfstate-backend-values-template.hcl"
 22: BACKEND_FILE="backend.hcl"
 23: VARIABLES_FILE="variables.tfvars"
 24: # Export configuration variables for use by sourced scripts
 25: export BACKEND_FILE
 26: export VARIABLES_FILE
 27: # Function to print colored messages
 28: print_error() {
 29:     echo -e "${RED}ERROR:${NC} $1" >&2
 30: }
 31: print_success() {
 32:     echo -e "${GREEN}SUCCESS:${NC} $1"
 33: }
 34: print_info() {
 35:     echo -e "${YELLOW}INFO:${NC} $1"
 36: }
 37: print_warning() {
 38:     echo -e "${YELLOW}WARNING:${NC} $1"
 39: }
 40: # Check if AWS CLI is installed
 41: if ! command -v aws &> /dev/null; then
 42:     print_error "AWS CLI is not installed."
 43:     echo "Please install it from: https://aws.amazon.com/cli/"
 44:     exit 1
 45: fi
 46: # Check if Terraform is installed
 47: if ! command -v terraform &> /dev/null; then
 48:     print_error "Terraform is not installed."
 49:     echo "Please install it from: https://www.terraform.io/downloads"
 50:     exit 1
 51: fi
 52: # Check if GitHub CLI is installed
 53: if ! command -v gh &> /dev/null; then
 54:     print_error "GitHub CLI (gh) is not installed."
 55:     echo "Please install it from: https://cli.github.com/"
 56:     exit 1
 57: fi
 58: # Check if user is authenticated with GitHub CLI
 59: if ! gh auth status &> /dev/null; then
 60:     print_error "Not authenticated with GitHub CLI."
 61:     echo "Please run: gh auth login"
 62:     exit 1
 63: fi
 64: # Check if jq is installed (required for gh --jq flag)
 65: if ! command -v jq &> /dev/null; then
 66:     print_error "jq is not installed."
 67:     echo "Please install it:"
 68:     echo "  macOS: brew install jq"
 69:     echo "  Linux: sudo apt-get install jq (or use your package manager)"
 70:     echo "  Or visit: https://stedolan.github.io/jq/download/"
 71:     exit 1
 72: fi
 73: # Get repository owner and name
 74: REPO_OWNER=$(gh repo view --json owner --jq '.owner.login' 2>/dev/null || echo "")
 75: REPO_NAME=$(gh repo view --json name --jq '.name' 2>/dev/null || echo "")
 76: if [ -z "$REPO_OWNER" ] || [ -z "$REPO_NAME" ]; then
 77:     print_error "Could not determine repository information."
 78:     echo "Please ensure you're in a git repository and have proper permissions."
 79:     exit 1
 80: fi
 81: print_info "Repository: ${REPO_OWNER}/${REPO_NAME}"
 82: # Function to get repository variable using GitHub CLI
 83: get_repo_variable() {
 84:     local var_name=$1
 85:     local value
 86:     value=$(gh variable list --repo "${REPO_OWNER}/${REPO_NAME}" --json name,value --jq ".[] | select(.name == \"${var_name}\") | .value" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
 87:     if [ -z "$value" ]; then
 88:         print_error "Repository variable '${var_name}' not found or not accessible."
 89:         return 1
 90:     fi
 91:     echo "$value"
 92: }
 93: # Function to retrieve secret from AWS Secrets Manager
 94: get_aws_secret() {
 95:     local secret_name=$1
 96:     local secret_json
 97:     local exit_code
 98:     # Retrieve secret from AWS Secrets Manager
 99:     # Use AWS_REGION if set, otherwise default to us-east-1
100:     secret_json=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value \
101:         --secret-id "$secret_name" \
102:         --region "${AWS_REGION:-us-east-1}" \
103:         --query SecretString \
104:         --output text 2>&1)
105:     # Capture exit code before checking
106:     exit_code=$?
107:     # Validate secret retrieval
108:     if [ $exit_code -ne 0 ]; then
109:         print_error "Failed to retrieve secret '${secret_name}' from AWS Secrets Manager"
110:         print_error "Error: $secret_json"
111:         return 1
112:     fi
113:     # Validate JSON can be parsed
114:     if ! echo "$secret_json" | jq empty 2>/dev/null; then
115:         print_error "Secret '${secret_name}' contains invalid JSON"
116:         return 1
117:     fi
118:     echo "$secret_json"
119: }
120: # Function to retrieve plain text secret from AWS Secrets Manager
121: get_aws_plaintext_secret() {
122:     local secret_name=$1
123:     local secret_value
124:     local exit_code
125:     # Retrieve secret from AWS Secrets Manager
126:     # Use AWS_REGION if set, otherwise default to us-east-1
127:     secret_value=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value \
128:         --secret-id "$secret_name" \
129:         --region "${AWS_REGION:-us-east-1}" \
130:         --query SecretString \
131:         --output text 2>&1)
132:     # Capture exit code before checking
133:     exit_code=$?
134:     # Validate secret retrieval
135:     if [ $exit_code -ne 0 ]; then
136:         print_error "Failed to retrieve secret '${secret_name}' from AWS Secrets Manager"
137:         print_error "Error: $secret_value"
138:         return 1
139:     fi
140:     # Check if secret value is empty
141:     if [ -z "$secret_value" ]; then
142:         print_error "Secret '${secret_name}' is empty"
143:         return 1
144:     fi
145:     echo "$secret_value"
146: }
147: # Function to get key value from secret JSON
148: get_secret_key_value() {
149:     local secret_json=$1
150:     local key_name=$2
151:     local value
152:     # Validate JSON can be parsed
153:     if ! echo "$secret_json" | jq empty 2>/dev/null; then
154:         print_error "Invalid JSON provided to get_secret_key_value"
155:         return 1
156:     fi
157:     # Extract key value using jq
158:     value=$(echo "$secret_json" | jq -r ".[\"${key_name}\"]" 2>/dev/null)
159:     # Check if jq command succeeded
160:     if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
161:         print_error "Failed to parse JSON or extract key '${key_name}'"
162:         return 1
163:     fi
164:     # Check if key exists (jq returns "null" for non-existent keys)
165:     if [ "$value" = "null" ] || [ -z "$value" ]; then
166:         print_error "Key '${key_name}' not found in secret JSON or value is empty"
167:         return 1
168:     fi
169:     echo "$value"
170: }
171: # Function to assume an AWS IAM role and export credentials
172: # Usage: assume_aws_role <role_arn> [external_id] [role_description] [session_name_suffix]
173: #   role_arn: The ARN of the role to assume (required)
174: #   external_id: Optional external ID for cross-account role assumption
175: #   role_description: Optional description for logging (defaults to "role")
176: #   session_name_suffix: Optional suffix for session name (defaults to "destroy-application-infra")
177: assume_aws_role() {
178:     local role_arn=$1
179:     local external_id=${2:-}
180:     local role_description=${3:-"role"}
181:     local session_name_suffix=${4:-"destroy-application-infra"}
182:     if [ -z "$role_arn" ]; then
183:         print_error "Role ARN is required for assume_aws_role"
184:         return 1
185:     fi
186:     print_info "Assuming ${role_description}: $role_arn"
187:     print_info "Region: $AWS_REGION"
188:     # Assume the role
189:     local role_session_name="${session_name_suffix}-$(date +%s)"
190:     local assume_role_output
191:     # Assume role and capture output
192:     # Add external ID if provided
193:     if [ -n "$external_id" ]; then
194:         assume_role_output=$(aws sts assume-role \
195:             --role-arn "$role_arn" \
196:             --role-session-name "$role_session_name" \
197:             --external-id "$external_id" \
198:             --region "$AWS_REGION" 2>&1)
199:     else
200:         assume_role_output=$(aws sts assume-role \
201:             --role-arn "$role_arn" \
202:             --role-session-name "$role_session_name" \
203:             --region "$AWS_REGION" 2>&1)
204:     fi
205:     if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
206:         print_error "Failed to assume ${role_description}: $assume_role_output"
207:         return 1
208:     fi
209:     # Extract credentials from JSON output
210:     # Try using jq if available (more reliable), otherwise use sed/grep
211:     local access_key_id
212:     local secret_access_key
213:     local session_token
214:     if command -v jq &> /dev/null; then
215:         access_key_id=$(echo "$assume_role_output" | jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId')
216:         secret_access_key=$(echo "$assume_role_output" | jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey')
217:         session_token=$(echo "$assume_role_output" | jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken')
218:     else
219:         # Fallback: use sed for JSON parsing (works on both macOS and Linux)
220:         access_key_id=$(echo "$assume_role_output" | sed -n 's/.*"AccessKeyId"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
221:         secret_access_key=$(echo "$assume_role_output" | sed -n 's/.*"SecretAccessKey"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
222:         session_token=$(echo "$assume_role_output" | sed -n 's/.*"SessionToken"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
223:     fi
224:     if [ -z "$access_key_id" ] || [ -z "$secret_access_key" ] || [ -z "$session_token" ]; then
225:         print_error "Failed to extract credentials from assume-role output."
226:         print_error "Output was: $assume_role_output"
227:         return 1
228:     fi
229:     # Export credentials to environment variables
230:     export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$access_key_id"
231:     export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$secret_access_key"
232:     export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$session_token"
233:     print_success "Successfully assumed ${role_description}"
234:     # Verify the credentials work
235:     local caller_arn
236:     caller_arn=$(aws sts get-caller-identity --region "$AWS_REGION" --query 'Arn' --output text 2>&1)
237:     if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
238:         print_error "Failed to verify assumed role credentials: $caller_arn"
239:         return 1
240:     fi
241:     print_info "${role_description} identity: $caller_arn"
242:     return 0
243: }
244: # Warning about destructive operation
245: echo ""
246: print_warning "=========================================="
247: print_warning "  DESTRUCTIVE OPERATION WARNING"
248: print_warning "=========================================="
249: print_warning "This script will DESTROY all application"
250: print_warning "infrastructure in the selected region and environment."
251: print_warning ""
252: print_warning "This action CANNOT be undone!"
253: print_warning "=========================================="
254: echo ""
255: read -p "Are you sure you want to continue? (type 'yes' to confirm): " confirmation
256: if [ "$confirmation" != "yes" ]; then
257:     print_info "Operation cancelled."
258:     exit 0
259: fi
260: # Interactive prompts
261: echo ""
262: print_info "Select AWS Region:"
263: echo "1) us-east-1: N. Virginia (default)"
264: echo "2) us-east-2: Ohio"
265: read -p "Enter choice [1-2] (default: 1): " region_choice
266: case ${region_choice:-1} in
267:     1)
268:         SELECTED_REGION="us-east-1: N. Virginia"
269:         ;;
270:     2)
271:         SELECTED_REGION="us-east-2: Ohio"
272:         ;;
273:     *)
274:         print_error "Invalid choice. Using default: us-east-1: N. Virginia"
275:         SELECTED_REGION="us-east-1: N. Virginia"
276:         ;;
277: esac
278: # Extract region code (everything before the colon)
279: AWS_REGION="${SELECTED_REGION%%:*}"
280: export AWS_REGION
281: print_success "Selected region: ${SELECTED_REGION} (${AWS_REGION})"
282: echo ""
283: print_info "Select Environment:"
284: echo "1) prod (default)"
285: echo "2) dev"
286: read -p "Enter choice [1-2] (default: 1): " env_choice
287: case ${env_choice:-1} in
288:     1)
289:         ENVIRONMENT="prod"
290:         ;;
291:     2)
292:         ENVIRONMENT="dev"
293:         ;;
294:     *)
295:         print_error "Invalid choice. Using default: prod"
296:         ENVIRONMENT="prod"
297:         ;;
298: esac
299: print_success "Selected environment: ${ENVIRONMENT}"
300: export ENVIRONMENT
301: echo ""
302: # Final confirmation with environment details
303: print_warning "You are about to DESTROY application infrastructure in:"
304: print_warning "  Region: ${AWS_REGION}"
305: print_warning "  Environment: ${ENVIRONMENT}"
306: echo ""
307: read -p "Type 'DESTROY' to confirm: " final_confirmation
308: if [ "$final_confirmation" != "DESTROY" ]; then
309:     print_info "Operation cancelled."
310:     exit 0
311: fi
312: # Retrieve role ARNs from AWS Secrets Manager in a single call
313: # This minimizes AWS CLI calls by fetching all required role ARNs at once
314: print_info "Retrieving role ARNs from AWS Secrets Manager..."
315: ROLE_SECRET_JSON=$(get_aws_secret "github-role" || echo "")
316: if [ -z "$ROLE_SECRET_JSON" ]; then
317:     print_error "Failed to retrieve 'github-role' secret from AWS Secrets Manager"
318:     exit 1
319: fi
320: # Extract STATE_ACCOUNT_ROLE_ARN for backend state operations
321: STATE_ROLE_ARN=$(get_secret_key_value "$ROLE_SECRET_JSON" "AWS_STATE_ACCOUNT_ROLE_ARN" || echo "")
322: if [ -z "$STATE_ROLE_ARN" ]; then
323:     print_error "Failed to retrieve AWS_STATE_ACCOUNT_ROLE_ARN from secret"
324:     exit 1
325: fi
326: print_success "Retrieved AWS_STATE_ACCOUNT_ROLE_ARN"
327: # Determine which deployment account role ARN to use based on environment
328: if [ "$ENVIRONMENT" = "prod" ]; then
329:     DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN_KEY="AWS_PRODUCTION_ACCOUNT_ROLE_ARN"
330: else
331:     DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN_KEY="AWS_DEVELOPMENT_ACCOUNT_ROLE_ARN"
332: fi
333: # Extract deployment account role ARN for provider assume_role
334: DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN=$(get_secret_key_value "$ROLE_SECRET_JSON" "$DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN_KEY" || echo "")
335: if [ -z "$DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN" ]; then
336:     print_error "Failed to retrieve ${DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN_KEY} from secret"
337:     exit 1
338: fi
339: export DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN
340: print_success "Retrieved ${DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN_KEY}"
341: # Retrieve ExternalId from AWS Secrets Manager (plain text secret)
342: print_info "Retrieving ExternalId from AWS Secrets Manager..."
343: EXTERNAL_ID=$(get_aws_plaintext_secret "external-id" || echo "")
344: if [ -z "$EXTERNAL_ID" ]; then
345:     print_error "Failed to retrieve 'external-id' secret from AWS Secrets Manager"
346:     exit 1
347: fi
348: export EXTERNAL_ID
349: print_success "Retrieved ExternalId"
350: # Retrieve Terraform variables from AWS Secrets Manager in a single call
351: print_info "Retrieving Terraform variables from AWS Secrets Manager..."
352: TF_VARS_SECRET_JSON=$(get_aws_secret "tf-vars" || echo "")
353: if [ -z "$TF_VARS_SECRET_JSON" ]; then
354:     print_error "Failed to retrieve 'tf-vars' secret from AWS Secrets Manager"
355:     exit 1
356: fi
357: # Extract OpenLDAP password values from tf-vars secret
358: TF_VAR_OPENLDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD_VALUE=$(get_secret_key_value "$TF_VARS_SECRET_JSON" "TF_VAR_OPENLDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD" || echo "")
359: if [ -z "$TF_VAR_OPENLDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD_VALUE" ]; then
360:     print_error "Failed to retrieve TF_VAR_OPENLDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD from secret"
361:     exit 1
362: fi
363: print_success "Retrieved TF_VAR_OPENLDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD"
364: TF_VAR_OPENLDAP_CONFIG_PASSWORD_VALUE=$(get_secret_key_value "$TF_VARS_SECRET_JSON" "TF_VAR_OPENLDAP_CONFIG_PASSWORD" || echo "")
365: if [ -z "$TF_VAR_OPENLDAP_CONFIG_PASSWORD_VALUE" ]; then
366:     print_error "Failed to retrieve TF_VAR_OPENLDAP_CONFIG_PASSWORD from secret"
367:     exit 1
368: fi
369: print_success "Retrieved TF_VAR_OPENLDAP_CONFIG_PASSWORD"
370: # Export as environment variables for Terraform
371: # Note: TF_VAR environment variables are case-sensitive and must match variable names in variables.tf
372: # Secrets in AWS/GitHub remain uppercase, but environment variables must be lowercase
373: export TF_VAR_openldap_admin_password="$TF_VAR_OPENLDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD_VALUE"
374: export TF_VAR_openldap_config_password="$TF_VAR_OPENLDAP_CONFIG_PASSWORD_VALUE"
375: print_success "Retrieved and exported all secrets from AWS Secrets Manager"
376: echo ""
377: # Retrieve repository variables
378: print_info "Retrieving repository variables..."
379: BUCKET_NAME=$(get_repo_variable "BACKEND_BUCKET_NAME") || exit 1
380: print_success "Retrieved BACKEND_BUCKET_NAME"
381: APPLICATION_INFRA_PREFIX=$(get_repo_variable "APPLICATION_INFRA_PREFIX") || exit 1
382: print_success "Retrieved APPLICATION_INFRA_PREFIX"
383: # Check if backend.hcl already exists
384: if [ -f "$BACKEND_FILE" ]; then
385:     print_info "${BACKEND_FILE} already exists. Skipping creation."
386: else
387:     # Check if placeholder file exists
388:     if [ ! -f "$PLACEHOLDER_FILE" ]; then
389:         print_error "Placeholder file '${PLACEHOLDER_FILE}' not found."
390:         exit 1
391:     fi
392:     # Copy placeholder to backend file and replace placeholders
393:     print_info "Creating ${BACKEND_FILE} from ${PLACEHOLDER_FILE} with retrieved values..."
394:     # Copy placeholder file to backend file
395:     cp "$PLACEHOLDER_FILE" "$BACKEND_FILE"
396:     # Replace placeholders (works on macOS and Linux)
397:     if [[ "$OSTYPE" == "darwin"* ]]; then
398:         # macOS sed requires -i '' for in-place editing
399:         sed -i '' "s|<BACKEND_BUCKET_NAME>|${BUCKET_NAME}|g" "$BACKEND_FILE"
400:         sed -i '' "s|<APPLICATION_INFRA_PREFIX>|${APPLICATION_INFRA_PREFIX}|g" "$BACKEND_FILE"
401:         sed -i '' "s|<AWS_REGION>|${AWS_REGION}|g" "$BACKEND_FILE"
402:     else
403:         # Linux sed
404:         sed -i "s|<BACKEND_BUCKET_NAME>|${BUCKET_NAME}|g" "$BACKEND_FILE"
405:         sed -i "s|<APPLICATION_INFRA_PREFIX>|${APPLICATION_INFRA_PREFIX}|g" "$BACKEND_FILE"
406:         sed -i "s|<AWS_REGION>|${AWS_REGION}|g" "$BACKEND_FILE"
407:     fi
408:     print_success "Created ${BACKEND_FILE}"
409: fi
410: print_success "Configuration files updated successfully!"
411: echo ""
412: print_info "Backend file: ${BACKEND_FILE}"
413: print_info "  - bucket: ${BUCKET_NAME}"
414: print_info "  - key: ${APPLICATION_INFRA_PREFIX}"
415: print_info "  - region: ${AWS_REGION}"
416: echo ""
417: # Assume State Account role for backend operations
418: if ! assume_aws_role "$STATE_ROLE_ARN" "" "State Account role" "destroy-application-infra"; then
419:     exit 1
420: fi
421: echo ""
422: # Terraform workspace name
423: WORKSPACE_NAME="${AWS_REGION}-${ENVIRONMENT}"
424: # Terraform init
425: print_info "Running terraform init with backend configuration..."
426: terraform init -backend-config="${BACKEND_FILE}"
427: # Terraform workspace
428: print_info "Selecting or creating workspace: ${WORKSPACE_NAME}..."
429: terraform workspace select "${WORKSPACE_NAME}" 2>/dev/null || terraform workspace new "${WORKSPACE_NAME}"
430: # Terraform validate
431: print_info "Running terraform validate..."
432: terraform validate
433: # Set Kubernetes environment variables
434: print_info "Setting Kubernetes environment variables..."
435: if [ ! -f "../scripts/set-k8s-env.sh" ]; then
436:     print_error "set-k8s-env.sh not found."
437:     exit 1
438: fi
439: # Make sure the script is executable
440: chmod +x ../scripts/set-k8s-env.sh
441: # Export backend_infra workspace for set-k8s-env.sh (consistent behavior when sourced from scripts or CI)
442: export TERRAFORM_WORKSPACE="$WORKSPACE_NAME"
443: # Source the script to set environment variables
444: # The script uses environment variables (Deployment Account credentials for EKS, State Account credentials for S3)
445: source ../scripts/set-k8s-env.sh
446: if [ -z "$KUBERNETES_MASTER" ]; then
447:     print_error "Failed to set KUBERNETES_MASTER environment variable."
448:     exit 1
449: fi
450: print_success "Kubernetes environment variables set"
451: print_info "  - KUBERNETES_MASTER: ${KUBERNETES_MASTER}"
452: print_info "  - KUBE_CONFIG_PATH: ${KUBE_CONFIG_PATH}"
453: # Export as TF_VAR_ environment variables for Terraform
454: export TF_VAR_kubernetes_master="$KUBERNETES_MASTER"
455: export TF_VAR_kube_config_path="$KUBE_CONFIG_PATH"
456: print_info "  - TF_VAR_kubernetes_master: ${TF_VAR_kubernetes_master}"
457: print_info "  - TF_VAR_kube_config_path: ${TF_VAR_kube_config_path}"
458: echo ""
459: # Assume State Account role again for Terraform operations
460: if ! assume_aws_role "$STATE_ROLE_ARN" "" "State Account role" "destroy-application-infra"; then
461:     exit 1
462: fi
463: echo ""
464: # Terraform plan destroy
465: print_info "Running terraform plan destroy..."
466: terraform plan -var-file="${VARIABLES_FILE}" -destroy -out terraform.tfplan
467: # Terraform apply (destroy)
468: print_warning "Applying destroy plan. This will DESTROY all application infrastructure..."
469: terraform apply -auto-approve terraform.tfplan
470: echo ""
471: print_success "Terraform destroy operation completed successfully!"
472: # Clean up PVCs (Helm does not delete PVCs by default to prevent data loss)
473: print_info "Checking for remaining PVCs in ldap namespace..."
474: PVC_COUNT=$(kubectl get pvc -n ldap --no-headers 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ' || echo "0")
475: if [ "$PVC_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
476:     print_warning "Found ${PVC_COUNT} PVC(s) remaining in ldap namespace."
477:     print_info "Helm does not delete PVCs by default. Deleting PVCs now..."
478:     print_warning "This will also delete the underlying EBS volumes (reclaim_policy=Delete)."
479:     if kubectl delete pvc --all -n ldap 2>/dev/null; then
480:         print_success "PVCs deleted successfully!"
481:     else
482:         print_error "Failed to delete PVCs. You may need to delete them manually:"
483:         print_info "  kubectl delete pvc --all -n ldap"
484:     fi
485: else
486:     print_info "No PVCs found in ldap namespace (already cleaned up or namespace doesn't exist)."
487: fi
488: echo ""
489: print_success "Destroy operation completed successfully!"
490: print_info "All application infrastructure in ${AWS_REGION} (${ENVIRONMENT}) has been destroyed."
```

## File: application/modules/sns/scripts/get-sender-id-arn.sh
```bash
 1: #!/usr/bin/env sh
 2: # Fetches the ARN of an SMS Sender ID from AWS End User Messaging (Pinpoint SMS Voice V2).
 3: # For manual testing only. Terraform uses inline bash with assume-github-role.sh (see
 4: # modules/sns/main.tf) to fetch credentials from env or Secrets Manager.
 5: #
 6: # Input (JSON on stdin): {"sender_id":"TALO2FA","country_code":"IL","region":"us-east-1"}
 7: # Output (JSON on stdout): {"arn":"arn:aws:sms-voice:...","found":"true"} or {"arn":"","found":"false"}
 8: # Note: external data source requires all values to be strings.
 9: #
10: # Manual use (requires jq, aws; uses current AWS credentials):
11: #   echo '{"sender_id":"TALORLIKAWS","country_code":"IL","region":"us-east-1"}' | ./get-sender-id-arn.sh
12: # For cross-account: from repo root, source scripts/assume-github-role.sh prod first.
13: set -e
14: QUERY=$(cat)
15: SENDER_ID=$(echo "$QUERY" | jq -r '.sender_id // empty')
16: COUNTRY_CODE=$(echo "$QUERY" | jq -r '.country_code // empty')
17: REGION=$(echo "$QUERY" | jq -r '.region // "us-east-1"')
18: if [ -z "$SENDER_ID" ] || [ -z "$COUNTRY_CODE" ]; then
19:   jq -n '{arn: "", found: "false"}'
20:   exit 0
21: fi
22: ARN=$(aws pinpoint-sms-voice-v2 describe-sender-ids \
23:   --sender-ids "SenderId=${SENDER_ID},IsoCountryCode=${COUNTRY_CODE}" \
24:   --region "$REGION" \
25:   --no-paginate \
26:   --query 'SenderIds[0].SenderIdArn' \
27:   --output text 2>/dev/null || true)
28: if [ -z "$ARN" ] || [ "$ARN" = "None" ]; then
29:   jq -n '{arn: "", found: "false"}'
30: else
31:   jq -n --arg arn "$ARN" '{arn: $arn, found: "true"}'
32: fi
```

## File: application/modules/sns/main.tf
```hcl
  1: # SNS Module for SMS-based 2FA Verification
  2: #
  3: # This module creates:
  4: # - IAM Role for EKS Service Account (IRSA) to publish SMS via SNS
  5: # - IAM Policy for direct SMS publishing (PhoneNumber=...)
  6: #
  7: # Uses Direct SMS (sns:Publish with PhoneNumber) - no SNS topic required. Topics
  8: # are for broadcast to multiple subscribers; 2FA sends one-off codes to individual
  9: # phones. See: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sms_publish-to-phone.html
 10: #
 11: # When sms_sender_country_code is set, fetches the Sender ID ARN from AWS End
 12: # User Messaging (Pinpoint SMS Voice V2) for validation and reference.
 13: 
 14: locals {
 15:   iam_role_name = "${var.prefix}-${var.region}-${var.iam_role_name}-${var.env}"
 16: }
 17: 
 18: # Data source to get AWS account ID
 19: data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}
 20: 
 21: # Fetch Sender ID ARN from AWS End User Messaging (Pinpoint SMS Voice V2).
 22: # The sender ID must be pre-registered via AWS End User Messaging console
 23: # (Configurations > Sender ID > Request originator) and shared with SNS.
 24: # Uses assume-github-role.sh to assume the correct deployment account role based on
 25: # var.env (same as ArgoCD external). Credentials come from env (GitHub Actions) or
 26: # AWS Secrets Manager (local). See docs/auxiliary/application_infra/guides/SMS_SENDER_ID_SETUP.md
 27: data "external" "sender_id_arn" {
 28:   program = ["bash", "-c", <<-EOT
 29:     set -u -o pipefail
 30:     export AWS_PAGER=""
 31:     ARN=""
 32:     FOUND="false"
 33:     ERR=""
 34: 
 35:     QUERY=$(cat)
 36:     SENDER_ID=$(echo "$QUERY" | jq -r '.sender_id // empty')
 37:     COUNTRY_CODE=$(echo "$QUERY" | jq -r '.country_code // empty')
 38:     REGION=$(echo "$QUERY" | jq -r '.region // "us-east-1"')
 39: 
 40:     if [ -z "$SENDER_ID" ] || [ -z "$COUNTRY_CODE" ]; then
 41:       jq -n --arg arn "" --arg found "false" --arg err "$ERR" '{arn:$arn,found:$found,error:$err}'
 42:       exit 0
 43:     fi
 44: 
 45:     ENV_LOWER="$(echo "${var.env}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
 46:     if [ "$ENV_LOWER" = "prod" ]; then
 47:       ACCOUNT_TYPE="prod"
 48:     else
 49:       ACCOUNT_TYPE="dev"
 50:     fi
 51: 
 52:     SCRIPT_PATH="${path.root}/../scripts/assume-github-role.sh"
 53:     if [ ! -x "$SCRIPT_PATH" ]; then
 54:       SCRIPT_PATH="../scripts/assume-github-role.sh"
 55:     fi
 56: 
 57:     if [ ! -x "$SCRIPT_PATH" ]; then
 58:       ERR="assume_script_not_found"
 59:     else
 60:       TMP="$(mktemp 2>/dev/null || echo "/tmp/sender_id_assume_$$")"
 61:       set +e
 62:       source "$SCRIPT_PATH" "$ACCOUNT_TYPE" >"$TMP" 2>&1
 63:       SCRIPT_RC=$?
 64:       set -e
 65: 
 66:       SCRIPT_ERROR_CHECK=$(env | grep '^SCRIPT_ERROR=' || echo "")
 67:       if [ -n "$SCRIPT_ERROR_CHECK" ] && echo "$SCRIPT_ERROR_CHECK" | grep -q 'SCRIPT_ERROR=true'; then
 68:         SCRIPT_ERROR_MSG_CHECK=$(env | grep '^SCRIPT_ERROR_MSG=' || echo "")
 69:         MSG=$(echo "$SCRIPT_ERROR_MSG_CHECK" | sed 's/^SCRIPT_ERROR_MSG=//' || echo "")
 70:         if [ -z "$MSG" ]; then
 71:           MSG="$(head -c 400 "$TMP" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n\r' || true)"
 72:         fi
 73:         ERR="failed_to_assume_role:$${MSG}"
 74:       else
 75:         AWS_AKID_CHECK=$(env | grep '^AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=' || echo "")
 76:         AWS_SAK_CHECK=$(env | grep '^AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=' || echo "")
 77:         AWS_ST_CHECK=$(env | grep '^AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=' || echo "")
 78:         if [ -z "$AWS_AKID_CHECK" ] || [ -z "$AWS_SAK_CHECK" ] || [ -z "$AWS_ST_CHECK" ]; then
 79:           MSG="$(head -c 400 "$TMP" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n\r' || true)"
 80:           if [ -n "$MSG" ]; then
 81:             ERR="failed_to_assume_role_exit_$${SCRIPT_RC}:$${MSG}"
 82:           else
 83:             ERR="failed_to_assume_role_exit_$${SCRIPT_RC}_no_output"
 84:           fi
 85:         fi
 86:       fi
 87:       rm -f "$TMP" 2>/dev/null || true
 88:     fi
 89: 
 90:     if [ -z "$ERR" ]; then
 91:       ARN=$(aws pinpoint-sms-voice-v2 describe-sender-ids \
 92:         --sender-ids "SenderId=$SENDER_ID,IsoCountryCode=$COUNTRY_CODE" \
 93:         --region "$REGION" \
 94:         --no-paginate \
 95:         --query 'SenderIds[0].SenderIdArn' \
 96:         --output text 2>/dev/null || true)
 97:       if [ -n "$ARN" ] && [ "$ARN" != "None" ]; then
 98:         FOUND="true"
 99:       else
100:         ARN=""
101:       fi
102:     fi
103: 
104:     jq -n \
105:       --arg arn "$ARN" \
106:       --arg found "$FOUND" \
107:       --arg error "$ERR" \
108:       '{arn:$arn,found:$found,error:$error}'
109:     exit 0
110:   EOT
111:   ]
112: 
113:   query = {
114:     sender_id    = var.sms_sender_id
115:     country_code = var.sms_sender_country_code
116:     region       = var.region
117:   }
118: }
119: 
120: # Data source to get EKS cluster OIDC provider
121: data "aws_eks_cluster" "cluster" {
122:   name = var.cluster_name
123: }
124: 
125: # IAM Role for EKS Service Account (IRSA)
126: resource "aws_iam_role" "sns_publisher" {
127:   name = local.iam_role_name
128: 
129:   lifecycle {
130:     precondition {
131:       condition = (
132:         var.sms_sender_country_code == "" ||
133:         try(data.external.sender_id_arn.result.found, "false") == "true"
134:       )
135:       error_message = <<-EOT
136:         SMS Sender ID "${var.sms_sender_id}" not found for country "${var.sms_sender_country_code}".
137:         If using cross-account access, ensure assume-github-role.sh can assume the deployment
138:         account (env vars or Secrets Manager). Request a sender ID in AWS End User Messaging
139:         (Configurations > Sender ID > Request originator), share it with Amazon SNS, and ensure
140:         sms_sender_id and sms_sender_country_code match. See docs/auxiliary/application_infra/
141:         guides/SMS_SENDER_ID_SETUP.md
142:       EOT
143:     }
144:   }
145: 
146:   assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
147:     Version = "2012-10-17"
148:     Statement = [
149:       {
150:         Effect = "Allow"
151:         Principal = {
152:           Federated = "arn:aws:iam::${data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id}:oidc-provider/${replace(data.aws_eks_cluster.cluster.identity[0].oidc[0].issuer, "https://", "")}"
153:         }
154:         Action = "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity"
155:         Condition = {
156:           StringEquals = {
157:             "${replace(data.aws_eks_cluster.cluster.identity[0].oidc[0].issuer, "https://", "")}:sub" = "system:serviceaccount:${var.service_account_namespace}:${var.service_account_name}"
158:             "${replace(data.aws_eks_cluster.cluster.identity[0].oidc[0].issuer, "https://", "")}:aud" = "sts.amazonaws.com"
159:           }
160:         }
161:       }
162:     ]
163:   })
164: 
165:   tags = var.tags
166: }
167: 
168: # IAM Policy for direct SMS publishing (sns:Publish with PhoneNumber - no topic)
169: resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "sns_publish" {
170:   name = "${local.iam_role_name}-policy"
171:   role = aws_iam_role.sns_publisher.id
172: 
173:   policy = jsonencode({
174:     Version = "2012-10-17"
175:     Statement = [
176:       {
177:         Sid    = "AllowDirectSMSPublish"
178:         Effect = "Allow"
179:         Action = [
180:           "sns:Publish"
181:         ]
182:         Resource = "*"
183:       },
184:       {
185:         Sid    = "AllowSNSCheckOptOut"
186:         Effect = "Allow"
187:         Action = [
188:           "sns:CheckIfPhoneNumberIsOptedOut",
189:           "sns:OptInPhoneNumber"
190:         ]
191:         Resource = "*"
192:       }
193:     ]
194:   })
195: }
196: 
197: # Set SMS attributes for the account (optional - for production use)
198: resource "aws_sns_sms_preferences" "sms_preferences" {
199:   count = var.configure_sms_preferences ? 1 : 0
200: 
201:   default_sender_id   = var.sms_sender_id
202:   default_sms_type    = var.sms_type
203:   monthly_spend_limit = var.sms_monthly_spend_limit
204: 
205:   # Note: delivery_status_iam_role_arn and delivery_status_success_sampling_rate
206:   # can be configured for SMS delivery status logging
207: }
```

```yaml
  1: apiVersion: apps/v1
  2: kind: StatefulSet
  3: metadata:
  4:   name: {{ template "openldap.fullname" . }}
  5:   labels:
  6:     {{- include "openldap.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
  7:     {{- with .Values.extraLabels }}
  8:     {{- toYaml . | nindent 4 }}
  9:     {{- end }}
 10: spec:
 11:   replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
 12:   selector:
 13:     matchLabels:
 14:       {{- include "openldap.selectorLabels" . | nindent 6 }}
 15:   serviceName: {{ template "openldap.fullname" . }}-headless
 16:   {{- with .Values.updateStrategy }}
 17:   updateStrategy:
 18:     {{- toYaml . | nindent 4 }}
 19:   {{- end }}
 20:   template:
 21:     metadata:
 22:       annotations:
 23:         checksum/configmap-env: {{ include (print $.Template.BasePath "/configmap-env.yaml") . | sha256sum }}
 24:         {{- if .Values.customLdifFiles }}
 25:         checksum/configmap-customldif: {{ include (print $.Template.BasePath "/configmap-customldif.yaml") . | sha256sum }}
 26:         {{- end }}
 27:       labels:
 28:         {{- include "openldap.selectorLabels" . | nindent 8 }}
 29:         {{- with .Values.podLabels }}
 30:         {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
 31:         {{- end }}
 32:     spec:
 33:       {{- include "openldap.imagePullSecrets" . | nindent 6 }}
 34:       {{- with .Values.affinity }}
 35:       affinity:
 36:         {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
 37:       {{- end }}
 38:       {{- with .Values.nodeSelector }}
 39:       nodeSelector:
 40:         {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
 41:       {{- end }}
 42:       {{- with .Values.tolerations }}
 43:       tolerations:
 44:         {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
 45:       {{- end }}
 46:       {{- if .Values.podSecurityContext.enabled }}
 47:       securityContext:
 48:         {{- omit .Values.podSecurityContext "enabled" | toYaml | nindent 8 }}
 49:       {{- end }}
 50:       {{- if .Values.priorityClassName }}
 51:       priorityClassName: {{ .Values.priorityClassName | quote }}
 52:       {{- end }}
 53:       {{- if .Values.customLdifFiles }}
 54:       initContainers:
 55:         - name: copy-custom-ldif
 56:           image: {{ .Values.customLdifInitImage | default "busybox:1.36" }}
 57:           command:
 58:             - sh
 59:             - -c
 60:             - |
 61:               cp -a /configmap-ldif/. /custom-ldif-out/ &&
 62:               chown -R 911:911 /custom-ldif-out
 63:           volumeMounts:
 64:             - name: custom-ldif-files
 65:               mountPath: /configmap-ldif
 66:               readOnly: true
 67:             - name: custom-ldif-files-writable
 68:               mountPath: /custom-ldif-out
 69:       {{- end }}
 70:       containers:
 71:         - name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
 72:           image: {{ include "openldap.image" . }}
 73:           imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy }}
 74:           {{- if .Values.customLdifFiles }}
 75:           command:
 76:             - sh
 77:             - -c
 78:             - |
 79:               cp /tmp/custom-ldif-files/* /container/service/slapd/assets/config/bootstrap/ldif/custom/ 2>/dev/null || true
 80:               exec /container/tool/run
 81:           {{- end }}
 82:           {{- if .Values.containerSecurityContext.enabled }}
 83:           securityContext:
 84:             {{- omit .Values.containerSecurityContext "enabled" | toYaml | nindent 12 }}
 85:           {{- end }}
 86:           env:
 87:             - name: POD_NAME
 88:               valueFrom:
 89:                 fieldRef:
 90:                   apiVersion: v1
 91:                   fieldPath: metadata.name
 92:             {{- with .Values.extraEnvVars }}
 93:             {{- toYaml . | nindent 12 }}
 94:             {{- end }}
 95:           envFrom:
 96:             - configMapRef:
 97:                 name: {{ template "openldap.fullname" . }}-env
 98:             - secretRef:
 99:                 name: {{ template "openldap.secretName" . }}
100:           {{- with .Values.resources }}
101:           resources:
102:             {{- toYaml . | nindent 12 }}
103:           {{- end }}
104:           ports:
105:             - name: ldap-port
106:               containerPort: 389
107:             - name: ssl-ldap-port
108:               containerPort: 636
109:           {{- if .Values.livenessProbe.enabled }}
110:           livenessProbe:
111:             tcpSocket:
112:               port: ldap-port
113:             initialDelaySeconds: {{ .Values.livenessProbe.initialDelaySeconds }}
114:             periodSeconds: {{ .Values.livenessProbe.periodSeconds }}
115:             timeoutSeconds: {{ .Values.livenessProbe.timeoutSeconds }}
116:             successThreshold: {{ .Values.livenessProbe.successThreshold }}
117:             failureThreshold: {{ .Values.livenessProbe.failureThreshold }}
118:           {{- end }}
119:           {{- if .Values.readinessProbe.enabled }}
120:           readinessProbe:
121:             tcpSocket:
122:               port: ldap-port
123:             initialDelaySeconds: {{ .Values.readinessProbe.initialDelaySeconds }}
124:             periodSeconds: {{ .Values.readinessProbe.periodSeconds }}
125:             timeoutSeconds: {{ .Values.readinessProbe.timeoutSeconds }}
126:             successThreshold: {{ .Values.readinessProbe.successThreshold }}
127:             failureThreshold: {{ .Values.readinessProbe.failureThreshold }}
128:           {{- end }}
129:           {{- if .Values.startupProbe.enabled }}
130:           startupProbe:
131:             tcpSocket:
132:               port: ldap-port
133:             initialDelaySeconds: {{ .Values.startupProbe.initialDelaySeconds }}
134:             periodSeconds: {{ .Values.startupProbe.periodSeconds }}
135:             timeoutSeconds: {{ .Values.startupProbe.timeoutSeconds }}
136:             successThreshold: {{ .Values.startupProbe.successThreshold }}
137:             failureThreshold: {{ .Values.startupProbe.failureThreshold }}
138:           {{- end }}
139:           volumeMounts:
140:             - name: data
141:               mountPath: /var/lib/ldap
142:               subPath: data
143:             - name: data
144:               mountPath: /etc/ldap/slapd.d
145:               subPath: config
146:             - name: data
147:               mountPath: /container/service/slapd/assets/certs
148:               subPath: certs
149:             {{- if .Values.customLdifFiles }}
150:             - name: custom-ldif-files-writable
151:               mountPath: /tmp/custom-ldif-files
152:               readOnly: true
153:             {{- end }}
154:             {{- with .Values.extraVolumeMounts }}
155:             {{- toYaml . | nindent 12 }}
156:             {{- end }}
157:       volumes:
158:         {{- if .Values.customLdifFiles }}
159:         - name: custom-ldif-files
160:           configMap:
161:             name: {{ template "openldap.fullname" . }}-customldif
162:         - name: custom-ldif-files-writable
163:           emptyDir: {}
164:         {{- end }}
165:         {{- with .Values.extraVolumes }}
166:         {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
167:         {{- end }}
168:   {{- if not .Values.persistence.existingClaim }}
169:   volumeClaimTemplates:
170:     - metadata:
171:         name: data
172:       spec:
173:         accessModes:
174:           {{- range .Values.persistence.accessModes }}
175:           - {{ . | quote }}
176:           {{- end }}
177:         resources:
178:           requests:
179:             storage: {{ .Values.persistence.size | quote }}
180:         {{- if .Values.persistence.storageClass }}
181:         {{- if eq "-" .Values.persistence.storageClass }}
182:         storageClassName: ""
183:         {{- else }}
184:         storageClassName: {{ .Values.persistence.storageClass | quote }}
185:         {{- end }}
186:         {{- end }}
187:   {{- else }}
188:         - name: data
189:           persistentVolumeClaim:
190:             claimName: {{ .Values.persistence.existingClaim }}
191:   {{- end }}
```

## File: application_infra/setup-application-infra.sh
```bash
  1: #!/bin/bash
  2: # Script to configure backend.hcl and variables.tfvars with user-selected region and environment
  3: # and run Terraform commands
  4: # Usage: ./setup-application-infra.sh  (from application_infra/) or ./application_infra/setup-application-infra.sh (from repo root)
  5: set -euo pipefail
  6: # Run from script directory so placeholder and Terraform files are found (works when called from repo root or application_infra)
  7: SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
  8: cd "$SCRIPT_DIR"
  9: # Clean up any existing AWS credentials from environment to prevent conflicts
 10: # This ensures the script starts with a clean slate and uses the correct credentials
 11: unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID 2>/dev/null || true
 12: unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY 2>/dev/null || true
 13: unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN 2>/dev/null || true
 14: unset AWS_PROFILE 2>/dev/null || true
 15: # Colors for output
 16: RED='\033[0;31m'
 17: GREEN='\033[0;32m'
 18: YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
 19: NC='\033[0m' # No Color
 20: # Configuration
 21: PLACEHOLDER_FILE="tfstate-backend-values-template.hcl"
 22: BACKEND_FILE="backend.hcl"
 23: VARIABLES_FILE="variables.tfvars"
 24: # Export configuration variables for use by sourced scripts
 25: export BACKEND_FILE
 26: export VARIABLES_FILE
 27: # Function to print colored messages
 28: print_error() {
 29:     echo -e "${RED}ERROR:${NC} $1" >&2
 30: }
 31: print_success() {
 32:     echo -e "${GREEN}SUCCESS:${NC} $1"
 33: }
 34: print_info() {
 35:     echo -e "${YELLOW}INFO:${NC} $1"
 36: }
 37: # Check if AWS CLI is installed
 38: if ! command -v aws &> /dev/null; then
 39:     print_error "AWS CLI is not installed."
 40:     echo "Please install it from: https://aws.amazon.com/cli/"
 41:     exit 1
 42: fi
 43: # Check if Terraform is installed
 44: if ! command -v terraform &> /dev/null; then
 45:     print_error "Terraform is not installed."
 46:     echo "Please install it from: https://www.terraform.io/downloads"
 47:     exit 1
 48: fi
 49: # Check if GitHub CLI is installed
 50: if ! command -v gh &> /dev/null; then
 51:     print_error "GitHub CLI (gh) is not installed."
 52:     echo "Please install it from: https://cli.github.com/"
 53:     exit 1
 54: fi
 55: # Check if user is authenticated with GitHub CLI
 56: if ! gh auth status &> /dev/null; then
 57:     print_error "Not authenticated with GitHub CLI."
 58:     echo "Please run: gh auth login"
 59:     exit 1
 60: fi
 61: # Check if jq is installed (required for gh --jq flag)
 62: if ! command -v jq &> /dev/null; then
 63:     print_error "jq is not installed."
 64:     echo "Please install it:"
 65:     echo "  macOS: brew install jq"
 66:     echo "  Linux: sudo apt-get install jq (or use your package manager)"
 67:     echo "  Or visit: https://stedolan.github.io/jq/download/"
 68:     exit 1
 69: fi

168: # Function to assume an AWS IAM role and export credentials

171: #   external_id: Optional external ID for cross-account role assumption

174: assume_aws_role() {

193:             --role-session-name "$role_session_name" \
194:             --external-id "$external_id" \
195:             --region "$AWS_REGION" 2>&1)
196:     else
197:         assume_role_output=$(aws sts assume-role \
198:             --role-arn "$role_arn" \
199:             --role-session-name "$role_session_name" \
200:             --region "$AWS_REGION" 2>&1)
201:     fi
202:     if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
203:         print_error "Failed to assume ${role_description}: $assume_role_output"
204:         return 1
205:     fi
206:     # Extract credentials from JSON output
207:     # Try using jq if available (more reliable), otherwise use sed/grep
208:     local access_key_id
209:     local secret_access_key
210:     local session_token
211:     if command -v jq &> /dev/null; then
212:         access_key_id=$(echo "$assume_role_output" | jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId')
213:         secret_access_key=$(echo "$assume_role_output" | jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey')
214:         session_token=$(echo "$assume_role_output" | jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken')

217:         access_key_id=$(echo "$assume_role_output" | sed -n 's/.*"AccessKeyId"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
218:         secret_access_key=$(echo "$assume_role_output" | sed -n 's/.*"SecretAccessKey"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
219:         session_token=$(echo "$assume_role_output" | sed -n 's/.*"SessionToken"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
220:     fi

222:         print_error "Failed to extract credentials from assume-role output."
223:         print_error "Output was: $assume_role_output"
224:         return 1

227:     export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$access_key_id"
228:     export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$secret_access_key"

231:     # Verify the credentials work

233:     caller_arn=$(aws sts get-caller-identity --region "$AWS_REGION" --query 'Arn' --output text 2>&1)
234:     if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
235:         print_error "Failed to verify assumed role credentials: $caller_arn"
236:         return 1
237:     fi
238:     print_info "${role_description} identity: $caller_arn"
```

```javascript
650: /**

653: class APIError extends Error {
654:     constructor(message, statusCode, data) {
655:         super(message);
656:         this.name = 'APIError';
657:         this.statusCode = statusCode;
658:         this.data = data;
659:     }
660:     /**
661:      * Check if error is due to authentication failure
662:      */
663:     isAuthError() {
664:         return this.statusCode === 401;
665:     }
666:     /**
667:      * Check if error is due to forbidden action (not enrolled, not active, etc.)
668:      */
669:     isForbidden() {
670:         return this.statusCode === 403;
671:     }
672:     /**
673:      * Check if error is due to user not being enrolled
674:      */
675:     isNotEnrolled() {
676:         return this.statusCode === 403;
677:     }
678:     /**
679:      * Check if error is a not found error
680:      */
681:     isNotFound() {
682:         return this.statusCode === 404;
683:     }
684:     /**
685:      * Check if error is a server error
686:      */
687:     isServerError() {
688:         return this.statusCode >= 500;
689:     }
690:     /**
691:      * Check if error is a validation error
692:      */
693:     isValidationError() {
694:         return this.statusCode === 400 || this.statusCode === 422;
695:     }
696: }
697: // Export for use in other modules
698: window.API = API;
699: window.APIError = APIError;
```

```python
  1: """
  2: Seed the first admin user for the 2FA application.
  3: Uses the same username and password as the LDAP admin. Creates the LDAP user
  4: (if missing), ensures they are in the admins group, and upserts the PostgreSQL
  5: profile with email/phone pre-verified and status ACTIVE.
  6: No MFA method is pre-entered. The admin selects their initial method(s) when
  7: logging in for the first time (TOTP and/or SMS). They may enroll multiple
  8: methods and choose which to use at each login.
  9: When LDAP_REPLICA_COUNT > 0, the seed job connects to each StatefulSet pod
 10: directly (using pod DNS names derived from LDAP_HOST) to ensure the admin user
 11: and directory structure exist on every replica. This is necessary because
 12: osixia/openldap multi-master replication does not reliably sync data.
 13: All sensitive values (password, email, phone, etc.) must be provided via
 14: environment variables (e.g. from a Kubernetes secret). Never log or print them.
 15: Run: python -m app.seed_admin
 16: """
 17: import asyncio
 18: import logging
 19: import os
 20: import sys
 21: from datetime import datetime, timezone
 22: import bcrypt

 24: from app.database import init_db, close_db

 32:     handlers=[logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout)],
 33: )

 35: def _hash_password(password: str) -> str:
 36:     """Hash password with bcrypt. Do not log the password."""
 37:     return bcrypt.hashpw(password.encode(), bcrypt.gensalt()).decode()
 38: def _get_seed_env() -> dict | None:
 39:     """
 40:     Read admin seed values from environment.
 41:     Returns a dict of (key -> value) or None if any required key is missing.
 42:     Never logs secret or PII values.
 43:     """
 44:     required = [
 45:         "ADMIN_SEED_USERNAME",
 46:         "ADMIN_SEED_EMAIL",
 47:         "ADMIN_SEED_FIRST_NAME",
 48:         "ADMIN_SEED_LAST_NAME",
 49:         "ADMIN_SEED_PHONE_COUNTRY_CODE",
 50:         "ADMIN_SEED_PHONE_NUMBER",
 51:         "LDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD",
 52:     ]
 53:     out = {}
 54:     for key in required:
 55:         val = os.environ.get(key)
 56:         if not val or not str(val).strip():
 57:             logger.error("Missing or empty required env: %s (do not set secrets in code)", key)
 58:             return None
 59:         out[key] = str(val).strip()
 60:     # Normalize username to lowercase to match signup behavior
 61:     out["ADMIN_SEED_USERNAME"] = out["ADMIN_SEED_USERNAME"].lower()
 62:     return out
 63: def _get_pod_hostnames() -> list[str]:
 64:     """
 65:     Derive individual StatefulSet pod hostnames from LDAP_HOST and LDAP_REPLICA_COUNT.
 66:     LDAP_HOST is the Kubernetes ClusterIP service name, e.g.:
 67:         openldap-stack-ha.ldap.svc.cluster.local
 68:     StatefulSet pod DNS names require the **headless** service and follow the pattern:
 69:         {statefulset}-{i}.{headless-service}.{namespace}.svc.cluster.local
 70:     The headless service host can be provided explicitly via LDAP_HEADLESS_HOST.
 71:     If not set, it is derived from LDAP_HOST by appending "-headless" to the
 72:     service name component (standard Helm naming convention).
 73:     Returns empty list if LDAP_REPLICA_COUNT is 0 or unset.
 74:     """
 75:     replica_count = int(os.environ.get("LDAP_REPLICA_COUNT", "0"))
 76:     if replica_count <= 0:
 77:         return []
 78:     settings = get_settings()
 79:     service_host = settings.ldap_host  # e.g. openldap-stack-ha.ldap.svc.cluster.local
 80:     # Extract service name (first component) and domain suffix
 81:     service_name = service_host.split(".", 1)[0]
 82:     domain = service_host.split(".", 1)[1]  # e.g. ldap.svc.cluster.local
 83:     # StatefulSet pods are addressed via the headless service, not the ClusterIP service.
 84:     headless_host = os.environ.get("LDAP_HEADLESS_HOST", "").strip()
 85:     if not headless_host:
 86:         # Derive from LDAP_HOST: standard Helm convention is {release}-headless
 87:         headless_host = f"{service_name}-headless.{domain}"
 88:     # Pod hostname: {service_name}-{i}.{headless_service_host}
 89:     return [f"{service_name}-{i}.{headless_host}" for i in range(replica_count)]
 90: def _create_ldap_client_for_host(host: str) -> LDAPClient:
 91:     """Create an LDAPClient targeting a specific LDAP host (e.g. a single pod)."""
 92:     settings = get_settings().model_copy(update={"ldap_host": host})
 93:     return LDAPClient(settings=settings)
 94: def _seed_ldap_on_host(
 95:     ldap: LDAPClient,

100:     email: str,
101: ) -> bool:
102:     """
103:     Ensure directory structure, create/update user, and add to admins group on a
104:     single LDAP host. Returns True on success.
105:     """
106:     host = ldap.settings.ldap_host
107:     admin_group_dn = ldap.settings.ldap_admin_group_dn
108:     # Step 1: Ensure ou=users and ou=groups exist
109:     ok, msg = ldap.ensure_directory_structure()
110:     if not ok:
111:         logger.error("[%s] Failed to ensure directory structure: %s", host, msg)
112:         return False
113:     logger.info("[%s] Directory structure OK", host)
114:     # Step 2: Create or update user
115:     ok, msg = ldap.create_or_update_user(
116:         username=username,
117:         password=password,
118:         first_name=first_name,
119:         last_name=last_name,
120:         email=email,
121:     )
122:     if not ok:
123:         logger.error("[%s] Failed to create/update LDAP user: %s", host, msg)
124:         return False
125:     logger.info("[%s] LDAP user ensured: %s (%s)", host, username, msg)
126:     # Step 3: Ensure admins and users groups exist, add user to admins
127:     users_group_dn = f"cn=users,{admin_group_dn.split(',', 1)[1]}"
128:     for group_name, group_dn, group_desc in [
129:         ("admins", admin_group_dn, "Administrator group"),
130:         ("users", users_group_dn, "Regular users group"),
131:     ]:
132:         try:
133:             groups = ldap.list_groups()
134:             if not any((g.get("dn") or "").lower() == group_dn.lower() for g in groups):
135:                 created, create_msg, _ = ldap.create_group(group_name, group_desc)
136:                 if not created and "already exists" not in (create_msg or "").lower():
137:                     logger.warning("[%s] Could not create %s group: %s", host, group_name, create_msg)
138:                 else:
139:                     logger.info("[%s] %s group ensured", host, group_name)
140:         except Exception as e:
141:             logger.warning("[%s] %s group check/add failed (non-fatal): %s", host, group_name, type(e).__name__)
142:     try:
143:         add_ok, add_msg = ldap.add_user_to_group(username, admin_group_dn)
144:         if add_ok:
145:             logger.info("[%s] User %s is in admin group", host, username)
146:         else:
147:             logger.warning("[%s] Could not add user to admin group: %s", host, add_msg)
148:     except Exception as e:
149:         logger.warning("[%s] Admin group add failed (non-fatal): %s", host, type(e).__name__)
150:     return True

179: async def _upsert_db_groups() -> bool:
180:     """Mirror admins and users groups from LDAP to PostgreSQL. Creates Group records if missing."""
181:     from sqlalchemy import select
182:     from app.database.connection import AsyncSessionLocal
183:     if AsyncSessionLocal is None:

187:     admin_group_dn = settings.ldap_admin_group_dn

189:     groups_to_sync = [
190:         ("admins", admin_group_dn, "Administrator group"),
191:         ("users", users_group_dn, "Regular users group"),
192:     ]
193:     async with AsyncSessionLocal() as session:
194:         for name, ldap_dn, description in groups_to_sync:
195:             result = await session.execute(select(Group).where(Group.ldap_dn == ldap_dn))
196:             group = result.scalar_one_or_none()
197:             if not group:
198:                 group = Group(name=name, ldap_dn=ldap_dn, description=description)
199:                 session.add(group)
200:                 logger.info("Created Group in DB: %s", name)
201:             else:
202:                 logger.debug("Group already exists in DB: %s", name)
203:         await session.commit()

206: async def _upsert_db_admin(
207:     username: str,
208:     password: str,
209:     email: str,
210:     first_name: str,

237:                 user.activated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
238:                 user.activated_by = "seed"

243:                 user.phone_number = phone_number

293:     username = env["ADMIN_SEED_USERNAME"]
294:     password = env["LDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD"]
295:     email = env["ADMIN_SEED_EMAIL"]
296:     first_name = env["ADMIN_SEED_FIRST_NAME"]
297:     last_name = env["ADMIN_SEED_LAST_NAME"]
298:     phone_country_code = env["ADMIN_SEED_PHONE_COUNTRY_CODE"]
299:     phone_number = env["ADMIN_SEED_PHONE_NUMBER"]
300:     logger.info("Seeding admin user: %s", username)
301:     try:
302:         await init_db()
303:     except Exception as e:
304:         logger.error("Database init failed: %s", type(e).__name__)
305:         return 1
306:     try:
307:         ok_ldap = await _ensure_ldap_admin_user(
308:             username=username,
309:             password=password,
310:             first_name=first_name,
311:             last_name=last_name,
312:             email=email,
313:         )
314:         if not ok_ldap:
315:             return 1
316:         ok_groups = await _upsert_db_groups()
317:         if not ok_groups:
318:             return 1
319:         ok_db = await _upsert_db_admin(
320:             username=username,
321:             password=password,
322:             email=email,
323:             first_name=first_name,
324:             last_name=last_name,
325:             phone_country_code=phone_country_code,
326:             phone_number=phone_number,
327:         )
328:         if not ok_db:
329:             return 1
330:         return 0
331:     finally:
332:         await close_db()
333: def main() -> int:
334:     return asyncio.run(run_seed())
335: if __name__ == "__main__":
336:     sys.exit(main())
```

```python
 376: def _mask_phone_number(phone: str) -> str:
 377:     """Mask phone number for display."""
 378:     if len(phone) > 4:
 379:         return "*" * (len(phone) - 4) + phone[-4:]
 380:     return phone
 381: def _mask_email(email: str) -> str:
 382:     """Mask email for display."""
 383:     if "@" not in email:
 384:         return email
 385:     local, domain = email.split("@", 1)
 386:     if len(local) > 2:
 387:         masked = local[0] + "*" * (len(local) - 2) + local[-1]
 388:     else:
 389:         masked = "*" * len(local)
 390:     return f"{masked}@{domain}"
 391: def _hash_password(password: str) -> str:
 392:     """Hash password using bcrypt."""
 393:     return bcrypt.hashpw(password.encode(), bcrypt.gensalt()).decode()
 394: def _verify_password(password: str, hashed: str) -> bool:
 395:     """Verify password against hash."""
 396:     return bcrypt.checkpw(password.encode(), hashed.encode())

 401: def _generate_verification_code(length: int = 6) -> str:
 402:     """Generate a numeric verification code."""
 403:     return "".join(secrets.choice("0123456789") for _ in range(length))

 468: async def _create_verification_token(
 469:     session: AsyncSession,
 470:     user_id: uuid.UUID,
 471:     token_type: str,
 472:     expiry_hours: int = 24,
 473:     target_value: Optional[str] = None,
 474: ) -> str:
 475:     """Create a verification token. target_value used for email/phone change flows."""
 476:     # Invalidate existing tokens of the same type
 477:     result = await session.execute(
 478:         select(VerificationToken).where(
 479:             VerificationToken.user_id == user_id,
 480:             VerificationToken.token_type == token_type,
 481:             VerificationToken.used == False,
 482:         )
 483:     )
 484:     for old_token in result.scalars():
 485:         old_token.used = True
 486:     # Create new token
 487:     if token_type in ("email", "password_reset", "eml_chg"):
 488:         token = str(uuid.uuid4())
 489:     else:
 490:         token = _generate_verification_code(6)
 491:     verification_token = VerificationToken(
 492:         user_id=user_id,
 493:         token_type=token_type,
 494:         token=token,
 495:         expires_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(hours=expiry_hours),
 496:         target_value=target_value,
 497:     )
 498:     session.add(verification_token)
 499:     await session.flush()
 500:     return token
 501: # ============================================================================
 502: # JWT Helper Functions
 503: # ============================================================================
 504: def _create_jwt_token(
 505:     user_id: str,
 506:     username: str,
 507:     is_admin: bool,
 508:     expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None,
 509: ) -> str:
 510:     """Create a JWT token for authenticated sessions."""
 511:     settings = get_settings()
 512:     if expires_delta is None:
 513:         expires_delta = timedelta(minutes=settings.jwt_expiry_minutes)
 514:     expire = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + expires_delta
 515:     payload = {
 516:         "sub": user_id,
 517:         "username": username,
 518:         "is_admin": is_admin,
 519:         "exp": expire,
 520:         "iat": datetime.now(timezone.utc),
 521:     }
 522:     return jwt.encode(payload, settings.jwt_secret_key, algorithm=settings.jwt_algorithm)
 523: def _decode_jwt_token(token: str) -> dict:
 524:     """Decode and validate a JWT token."""
 525:     settings = get_settings()
 526:     try:
 527:         payload = jwt.decode(
 528:             token,
 529:             settings.jwt_secret_key,
 530:             algorithms=[settings.jwt_algorithm]
 531:         )
 532:         return payload
 533:     except jwt.ExpiredSignatureError:
 534:         raise HTTPException(
 535:             status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
 536:             detail="Token has expired",
 537:         )
 538:     except jwt.InvalidTokenError:
 539:         raise HTTPException(
 540:             status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
 541:             detail="Invalid token",
 542:         )
 543: async def _get_current_user(
 544:     authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None),
 545:     session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session),
 546: ) -> dict:
 547:     """Get current user from JWT token."""
 548:     if not authorization or not authorization.startswith("Bearer "):
 549:         raise HTTPException(
 550:             status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
 551:             detail="Missing or invalid authorization header",
 552:         )
 553:     token = authorization.split(" ")[1]
 554:     payload = _decode_jwt_token(token)
 555:     user = await _get_user_by_username(session, payload["username"])
 556:     if not user:
 557:         raise HTTPException(
 558:             status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
 559:             detail="User not found",
 560:         )
 561:     return {
 562:         "user": user,
 563:         "user_id": payload["sub"],
 564:         "username": payload["username"],
 565:         "is_admin": payload["is_admin"],
 566:     }
 567: async def _require_admin(
 568:     authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None),
 569:     session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session),
 570: ) -> dict:
 571:     """Require admin privileges for an endpoint."""
 572:     current = await _get_current_user(authorization, session)
 573:     if not current["is_admin"]:
 574:         raise HTTPException(
 575:             status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
 576:             detail="Admin privileges required",
 577:         )
 578:     return current
 579: async def _check_app_active(session: AsyncSession) -> bool:
 580:     """Single source of truth for application active: True iff app can serve auth.
 581:     Inputs: APP_ACTIVE (config override), DB, Redis (when enabled), LDAP. There is
 582:     only one application-active mechanism; its result is used to gate auth (503)
 583:     and exposed as isActive in GET /api/app-config. User active/disabled is
 584:     separate (ProfileStatus, enforced on authenticated endpoints).
 585:     """
 586:     settings = get_settings()
 587:     if not settings.app_active:
 588:         return False
 589:     try:
 590:         await session.execute(text("SELECT 1"))
 591:     except Exception:
 592:         logger.warning("App active check: database unreachable")
 593:         return False
 594:     if settings.redis_enabled and not get_otp_client().is_connected:
 595:         logger.warning("App active check: Redis unreachable")
 596:         return False
 597:     try:
 598:         ldap_client = LDAPClient()
 599:         conn = ldap_client._get_admin_connection()
 600:         conn.unbind()
 601:     except Exception:
 602:         logger.warning("App active check: LDAP unreachable")
 603:         return False
 604:     return True
 605: async def _require_app_active(
 606:     session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session),
 607: ) -> None:
 608:     """Raise 503 if the application is disabled or dependencies are unhealthy.
 609:     Active is determined automatically by:
 610:     - APP_ACTIVE env (default true): when false, always 503.
 611:     - DB reachable: quick SELECT 1 check.
 612:     - Redis reachable when REDIS_ENABLED: required for login challenge storage.
 613:     - LDAP reachable: admin bind check (required for authentication).
 614:     No manual toggle needed: when DB, Redis or LDAP is down, auth endpoints return 503.
 615:     """
 616:     if not await _check_app_active(session):
 617:         raise HTTPException(
 618:             status_code=status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
 619:             detail="Application is currently disabled. Please try again later.",
 620:         )
 621: async def _send_admin_notification(user: User) -> None:
 622:     """Send notification email to admins about new user signup."""
 623:     try:
 624:         ldap_client = LDAPClient()
 625:         admin_emails = ldap_client.get_admin_emails()
 626:         if not admin_emails:
 627:             logger.warning("No admin emails found for notification")
 628:             return
 629:         email_client = EmailClient()
 630:         new_user_data = {
 631:             "username": user.username,
 632:             "full_name": user.full_name,
 633:             "email": user.email,
 634:             "phone": user.full_phone_number,
 635:             "signup_time": user.created_at.isoformat() if user.created_at else datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 636:         }
 637:         success, msg = email_client.send_admin_notification_email(admin_emails, new_user_data)
 638:         if success:
 639:             logger.info("Admin notification sent for new user %s", user.username)
 640:         else:
 641:             logger.error("Failed to send admin notification: %s", msg)
 642:     except Exception as e:
 643:         logger.error("Error sending admin notification: %s", e)

 656: @router.get("/app-config", response_model=AppConfigResponse)
 657: async def get_app_config(
 658:     session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session),
 659: ) -> AppConfigResponse:
 660:     """Return application-level state only (isActive, mode). User-level state (e.g.
 661:     disabled/revoked) is not here; it is enforced on authenticated endpoints (profile
 662:     status) and in the JWT/session. Frontend uses this on load to enable/disable the
 663:     login form. is_active is True only when DB, Redis and LDAP are reachable and
 664:     APP_ACTIVE is true.
 665:     """
 666:     is_active = await _check_app_active(session)
 667:     return AppConfigResponse(
 668:         is_active=is_active,
 669:         mode="full" if is_active else "limited",
 670:     )

 682: async def signup(
 683:     request: SignupRequest,
 684:     session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session),
 685: ) -> SignupResponse:
 686:     """
 687:     Register a new user account.
 688:     Creates user in PENDING state and sends verification emails/SMS.
 689:     """

 693:         raise HTTPException(
 694:             status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
 695:             detail="Username already taken",

 697:     # Check if email exists
 698:     if await _get_user_by_email(session, request.email):
 699:         raise HTTPException(
 700:             status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
 701:             detail="Email already registered",
 702:         )
 703:     # Create user (MFA method will be set during enrollment at login)
 704:     user = User(
 705:         username=request.username.lower(),
 706:         email=request.email.lower(),
 707:         first_name=request.first_name,
 708:         last_name=request.last_name,
 709:         phone_country_code=request.phone_country_code,
 710:         phone_number=request.phone_number,
 711:         password_hash=_hash_password(request.password),
 712:         mfa_method=None,  # Will be set during MFA enrollment at login
 713:         totp_secret=None,  # Will be set during MFA enrollment at login
 714:         status=ProfileStatus.PENDING.value,
 715:     )
 716:     session.add(user)
 717:     await session.flush()
 718:     email_sent = False
 719:     phone_sent = False
 720:     # Send email verification
 721:     if settings.enable_email_verification:
 722:         try:
 723:             email_token = await _create_verification_token(
 724:                 session, user.id, "email",
 725:                 settings.email_verification_expiry_hours
 726:             )
 727:             email_client = EmailClient()
 728:             success, _ = email_client.send_verification_email(
 729:                 to_email=user.email,
 730:                 token=email_token,
 731:                 username=user.username,
 732:                 first_name=user.first_name,
 733:             )
 734:             email_sent = success
 735:         except Exception as e:
 736:             logger.error("Failed to send verification email: %s", e)
 737:     # Send phone verification
 738:     try:
 739:         phone_token = await _create_verification_token(
 740:             session, user.id, "phone",
 741:             expiry_hours=1,  # Phone codes expire faster
 742:         )
 743:         sms_client = _get_sms_client()
 744:         full_phone = f"{user.phone_country_code}{user.phone_number}"
 745:         success, _, _ = sms_client.send_verification_code(full_phone, phone_token)
 746:         phone_sent = success
 747:     except Exception as e:
 748:         logger.error("Failed to send verification SMS: %s", e)
 749:     await session.commit()
 750:     # Send admin notification asynchronously (don't block response)
 751:     await _send_admin_notification(user)
 752:     logger.info("User %s signed up successfully", user.username)
 753:     return SignupResponse(
 754:         success=True,
 755:         message="Account created. Please verify your email and phone number.",
 756:         user_id=str(user.id),
 757:         email_verification_sent=email_sent,
 758:         phone_verification_sent=phone_sent,
 759:     )

 822: async def verify_phone(

 894:         return ForgotPasswordResponse(success=True, message=generic_message)

 897:         return ForgotPasswordResponse(success=True, message=generic_message)
 898:     token = await _create_verification_token(
 899:         session,
 900:         user.id,
 901:         "password_reset",
 902:         settings.password_reset_expiry_hours,
 903:     )
 904:     await session.commit()
 905:     email_client = EmailClient()
 906:     success, _ = email_client.send_password_reset_email(
 907:         to_email=user.email,
 908:         reset_token=token,
 909:         username=user.username,
 910:         first_name=user.first_name,
 911:     )
 912:     if not success:

 914:     return ForgotPasswordResponse(success=True, message=generic_message)
 915: @router.post(
 916:     "/auth/reset-password",
 917:     response_model=ResetPasswordResponse,
 918:     responses={
 919:         400: {"description": "Invalid or expired token, or validation error"},
 920:         404: {"description": "User not found"},
 921:     },
 922: )
 923: async def reset_password(
 924:     request: ResetPasswordRequest,
 925:     session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session),
 926: ) -> ResetPasswordResponse:
 927:     """Set new password using the token from the reset link."""
 928:     result = await session.execute(
 929:         select(VerificationToken).where(
 930:             VerificationToken.token_type == "password_reset",
 931:             VerificationToken.token == request.token,
 932:             VerificationToken.used == False,
 933:         )
 934:     )
 935:     reset_token = result.scalar_one_or_none()
 936:     if not reset_token:
 937:         raise HTTPException(
 938:             status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
 939:             detail="Invalid or expired reset link. Please request a new password reset.",
 940:         )
 941:     if reset_token.expires_at < datetime.now(timezone.utc):
 942:         raise HTTPException(
 943:             status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
 944:             detail="Reset link has expired. Please request a new password reset.",
 945:         )
 946:     user = await _get_user_by_id(session, reset_token.user_id)
 947:     if not user:
 948:         raise HTTPException(
 949:             status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
 950:             detail="User not found",
 951:         )
 952:     if user.username != request.username:
 953:         raise HTTPException(
 954:             status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
 955:             detail="Invalid reset link.",
 956:         )
 957:     ldap_client = LDAPClient()
 958:     if not ldap_client.user_exists(user.username):
 959:         raise HTTPException(
 960:             status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
 961:             detail="Account is not active. Please contact support.",
 962:         )
 963:     success, msg = ldap_client.change_password(user.username, request.new_password)
 964:     if not success:
 965:         raise HTTPException(
 966:             status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
 967:             detail="Failed to update password. Please try again or request a new link.",
 968:         )
 969:     reset_token.used = True
 970:     user.password_hash = _hash_password(request.new_password)
 971:     await session.commit()
 972:     logger.info("Password reset completed for user %s", user.username)
 973:     return ResetPasswordResponse(
 974:         success=True,
 975:         message="Your password has been reset. You can now log in with your new password.",
 976:     )

1114: # ============================================================================
1115: # MFA Enrollment (for re-enrollment)
1116: # ============================================================================
1117: @router.post(
1118:     "/auth/enroll",
1119:     response_model=EnrollResponse,
1120:     responses={
1121:         400: {"description": "Bad request"},
1122:         401: {"description": "Invalid credentials"},
1123:         403: {"description": "User not active"},
1124:     },
1125: )
1126: async def enroll(
1127:     request: EnrollRequest,
1128:     session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session),
1129: ) -> EnrollResponse:
1130:     """
1131:     Enroll or re-enroll for MFA (for active users only). Adds a method to
1132:     user_mfa_methods (or updates existing row for that method).
1133:     """
1134:     settings = get_settings()
1135:     user = await _get_user_with_mfa(session, request.username)
1136:     if not user:
1137:         raise HTTPException(
1138:             status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
1139:             detail="User not found",
1140:         )
1141:     # Verify password
1142:     if not _verify_password(request.password, user.password_hash):
1143:         raise HTTPException(
1144:             status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
1145:             detail="Invalid password",
1146:         )
1147:     # Only active users can re-enroll
1148:     if user.status != ProfileStatus.ACTIVE.value:
1149:         raise HTTPException(
1150:             status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
1151:             detail="Only active users can update MFA enrollment",
1152:         )
1153:     # Validate SMS is enabled
1154:     if request.mfa_method == MFAMethod.SMS and not settings.enable_sms_2fa:
1155:         raise HTTPException(
1156:             status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
1157:             detail="SMS 2FA is not enabled",
1158:         )
1159:     if request.mfa_method == MFAMethod.TOTP:
1160:         totp_manager = TOTPManager()
1161:         secret = totp_manager.generate_secret()
1162:         otpauth_uri = totp_manager.generate_otpauth_uri(
1163:             secret=secret,
1164:             username=user.username,
1165:         )
1166:         # Add or update TOTP row in user_mfa_methods
1167:         existing_totp = next(
1168:             (m for m in user.mfa_methods if m.method == "totp"),
1169:             None,
1170:         )
1171:         if existing_totp:
1172:             existing_totp.totp_secret = secret
1173:         else:
1174:             session.add(
1175:                 UserMFAMethod(
1176:                     user_id=user.id,
1177:                     method="totp",
1178:                     totp_secret=secret,
1179:                 )
1180:             )
1181:         await session.commit()
1182:         logger.info("User %s enrolled for TOTP MFA", user.username)
1183:         return EnrollResponse(
1184:             success=True,
1185:             message="MFA enrollment updated. Scan the QR code.",
1186:             mfa_method=MFAMethod.TOTP,
1187:             otpauth_uri=otpauth_uri,
1188:             secret=secret,
1189:         )
1190:     else:
1191:         # SMS enrollment
1192:         if not request.phone_number:
1193:             phone = user.full_phone_number
1194:         else:
1195:             phone = request.phone_number
1196:         sms_client = _get_sms_client()
1197:         is_valid, error = sms_client.validate_phone_number(phone)
1198:         if not is_valid:
1199:             raise HTTPException(
1200:                 status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
1201:                 detail=error,
1202:             )
1203:         phone_cc, phone_num = user.phone_country_code, user.phone_number
1204:         if request.phone_number and request.phone_number.startswith("+"):
1205:             match = re.match(r"^(\+\d{1,4})(\d+)$", request.phone_number)
1206:             if match:
1207:                 phone_cc, phone_num = match.group(1), match.group(2)
1208:         existing_sms = next(
1209:             (m for m in user.mfa_methods if m.method == "sms"),
1210:             None,
1211:         )
1212:         if existing_sms:
1213:             existing_sms.phone_country_code = phone_cc
1214:             existing_sms.phone_number = phone_num
1215:         else:
1216:             session.add(
1217:                 UserMFAMethod(
1218:                     user_id=user.id,
1219:                     method="sms",
1220:                     phone_country_code=phone_cc,
1221:                     phone_number=phone_num,
1222:                 )
1223:             )
1224:         await session.commit()
1225:         logger.info("User %s enrolled for SMS MFA", user.username)
1226:         return EnrollResponse(
1227:             success=True,
1228:             message="MFA enrollment updated for SMS.",
1229:             mfa_method=MFAMethod.SMS,
1230:             phone_number=user.masked_phone,
1231:         )
```
