```python
1233: # Login (two-step: start -> MFA -> verify)
1234: # ============================================================================
1235: @router.post(
1236:     "/auth/login/start",
1237:     response_model=LoginStartResponse,
1238:     responses={
1239:         401: {"description": "Invalid credentials"},
1240:         403: {"description": "Profile incomplete or not activated"},
1241:         503: {"description": "Application disabled or storage unavailable"},
1242:     },
1243: )
1244: async def login_start(
1245:     request: LoginStartRequest,
1246:     session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session),
1247:     _: None = Depends(_require_app_active),
1248: ) -> LoginStartResponse:
1249:     """
1250:     Step 1: Validate username and password. Returns a challenge token and which
1251:     MFA methods are available (user may have multiple; they choose one per login).
1252:     """
1253:     user = await _get_user_with_mfa(session, request.username)
1254:     if not user:
1255:         raise HTTPException(
1256:             status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
1257:             detail="User not found. Please sign up first.",
1258:         )
1259:     if user.status == ProfileStatus.PENDING.value:
1260:         missing = []
1261:         if not user.email_verified:
1262:             missing.append("email")
1263:         if not user.phone_verified:
1264:             missing.append("phone")
1265:         raise HTTPException(
1266:             status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
1267:             detail=f"Profile incomplete. Please verify your: {', '.join(missing)}",
1268:         )
1269:     if user.status == ProfileStatus.COMPLETE.value:
1270:         raise HTTPException(
1271:             status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
1272:             detail="Your profile is awaiting admin approval. Please wait for activation.",
1273:         )
1274:     ldap_client = LDAPClient()
1275:     auth_success, auth_message = ldap_client.authenticate(

1355: @router.post(
1356:     "/auth/login/verify",
1357:     response_model=LoginResponse,
1358:     responses={
1359:         401: {"description": "Invalid or expired challenge or verification code"},
1360:         503: {"description": "Application disabled or storage unavailable"},
1361:     },
1362: )
1363: async def login_verify(
1364:     request: LoginVerifyRequest,
1365:     session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session),
1366:     _: None = Depends(_require_app_active),
1367: ) -> LoginResponse:
1368:     """
1369:     Step 2: Verify MFA code and return JWT. Consumes the challenge token.
1370:     """
1371:     challenge = get_login_challenge(request.challenge_token)
1372:     if not challenge:
1373:         raise HTTPException(
1374:             status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
1375:             detail="Invalid or expired login session. Please log in again.",
1376:         )
1377:     user = await _get_user_by_id_with_mfa(session, uuid.UUID(challenge["user_id"]))
1378:     if not user:
1379:         raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="User not found.")
1380:     username = user.username
1381:     totp_secret = _user_totp_secret(user)
1382:     if request.mfa_method == MFAMethod.TOTP:
1383:         if not totp_secret:
1384:             raise HTTPException(
1385:                 status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
1386:                 detail="Authenticator app not set up. Please complete setup first.",
1387:             )
1388:         totp_manager = TOTPManager()
1389:         if not totp_manager.verify_totp(totp_secret, request.verification_code):
1390:             logger.warning("Login verify failed for %s: Invalid TOTP", username)
1391:             raise HTTPException(
1392:                 status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
1393:                 detail="Invalid verification code",
1394:             )
1395:     elif request.mfa_method == MFAMethod.SMS:
1396:         otp_client = get_otp_client()
1397:         if not otp_client.is_connected:
1398:             raise HTTPException(
1399:                 status_code=status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
1400:                 detail="Storage unavailable. Please try again.",
1401:             )
1402:         sms_code_data = otp_client.get_code(username)
1403:         if not sms_code_data:
1404:             raise HTTPException(
1405:                 status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
1406:                 detail="No verification code sent. Please request a code first.",
1407:             )
1408:         if not hmac.compare_digest(request.verification_code, sms_code_data["code"]):
1409:             logger.warning("Login verify failed for %s: Invalid SMS code", username)
1410:             raise HTTPException(
1411:                 status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
1412:                 detail="Invalid verification code",
1413:             )
1414:         otp_client.delete_code(username)
1415:         # Enroll SMS if not yet enrolled (first-time SMS login)
1416:         if not _user_has_sms(user):
1417:             session.add(
1418:                 UserMFAMethod(
1419:                     user_id=user.id,
1420:                     method="sms",
1421:                     phone_country_code=user.phone_country_code,
1422:                     phone_number=user.phone_number,
1423:                 )
1424:             )
1425:             await session.commit()
1426:     else:
1427:         raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail="Invalid mfa_method")
1428:     remember_me = challenge.get("remember_me", False)
1429:     delete_login_challenge(request.challenge_token)
1430:     ldap_client = LDAPClient()
1431:     is_admin = ldap_client.is_admin(username)
1432:     settings = get_settings()
1433:     expires_delta = None
1434:     if remember_me:
1435:         expires_delta = timedelta(days=settings.jwt_refresh_expiry_days)
1436:     token = _create_jwt_token(
1437:         user_id=str(user.id),
1438:         username=username,
1439:         is_admin=is_admin,
1440:         expires_delta=expires_delta,
1441:     )
1442:     logger.info("User %s logged in successfully", username)
1443:     return LoginResponse(
1444:         success=True,
1445:         message="Login successful",
1446:         is_admin=is_admin,
1447:         token=token,
1448:         username=username,
1449:     )

1453: @router.post(
1454:     "/auth/login",
1455:     response_model=LoginResponse,
1456:     responses={
1457:         401: {"description": "Invalid credentials"},
1458:         403: {"description": "Profile incomplete or not activated"},
1459:         503: {"description": "Application disabled or storage unavailable"},
1460:     },
1461: )
1462: async def login(
1463:     request: LoginRequest,
1464:     session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session),
1465:     _: None = Depends(_require_app_active),
1466: ) -> LoginResponse:
1467:     """
1468:     Authenticate user with username, password, and verification code (legacy one-step).
1469:     """
1470:     user = await _get_user_with_mfa(session, request.username)
1471:     # Check if user exists
1472:     if not user:
1473:         raise HTTPException(
1474:             status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
1475:             detail="User not found. Please sign up first.",
1476:         )
1477:     # Check profile status
1478:     if user.status == ProfileStatus.PENDING.value:
1479:         missing = []
1480:         if not user.email_verified:
1481:             missing.append("email")
1482:         if not user.phone_verified:
1483:             missing.append("phone")
1484:         raise HTTPException(
1485:             status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
1486:             detail=f"Profile incomplete. Please verify your: {', '.join(missing)}",
1487:         )
1488:     if user.status == ProfileStatus.COMPLETE.value:
1489:         raise HTTPException(
1490:             status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
1491:             detail="Your profile is awaiting admin approval. Please wait for activation.",
1492:         )
1493:     # Only ACTIVE users can login - verify against LDAP
1494:     ldap_client = LDAPClient()
1495:     auth_success, auth_message = ldap_client.authenticate(
1496:         request.username, request.password
1497:     )
1498:     if not auth_success:
1499:         logger.warning("Login failed for %s: %s", request.username, auth_message)
1500:         raise HTTPException(
1501:             status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
1502:             detail="Invalid username or password",
1503:         )
1504:     # Verify MFA code (legacy one-step: try TOTP first if enrolled, else SMS)
1505:     totp_secret = _user_totp_secret(user)
1506:     if _user_has_totp(user):
1507:         if not totp_secret:
1508:             raise HTTPException(
1509:                 status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
1510:                 detail="TOTP not configured",
1511:             )
1512:         totp_manager = TOTPManager()
1513:         if not totp_manager.verify_totp(totp_secret, request.verification_code):
1514:             logger.warning("Login failed for %s: Invalid TOTP", request.username)
1515:             raise HTTPException(
1516:                 status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
1517:                 detail="Invalid verification code",
1518:             )
1519:     elif _user_has_sms(user):
1520:         # Verify SMS code (Redis only)
1521:         otp_client = get_otp_client()
1522:         if not otp_client.is_connected:
1523:             raise HTTPException(
1524:                 status_code=status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
1525:                 detail="Storage unavailable. Please try again.",
1526:             )
1527:         sms_code_data = otp_client.get_code(request.username)
1528:         if not sms_code_data:
1529:             raise HTTPException(
1530:                 status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
1531:                 detail="No verification code sent. Please request a code first.",
1532:             )
1533:         if not hmac.compare_digest(
1534:             request.verification_code, sms_code_data["code"]
1535:         ):
1536:             logger.warning(
1537:                 f"Login failed for {request.username}: Invalid SMS code"
1538:             )
1539:             raise HTTPException(
1540:                 status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
1541:                 detail="Invalid verification code",
1542:             )
1543:         otp_client.delete_code(request.username)
1544:     else:
1545:         raise HTTPException(
1546:             status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
1547:             detail="No MFA method enrolled. Please complete enrollment.",
1548:         )
1549:     # Check if user is admin
1550:     is_admin = ldap_client.is_admin(request.username)
1551:     # Generate JWT token
1552:     token = _create_jwt_token(
1553:         user_id=str(user.id),
1554:         username=user.username,
1555:         is_admin=is_admin,
1556:     )
1557:     logger.info("User %s logged in successfully", request.username)
1558:     return LoginResponse(
1559:         success=True,
1560:         message="Login successful",
1561:         is_admin=is_admin,
1562:         token=token,
1563:         username=user.username,
1564:     )
1565: @router.post(
1566:     "/auth/sms/send-code",
1567:     response_model=SMSSendCodeResponse,
1568:     responses={
1569:         401: {"description": "Invalid credentials"},
1570:         403: {"description": "User not enrolled for SMS or no phone"},
1571:         400: {"description": "Provide either challenge_token or username+password"},
1572:     },
1573: )
1574: async def send_sms_code(
1575:     request: SMSSendCodeRequest,
1576:     session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session),
1577: ) -> SMSSendCodeResponse:
1578:     """Send SMS verification code for login. Use challenge_token (after login/start) or username+password."""
1579:     settings = get_settings()
1580:     if not settings.enable_sms_2fa:
1581:         raise HTTPException(
1582:             status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
1583:             detail="SMS 2FA is not enabled",
1584:         )
1585:     if request.challenge_token:
1586:         challenge = get_login_challenge(request.challenge_token)
1587:         if not challenge:
1588:             raise HTTPException(
1589:                 status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
1590:                 detail="Invalid or expired login session. Please log in again.",
1591:             )
1592:         user = await _get_user_by_id_with_mfa(session, uuid.UUID(challenge["user_id"]))
1593:         if not user:
1594:             raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="User not found")
1595:         if not (user.phone_verified and user.phone_country_code and user.phone_number):
1596:             raise HTTPException(
1597:                 status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
1598:                 detail="Phone must be verified to use SMS.",
1599:             )
1600:         # User already passed step 1; can enroll or use SMS when phone is verified
1601:     elif request.username and request.password:
1602:         user = await _get_user_with_mfa(session, request.username)
1603:         if not user:
1604:             raise HTTPException(
1605:                 status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
1606:                 detail="User not found",
1607:             )
1608:         if user.status == ProfileStatus.ACTIVE.value:
1609:             ldap_client = LDAPClient()
1610:             auth_success, _ = ldap_client.authenticate(request.username, request.password)
1611:             if not auth_success:
1612:                 raise HTTPException(
1613:                     status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
1614:                     detail="Invalid username or password",
1615:                 )
1616:         else:
1617:             if not _verify_password(request.password, user.password_hash):
1618:                 raise HTTPException(
1619:                     status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
1620:                     detail="Invalid username or password",
1621:                 )
1622:         if not _user_has_sms(user):
1623:             raise HTTPException(
1624:                 status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
1625:                 detail="User not enrolled for SMS MFA",
1626:             )
1627:     else:
1628:         raise HTTPException(
1629:             status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
1630:             detail="Provide either challenge_token or username and password.",
1631:         )
1632:     # Generate and send code
1633:     sms_client = _get_sms_client()
1634:     code = _generate_verification_code(settings.sms_code_length)
1635:     success, message, message_id = sms_client.send_verification_code(
1636:         user.full_phone_number, code
1637:     )
1638:     if not success:
1639:         raise HTTPException(
1640:             status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
1641:             detail=f"Failed to send SMS: {message}",
1642:         )
1643:     # Store code for verification (Redis only)
1644:     otp_client = get_otp_client()
1645:     if not otp_client.is_connected:
1646:         raise HTTPException(
1647:             status_code=status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
1648:             detail="Storage unavailable. Please try again.",
1649:         )
1650:     stored = otp_client.store_code(
1651:         username=user.username,
1652:         code=code,
1653:         phone_number=user.full_phone_number,
1654:         ttl_seconds=settings.sms_code_expiry_seconds,
1655:     )
1656:     if not stored:
1657:         logger.error("Failed to store OTP code for %s", user.username)
1658:         raise HTTPException(
1659:             status_code=status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
1660:             detail="Failed to store verification code. Please try again.",
1661:         )
1662:     logger.info(
1663:         "SMS code sent to user %s (MessageId: %s)",
1664:         user.username,
1665:         message_id or "(none)",
1666:     )
1667:     return SMSSendCodeResponse(
1668:         success=True,
1669:         message="Verification code sent",
1670:         phone_number=user.masked_phone,
1671:         expires_in_seconds=settings.sms_code_expiry_seconds,
1672:     )

1749:     session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session),

1751:     """Activate a user (create in LDAP)."""
1752:     # Use JWT authentication if token provided, otherwise fall back to legacy admin credentials
1753:     current = None

1775:         ldap_client = LDAPClient()

1778:         )

1783:             )

1785:             raise HTTPException(

1797:         )
1798:     result = await session.execute(select(User).where(User.id == user_uuid))
1799:     user = result.scalar_one_or_none()
1800:     if not user:
1801:         raise HTTPException(
1802:             status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
1803:             detail="User not found",
1804:         )
1805:     if user.status != ProfileStatus.COMPLETE.value:
1806:         raise HTTPException(

1808:             detail=f"User cannot be activated. Current status: {user.status}",
1809:         )
1810:     # Group assignment is required for activation

1816:     # Create user in LDAP

1819:     # For now, we'll generate a temporary password and require the user to reset it

1821:     success, message = ldap_client.create_user(
1822:         username=user.username,

1897: async def admin_reject_user(
1898:     user_id: str,
1899:     request: Optional[AdminRejectRequest] = None,
1900:     authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None),
1901:     session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session),
1902: ) -> AdminActivateResponse:
1903:     """Reject and delete a user (supports JWT and legacy auth)."""
1904:     # Use JWT authentication if token provided, otherwise fall back to legacy admin credentials
1905:     admin_username = None
1906:     if authorization and authorization.startswith("Bearer "):
1907:         try:
1908:             current = await _get_current_user(authorization, session)
1909:             if not current["is_admin"]:
1910:                 raise HTTPException(
1911:                     status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
1912:                     detail="Admin privileges required",
1913:                 )
1914:             admin_username = current["username"]
1915:         except HTTPException as e:
1916:             if not request or not request.admin_username or not request.admin_password:
1917:                 raise e
1918:     # Fall back to legacy admin credentials if JWT not provided or failed
1919:     if not admin_username:
1920:         if not request or not request.admin_username or not request.admin_password:
1921:             raise HTTPException(
1922:                 status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
1923:                 detail="Authentication required. Provide JWT token or admin credentials.",
1924:             )
1925:         ldap_client = LDAPClient()
1926:         auth_success, _ = ldap_client.authenticate(
1927:             request.admin_username, request.admin_password
1928:         )
1929:         if not auth_success:
1930:             raise HTTPException(
1931:                 status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
1932:                 detail="Invalid admin credentials",
1933:             )
1934:         if not ldap_client.is_admin(request.admin_username):
1935:             raise HTTPException(
1936:                 status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
1937:                 detail="Admin privileges required",
1938:             )
1939:         admin_username = request.admin_username
1940:     # Get user
1941:     try:
1942:         user_uuid = uuid.UUID(user_id)
1943:     except ValueError:
1944:         raise HTTPException(
1945:             status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
1946:             detail="Invalid user ID format",
1947:         )
1948:     result = await session.execute(select(User).where(User.id == user_uuid))
1949:     user = result.scalar_one_or_none()
1950:     if not user:
1951:         raise HTTPException(
1952:             status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
1953:             detail="User not found",
1954:         )
1955:     username = user.username
1956:     await session.delete(user)
1957:     await session.commit()
1958:     logger.info("User %s rejected/deleted by %s", username, admin_username)
1959:     return AdminActivateResponse(
1960:         success=True,
1961:         message=f"User {username} has been rejected and removed.",
1962:     )

2012:         email_client = EmailClient()

2015:             token=email_token,
2016:             username=user.username,
2017:             first_name=user.first_name,
2018:         )
2019:         await session.commit()
2020:         if not success:
2021:             raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, detail=msg)

2023:         raise
2024:     except Exception as e:

2026:         raise HTTPException(

2492:                 method="sms",

2494:                 phone_number=user.phone_number,
2495:             )
2496:         )
2497:         await session.commit()
2498:         logger.info("User %s added SMS from profile", user.username)

2887: async def admin_assign_user_groups(
2888:     user_id: str,
2889:     request: UserGroupAssignRequest,
2890:     authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None),
2891:     session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session),
2892: ) -> UserGroupResponse:
2893:     """Assign user to groups (admin only). Adds to existing assignments."""
2894:     current = await _require_admin(authorization, session)
2895:     try:
2896:         user_uuid = uuid.UUID(user_id)
2897:     except ValueError:
2898:         raise HTTPException(
2899:             status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
2900:             detail="Invalid user ID format",
2901:         )
2902:     result = await session.execute(select(User).where(User.id == user_uuid))
2903:     user = result.scalar_one_or_none()
2904:     if not user:
2905:         raise HTTPException(
2906:             status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
2907:             detail="User not found",
2908:         )
2909:     ldap_client = LDAPClient()
2910:     for group_id in request.group_ids:
2911:         try:
2912:             group_uuid = uuid.UUID(group_id)
2913:         except ValueError:
2914:             continue
2915:         # Get group
2916:         result = await session.execute(select(Group).where(Group.id == group_uuid))
2917:         group = result.scalar_one_or_none()
2918:         if not group:
2919:             continue
2920:         # Check if already assigned
2921:         result = await session.execute(
2922:             select(UserGroup).where(
2923:                 UserGroup.user_id == user_uuid,
2924:                 UserGroup.group_id == group_uuid,
2925:             )
2926:         )
2927:         if result.scalar_one_or_none():
2928:             continue
2929:         # Add to LDAP group (only for active users)
2930:         if user.status == ProfileStatus.ACTIVE.value:
2931:             success, msg = ldap_client.add_user_to_group(user.username, group.ldap_dn)
2932:             if not success:

3131:     )

3156: async def admin_revoke_user(
3157:     user_id: str,
3158:     authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None),
3159:     session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session),
3160: ) -> AdminActivateResponse:
3161:     """
3162:     Revoke an active user.
3163:     - Removes user from all LDAP groups
3164:     - Deletes user from LDAP
3165:     - Updates status to REVOKED
3166:     """
3167:     current = await _require_admin(authorization, session)
3168:     try:
3169:         user_uuid = uuid.UUID(user_id)

3197:             )

3200:     # Delete from LDAP

3216: # Enhanced Admin User List with Sorting/Filtering/Search
3217: # ============================================================================
3218: @router.get(
3219:     "/admin/users/enhanced",
3220:     response_model=AdminUserListResponse,
3221:     responses={401: {"description": "Not authenticated"}, 403: {"description": "Not admin"}},
3222: )
3223: async def admin_list_users_enhanced(
3224:     status_filter: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by status"),
3225:     group_filter: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by group ID"),
3226:     search: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search term"),
3227:     sort_by: Optional[str] = Query("created_at", description="Sort field"),
3228:     sort_order: Optional[str] = Query("desc", description="Sort order"),
3229:     authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None),
3230:     session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session),
3231: ) -> AdminUserListResponse:
3232:     """List users with sorting, filtering, and search (admin only)."""
3233:     await _require_admin(authorization, session)
3234:     query = select(User).options(
3235:         selectinload(User.mfa_methods),
3236:         selectinload(User.user_groups).selectinload(UserGroup.group),
3237:     )
3238:     # Apply status filter
3239:     if status_filter:
3240:         query = query.where(User.status == status_filter)
3241:     # Apply search
3242:     if search:
3243:         search_term = f"%{search}%"
3244:         query = query.where(
3245:             or_(
3246:                 User.username.ilike(search_term),
3247:                 User.email.ilike(search_term),
3248:                 User.first_name.ilike(search_term),
3249:                 User.last_name.ilike(search_term),
3250:             )
3251:         )
3252:     # Apply sorting
3253:     if sort_by == "username":
3254:         order_col = User.username
3255:     elif sort_by == "email":
3256:         order_col = User.email
3257:     elif sort_by == "first_name":
3258:         order_col = User.first_name
3259:     elif sort_by == "status":
3260:         order_col = User.status
3261:     else:
3262:         order_col = User.created_at
3263:     if sort_order == "asc":
3264:         query = query.order_by(order_col.asc())
3265:     else:
3266:         query = query.order_by(order_col.desc())
3267:     result = await session.execute(query)
3268:     users = result.scalars().all()
3269:     # Filter by group if specified
3270:     if group_filter:
3271:         try:
3272:             group_uuid = uuid.UUID(group_filter)
3273:             users = [
3274:                 u for u in users
3275:                 if any(ug.group_id == group_uuid for ug in u.user_groups)
3276:             ]
3277:         except ValueError:
3278:             pass
3279:     user_list = [
3280:         {
3281:             "id": str(u.id),
3282:             "username": u.username,
3283:             "email": u.email,
3284:             "first_name": u.first_name,
3285:             "last_name": u.last_name,
3286:             "phone": u.full_phone_number,
3287:             "status": u.status,
3288:             "email_verified": u.email_verified,
3289:             "phone_verified": u.phone_verified,
3290:             "mfa_method": ", ".join(m.upper() for m in _user_mfa_methods_summary(u)) or (u.mfa_method or ""),
3291:             "created_at": u.created_at.isoformat() if u.created_at else "",
3292:             "activated_at": u.activated_at.isoformat() if u.activated_at else None,
3293:             "activated_by": u.activated_by,
3294:             "groups": [
3295:                 {"id": str(ug.group_id), "name": ug.group.name if ug.group else ""}
3296:                 for ug in u.user_groups
3297:             ],
3298:         }
3299:         for u in users
3300:     ]
3301:     return AdminUserListResponse(users=user_list, total=len(user_list))
```

```yaml
  1: # Replica count (use 1 for first deploy, then 3 for HA)
  2: replicaCount: ${openldap_replica_count}
  3: # Image from ECR
  4: image:
  5:   registry: "${ecr_registry}"
  6:   repository: "${ecr_repository}"
  7:   tag: "${openldap_image_tag}"
  8:   pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  9: # LDAP domain and organization
 10: ldapDomain: "${openldap_ldap_domain}"
 11: ldapOrganisation: "${openldap_ldap_domain}"
 12: # Use Terraform-managed Kubernetes secret for passwords
 13: existingSecret: "${openldap_secret_name}"
 14: # TLS configuration (osixia auto-generates self-signed certs)
 15: tls:
 16:   enabled: true
 17:   enforce: false
 18:   verifyClient: "never"
 19:   certFilename: "ldap.crt"
 20:   keyFilename: "ldap.key"
 21:   caFilename: "ca.crt"
 22: # osixia native multi-master replication
 23: replication:
 24:   enabled: true
 25:   clusterName: "cluster.local"
 26: # Resources aligned with OpenLDAP/LMDB guidance (Symas sizing, OpenLDAP tuning).
 27: # Requests and limits match for predictable scheduling (no bursting).
 28: resources:
 29:   requests:
 30:     memory: "1Gi"
 31:     cpu: "1"
 32:   limits:
 33:     memory: "1Gi"
 34:     cpu: "1"
 35: # Allow up to 10 min for first replica to start (cold node, image pull, PVC attach)
 36: startupProbe:
 37:   enabled: true
 38:   initialDelaySeconds: 0
 39:   periodSeconds: 10
 40:   timeoutSeconds: 1
 41:   successThreshold: 1
 42:   failureThreshold: 60

 44: customLdifInitImage: "${ecr_registry}/${ecr_repository}:${busybox_image_tag}"
 45: # Pass ldapDomain and existingSecret to subcharts via global
 46: global:

 49: # Persistence
 50: persistence:
 51:   enabled: true

 61: # Custom LDIF files to initialize directory structure on all pods.

 78:     objectClass: groupOfUniqueNames
 79:     objectClass: top
 80:     cn: admins

 82:     uniqueMember: cn=admin,${openldap_base_dn}
 83:     # Create users group (groupOfUniqueNames)

 85:     dn: cn=users,ou=groups,${openldap_base_dn}
 86:     objectClass: groupOfUniqueNames
 87:     objectClass: top
 88:     cn: users
 89:     description: Regular users group
 90:     uniqueMember: cn=admin,${openldap_base_dn}
 91: ltb-passwd:
 92:   enabled: true

100:   env:

102:       value: "allow"

105:     ingressClassName: "${ingress_class_name}"

110:       alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect: "443"
111:       alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-policy: "${alb_ssl_policy}"
```

```hcl
  1: locals {
  2:   argocd_role_name       = "${var.prefix}-${var.region}-${var.argocd_role_name_component}-${var.env}"
  3:   argocd_capability_name = "${var.prefix}-${var.region}-${var.argocd_capability_name_component}-${var.env}"
  4: 
  5:   tags = {
  6:     Env       = "${var.env}"
  7:     Terraform = "true"
  8:   }
  9: }
 10: 
 11: # IAM Trust Policy for ArgoCD Capability Role
 12: data "aws_iam_policy_document" "argocd_assume_role" {
 13:   statement {
 14:     effect = "Allow"
 15: 
 16:     principals {
 17:       type        = "Service"
 18:       identifiers = ["capabilities.eks.amazonaws.com"]
 19:     }
 20: 
 21:     actions = [
 22:       "sts:AssumeRole",
 23:       "sts:TagSession",
 24:     ]
 25:   }
 26: }
 27: 
 28: # IAM Role for ArgoCD Capability
 29: resource "aws_iam_role" "argocd_capability" {
 30:   name = local.argocd_role_name
 31: 
 32:   assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.argocd_assume_role.json
 33: 
 34:   tags = merge(
 35:     local.tags,
 36:     {
 37:       Name = local.argocd_role_name
 38:     }
 39:   )
 40: 
 41:   # Force replacement if trust policy changes to ensure AWS validates correctly
 42:   lifecycle {
 43:     create_before_destroy = true
 44:   }
 45: }
 46: 
 47: # IAM Policy Document for ArgoCD Capability
 48: # Single inline policy with all required permissions: EKS, Secrets Manager, KMS,
 49: # CodeConnections (incl. UseConnection), and optional ECR/CodeCommit when enabled.
 50: data "aws_iam_policy_document" "argocd_capability" {
 51:   statement {
 52:     sid    = "EKSDescribe"
 53:     effect = "Allow"
 54:     actions = [
 55:       "eks:DescribeCluster",
 56:       "eks:ListClusters",
 57:       "eks:DescribeUpdate",
 58:       "eks:ListUpdates"
 59:     ]
 60:     resources = var.iam_policy_eks_resources
 61:   }
 62: 
 63:   statement {
 64:     sid    = "SecretsManager"
 65:     effect = "Allow"
 66:     actions = [
 67:       "secretsmanager:GetSecretValue",
 68:       "secretsmanager:DescribeSecret",
 69:       "secretsmanager:ListSecrets"
 70:     ]
 71:     resources = var.iam_policy_secrets_manager_resources
 72:   }
 73: 
 74:   statement {
 75:     sid    = "KMSDecrypt"
 76:     effect = "Allow"
 77:     actions = [
 78:       "kms:Decrypt",
 79:       "kms:DescribeKey"
 80:     ]
 81:     resources = var.iam_policy_kms_key_arns
 82:   }
 83: 
 84:   statement {
 85:     sid    = "CodeConnections"
 86:     effect = "Allow"
 87:     actions = [
 88:       "codeconnections:UseConnection",
 89:       "codeconnections:GetConnection",
 90:       "codeconnections:ListConnections"
 91:     ]
 92:     resources = var.iam_policy_code_connections_resources
 93:   }
 94: 
 95:   dynamic "statement" {
 96:     for_each = var.enable_ecr_access ? [1] : []
 97:     content {
 98:       sid    = "ECRAccess"
 99:       effect = "Allow"
100:       actions = [
101:         "ecr:GetAuthorizationToken",
102:         "ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability",
103:         "ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer",
104:         "ecr:BatchGetImage"
105:       ]
106:       resources = var.iam_policy_ecr_resources
107:     }
108:   }
109: 
110:   dynamic "statement" {
111:     for_each = var.enable_codecommit_access ? [1] : []
112:     content {
113:       sid    = "CodeCommitAccess"
114:       effect = "Allow"
115:       actions = [
116:         "codecommit:GitPull",
117:         "codecommit:GetRepository"
118:       ]
119:       resources = var.iam_policy_codecommit_resources
120:     }
121:   }
122: }
123: 
124: # Attach IAM Policy to Role
125: resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "argocd_capability" {
126:   name   = "${local.argocd_role_name}-policy"
127:   role   = aws_iam_role.argocd_capability.id
128:   policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.argocd_capability.json
129: }
130: 
131: # Create ArgoCD namespace
132: # The namespace must exist before the EKS Capability can deploy into it
133: # and before the cluster registration secret can be created
134: resource "kubernetes_namespace_v1" "argocd" {
135:   metadata {
136:     name = var.argocd_namespace
137:     labels = {
138:       "app.kubernetes.io/name"       = "argocd"
139:       "app.kubernetes.io/instance"   = local.argocd_capability_name
140:       "app.kubernetes.io/managed-by" = "terraform"
141:       "eks.capability"               = "argocd"
142:     }
143:   }
144: 
145:   lifecycle {
146:     # Prevent deletion of namespace if it contains resources
147:     prevent_destroy = false
148:   }
149: }
150: 
151: # Wait for IAM role to propagate before creating EKS capability
152: resource "time_sleep" "wait_for_iam_and_ns_propagation" {
153:   depends_on = [
154:     aws_iam_role.argocd_capability,
155:     aws_iam_role_policy.argocd_capability,
156:     kubernetes_namespace_v1.argocd,
157:   ]
158: 
159:   create_duration = var.wait_iam_propagation_duration
160: }
161: 
162: # EKS Capability for ArgoCD
163: resource "aws_eks_capability" "argocd" {
164:   cluster_name    = var.cluster_name
165:   capability_name = local.argocd_capability_name
166:   type            = "ARGOCD"
167: 
168:   role_arn                  = aws_iam_role.argocd_capability.arn
169:   delete_propagation_policy = var.delete_propagation_policy
170: 
171:   configuration {
172:     argo_cd {
173:       namespace = var.argocd_namespace
174: 
175:       aws_idc {
176:         idc_instance_arn = var.idc_instance_arn
177:         idc_region       = var.idc_region
178:       }
179: 
180:       dynamic "rbac_role_mapping" {
181:         for_each = var.rbac_role_mappings
182:         content {
183:           role = rbac_role_mapping.value.role
184: 
185:           dynamic "identity" {
186:             for_each = rbac_role_mapping.value.identities
187:             content {
188:               id   = identity.value.id
189:               type = identity.value.type
190:             }
191:           }
192:         }
193:       }
194: 
195:       dynamic "network_access" {
196:         for_each = length(var.argocd_vpce_ids) > 0 ? [1] : []
197:         content {
198:           vpce_ids = var.argocd_vpce_ids
199:         }
200:       }
201:     }
202:   }
203: 
204:   tags = merge(
205:     local.tags,
206:     {
207:       Name                 = local.argocd_capability_name
208:       "eks:cluster"        = var.cluster_name
209:       "eks:capabilityType" = "ARGOCD"
210:     }
211:   )
212: 
213:   # Create ClusterRole and IAM-role ClusterRoleBinding before the capability so
214:   # the role has RBAC in place as soon as the capability starts. Only resources
215:   # that require the capability (access entry, SAs) are created after.
216:   depends_on = [
217:     time_sleep.wait_for_iam_and_ns_propagation,
218:     kubernetes_manifest.argocd_application_controller_clusterrole,
219:     kubernetes_manifest.argocd_application_controller_iam_role_binding,
220:   ]
221: }
222: 
223: # Wait for ArgoCD capability to be fully deployed (ACTIVE) and for the auto-created
224: # access entry and ArgoCD SAs to propagate before creating ClusterRoleBinding and
225: # associating the access policy (single sleep, default 330s).
226: resource "time_sleep" "wait_for_argocd" {
227:   create_duration = var.wait_capability_ready_duration
228: 
229:   depends_on = [aws_eks_capability.argocd]
230: }
231: 
232: # External data source to query ArgoCD capability details via AWS CLI
233: # This automatically retrieves server_url and status without manual CLI commands
234: # Uses assume-github-role.sh to assume the correct deployment account role based on var.env
235: # In GitHub Actions, uses already-configured deployment account credentials
236: data "external" "argocd_capability" {
237:   program = ["bash", "-c", <<-EOT
238:     set -u -o pipefail
239:     export AWS_PAGER=""
240: 
241:     # Always return strings
242:     SERVER_URL=""
243:     STATUS=""
244:     ERR=""
245: 
246:     # Map env -> account type
247:     ENV_LOWER="$(echo "${var.env}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
248:     if [ "$ENV_LOWER" = "prod" ]; then
249:       ACCOUNT_TYPE="prod"
250:     else
251:       ACCOUNT_TYPE="dev"
252:     fi
253: 
254:     # Ensure jq exists
255:     if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
256:       ERR="jq_not_found"
257:     fi
258: 
259:     # Assume role using assume-github-role.sh script
260:     # The script automatically detects GitHub Actions environment and uses
261:     # DEPLOYMENT_ROLE_ARN/EXTERNAL_ID from environment variables, or falls back
262:     # to AWS Secrets Manager for local environments
263:     if [ -z "$ERR" ]; then
264:       SCRIPT_PATH="${path.root}/../scripts/assume-github-role.sh"
265:       if [ ! -x "$SCRIPT_PATH" ]; then
266:         SCRIPT_PATH="../scripts/assume-github-role.sh"
267:       fi
268: 
269:       if [ ! -x "$SCRIPT_PATH" ]; then
270:         ERR="assume_script_not_found"
271:       else
272:         TMP="$(mktemp 2>/dev/null || echo "/tmp/argocd_assume_$$")"
273:         # Temporarily disable exit on error to capture script output
274:         set +e
275:         # Source the script and capture all output
276:         # The script will set SCRIPT_ERROR and SCRIPT_ERROR_MSG if it fails in silent mode
277:         source "$SCRIPT_PATH" "$ACCOUNT_TYPE" >"$TMP" 2>&1
278:         SCRIPT_RC=$?
279:         set -e
280: 
281:         # Check for script error flag (set in silent mode)
282:         # Use env command to check variables without Terraform interpolation issues
283:         SCRIPT_ERROR_CHECK=$(env | grep '^SCRIPT_ERROR=' || echo "")
284:         if [ -n "$SCRIPT_ERROR_CHECK" ] && echo "$SCRIPT_ERROR_CHECK" | grep -q 'SCRIPT_ERROR=true'; then
285:           # Get error message from environment
286:           SCRIPT_ERROR_MSG_CHECK=$(env | grep '^SCRIPT_ERROR_MSG=' || echo "")
287:           MSG=$(echo "$SCRIPT_ERROR_MSG_CHECK" | sed 's/^SCRIPT_ERROR_MSG=//' || echo "")
288:           if [ -z "$MSG" ]; then
289:             MSG="$(head -c 400 "$TMP" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n\r' || true)"
290:           fi
291:           ERR="failed_to_assume_role:$${MSG}"
292:         else
293:           # Check if credentials were set (script succeeded)
294:           # Use env to check credentials without Terraform interpolation issues
295:           AWS_AKID_CHECK=$(env | grep '^AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=' || echo "")
296:           AWS_SAK_CHECK=$(env | grep '^AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=' || echo "")
297:           AWS_ST_CHECK=$(env | grep '^AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=' || echo "")
298:           if [ -z "$AWS_AKID_CHECK" ] || [ -z "$AWS_SAK_CHECK" ] || [ -z "$AWS_ST_CHECK" ]; then
299:             # Script didn't set credentials - check for error message
300:             MSG="$(head -c 400 "$TMP" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n\r' || true)"
301:             if [ -n "$MSG" ]; then
302:               ERR="failed_to_assume_role_exit_$${SCRIPT_RC}:$${MSG}"
303:             else
304:               ERR="failed_to_assume_role_exit_$${SCRIPT_RC}_no_output"
305:             fi
306:           fi
307:         fi
308:         rm -f "$TMP" 2>/dev/null || true
309:       fi
310:     fi
311: 
312:     # Query capability (default null/missing to empty string)
313:     if [ -z "$ERR" ]; then
314:       TMP="$(mktemp 2>/dev/null || echo "/tmp/argocd_describe_$$")"
315:       RESULT="$(aws eks describe-capability \
316:         --cluster-name "${var.cluster_name}" \
317:         --capability-name "${local.argocd_capability_name}" \
318:         --region "${var.region}" \
319:         --output json \
320:         --query 'capability.{server_url:(configuration.argoCd.serverUrl || `""`),status:(status || `""`)}' \
321:         2>"$TMP")"
322:       RC=$?
323: 
324:       if [ $RC -ne 0 ]; then
325:         MSG="$(head -c 400 "$TMP" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n\r' || true)"
326:         ERR="describe_failed:$${MSG}"
327:       else
328:         SERVER_URL="$(echo "$RESULT" | jq -r '.server_url // ""' 2>/dev/null || echo "")"
329:         STATUS="$(echo "$RESULT" | jq -r '.status // ""' 2>/dev/null || echo "")"
330:       fi
331: 
332:       rm -f "$TMP" 2>/dev/null || true
333:     fi
334: 
335:     # Emit ONLY JSON (string values). Never fail Terraform.
336:     jq -n \
337:       --arg server_url "$SERVER_URL" \
338:       --arg status "$STATUS" \
339:       --arg error "$ERR" \
340:       '{server_url:$server_url,status:$status,error:$error}'
341: 
342:     exit 0
343:   EOT
344:   ]
345: 
346:   query      = { wait_for = aws_eks_capability.argocd.arn }
347:   depends_on = [time_sleep.wait_for_argocd]
348: }
349: 
350: # ClusterRole for ArgoCD application-controller
351: # Based on official ArgoCD manifests: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-cd/blob/master/manifests/cluster-rbac/application-controller/argocd-application-controller-clusterrole.yaml
352: # ArgoCD needs full CRUD permissions (create, update, patch, delete, get, list, watch) on all resources
353: # to properly sync applications from Git to the cluster and remove resources when applications are deleted
354: #
355: # Created before the EKS capability so that all roles and IAM-role bindings exist first; the capability
356: # then starts with permissions already in place. Only the service-account ClusterRoleBinding must wait
357: # for the capability (because the SAs are created by the capability).
358: resource "kubernetes_manifest" "argocd_application_controller_clusterrole" {
359:   manifest = {
360:     apiVersion = "rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1"
361:     kind       = "ClusterRole"
362:     metadata = {
363:       name = "${local.argocd_capability_name}-application-controller"
364:       labels = {
365:         "app.kubernetes.io/name"       = "argocd"
366:         "app.kubernetes.io/instance"   = local.argocd_capability_name
367:         "app.kubernetes.io/managed-by" = "terraform"
368:       }
369:     }
370:     rules = [
371:       # Full permissions on all resources across all API groups
372:       # This matches the official ArgoCD application-controller ClusterRole
373:       # ArgoCD needs these permissions to:
374:       # - Create resources when syncing applications
375:       # - Update resources when Git state changes
376:       # - Delete resources when applications are removed or resources are deleted from Git
377:       # - Manage resources across all namespaces
378:       # - Handle custom resources (CRDs) defined in Git repositories
379:       {
380:         apiGroups = ["*"]
381:         resources = ["*"]
382:         verbs     = ["*"]
383:       },
384:       # Non-resource URLs (for cluster-level operations)
385:       {
386:         nonResourceURLs = ["*"]
387:         verbs           = ["*"]
388:       }
389:     ]
390:   }
391: 
392:   depends_on = [time_sleep.wait_for_iam_and_ns_propagation]
393: }
394: 
395: # ClusterRoleBinding to grant ArgoCD service accounts permission to sync application resources
396: # Binds all ArgoCD service accounts to the application-controller ClusterRole
397: # AWS EKS ArgoCD Capability typically creates: argocd-application-controller, argocd-repo-server, argocd-server, argocd-redis
398: resource "kubernetes_manifest" "argocd_application_controller_clusterrolebinding" {
399:   manifest = {
400:     apiVersion = "rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1"
401:     kind       = "ClusterRoleBinding"
402:     metadata = {
403:       name = "${local.argocd_capability_name}-application-controller"
404:       labels = {
405:         "app.kubernetes.io/name"       = "argocd"
406:         "app.kubernetes.io/instance"   = local.argocd_capability_name
407:         "app.kubernetes.io/managed-by" = "terraform"
408:       }
409:     }
410:     roleRef = {
411:       apiGroup = "rbac.authorization.k8s.io"
412:       kind     = "ClusterRole"
413:       name     = "${local.argocd_capability_name}-application-controller"
414:     }
415:     subjects = [
416:       {
417:         kind      = "ServiceAccount"
418:         namespace = var.argocd_namespace
419:         name      = "argocd-application-controller"
420:       },
421:       {
422:         kind      = "ServiceAccount"
423:         namespace = var.argocd_namespace
424:         name      = "argocd-repo-server"
425:       },
426:       {
427:         kind      = "ServiceAccount"
428:         namespace = var.argocd_namespace
429:         name      = "argocd-server"
430:       },
431:       {
432:         kind      = "ServiceAccount"
433:         namespace = var.argocd_namespace
434:         name      = "argocd-redis"
435:       }
436:     ]
437:   }
438: 
439:   depends_on = [
440:     time_sleep.wait_for_argocd,
441:     kubernetes_manifest.argocd_application_controller_clusterrole
442:   ]
443: }
444: 
445: # Associate access policy with the automatically-created EKS Access Entry
446: # AWS EKS automatically creates an access entry for the ArgoCD Capability IAM role when the capability is created.
447: # We don't need to manage the access entry itself - we just need to associate additional access policies with it.
448: # This grants the ArgoCD Capability IAM role full cluster admin permissions (in addition to the ArgoCD-specific policies
449: # that are automatically associated), which is required for ArgoCD to sync applications and manage resources
450: # across all namespaces, including cluster-scoped resources like runtimeclasses.node.k8s.io
451: #
452: # IMPORTANT: Must depend on time_sleep.wait_for_argocd so the capability's
453: # auto-created access entry exists before we associate the policy (avoids AccessDenied).
454: resource "aws_eks_access_policy_association" "argocd_capability_cluster_admin" {
455:   cluster_name  = var.cluster_name
456:   principal_arn = aws_iam_role.argocd_capability.arn
457:   policy_arn    = "arn:aws:eks::aws:cluster-access-policy/AmazonEKSClusterAdminPolicy"
458: 
459:   access_scope {
460:     type = "cluster"
461:   }
462: 
463:   depends_on = [time_sleep.wait_for_argocd]
464: }
465: 
466: # ClusterRoleBinding for IAM role-based authentication (kept for backward compatibility)
467: # Note: EKS Access Entry with access policy is the preferred method for IAM role-based RBAC
468: # This ClusterRoleBinding may still be needed for some edge cases.
469: # Created before the capability so the IAM role has the ClusterRole as soon as the capability starts.
470: resource "kubernetes_manifest" "argocd_application_controller_iam_role_binding" {
471:   manifest = {
472:     apiVersion = "rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1"
473:     kind       = "ClusterRoleBinding"
474:     metadata = {
475:       name = "${local.argocd_capability_name}-application-controller-iam"
476:       labels = {
477:         "app.kubernetes.io/name"       = "argocd"
478:         "app.kubernetes.io/instance"   = local.argocd_capability_name
479:         "app.kubernetes.io/managed-by" = "terraform"
480:       }
481:     }
482:     roleRef = {
483:       apiGroup = "rbac.authorization.k8s.io"
484:       kind     = "ClusterRole"
485:       name     = "${local.argocd_capability_name}-application-controller"
486:     }
487:     subjects = [
488:       {
489:         kind = "User"
490:         name = aws_iam_role.argocd_capability.arn
491:       }
492:     ]
493:   }
494: 
495:   depends_on = [kubernetes_manifest.argocd_application_controller_clusterrole]
496: }
497: 
498: # EKS Cluster Data Source
499: data "aws_eks_cluster" "this" {
500:   name = var.cluster_name
501: }
502: 
503: # Cluster Registration Secret
504: resource "kubernetes_secret" "argocd_local_cluster" {
505:   metadata {
506:     name      = var.local_cluster_secret_name
507:     namespace = var.argocd_namespace
508:     labels = {
509:       "argocd.argoproj.io/secret-type" = "cluster"
510:     }
511:   }
512: 
513:   data = {
514:     name    = var.local_cluster_secret_name
515:     server  = data.aws_eks_cluster.this.arn
516:     project = var.argocd_project_name
517:   }
518: 
519:   type = "Opaque"
520: 
521:   depends_on = [time_sleep.wait_for_argocd]
522: }
```

## File: application_infra/modules/openldap/main.tf
```hcl
  1: # First resource in the module: wait for cluster readiness (ALB/StorageClass/ArgoCD
  2: # are guaranteed by root module depends_on) before creating any OpenLDAP resources.
  3: resource "time_sleep" "pre_deploy" {
  4:   create_duration = "3m"
  5: }
  6: 
  7: locals {
  8:   # Determine values template path
  9:   values_template_path = var.values_template_path != null ? var.values_template_path : "${path.module}/../../helm/openldap-values.tpl.yaml"
 10: 
 11:   # Compute base DN from domain if not provided
 12:   # e.g., "ldap.talorlik.internal" -> "dc=ldap,dc=talorlik,dc=internal"
 13:   computed_base_dn = var.openldap_base_dn != null ? var.openldap_base_dn : join(",", [
 14:     for part in split(".", var.openldap_ldap_domain) : "dc=${part}"
 15:   ])
 16: 
 17:   openldap_values = templatefile(
 18:     local.values_template_path,
 19:     {
 20:       storage_class_name   = var.storage_class_name
 21:       openldap_ldap_domain = var.openldap_ldap_domain
 22:       openldap_base_dn     = local.computed_base_dn
 23:       openldap_secret_name = var.openldap_secret_name
 24:       app_name             = var.app_name
 25:       # ECR image configuration
 26:       ecr_registry           = var.ecr_registry
 27:       ecr_repository         = var.ecr_repository
 28:       openldap_image_tag     = var.openldap_image_tag
 29:       phpldapadmin_image_tag = var.phpldapadmin_image_tag
 30:       ltb_passwd_image_tag   = var.ltb_passwd_image_tag
 31:       busybox_image_tag      = var.busybox_image_tag
 32:       openldap_replica_count = var.replica_count
 33:       # ALB configuration - IngressClassParams handles scheme and ipAddressType
 34:       ingress_class_name     = var.use_alb && var.ingress_class_name != null ? var.ingress_class_name : "alb"
 35:       alb_load_balancer_name = var.alb_load_balancer_name
 36:       phpldapadmin_host      = var.phpldapadmin_host
 37:       ltb_passwd_host        = var.ltb_passwd_host
 38:       alb_target_type        = var.alb_target_type
 39:       alb_ssl_policy         = var.alb_ssl_policy
 40:     }
 41:   )
 42: }
 43: 
 44: # Create namespace for OpenLDAP (after pre_deploy delay)
 45: resource "kubernetes_namespace" "openldap" {
 46:   metadata {
 47:     name = var.namespace
 48: 
 49:     labels = {
 50:       name        = var.namespace
 51:       environment = var.env
 52:       managed-by  = "terraform"
 53:     }
 54:   }
 55: 
 56:   lifecycle {
 57:     # Ignore changes to labels that might be modified by ArgoCD, Helm, or other controllers
 58:     ignore_changes = [
 59:       metadata[0].labels,
 60:       metadata[0].annotations,
 61:     ]
 62:   }
 63: 
 64:   depends_on = [time_sleep.pre_deploy]
 65: }
 66: 
 67: # Create Kubernetes secret for OpenLDAP passwords
 68: # Passwords are sourced from GitHub Secrets via TF_VAR_openldap_admin_password and TF_VAR_openldap_config_password
 69: resource "kubernetes_secret" "openldap_passwords" {
 70:   metadata {
 71:     name      = var.openldap_secret_name
 72:     namespace = kubernetes_namespace.openldap.metadata[0].name
 73: 
 74:     labels = {
 75:       app         = "openldap"
 76:       environment = var.env
 77:       managed-by  = "terraform"
 78:     }
 79:   }
 80: 
 81:   data = {
 82:     "LDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD"  = var.openldap_admin_password
 83:     "LDAP_CONFIG_PASSWORD" = var.openldap_config_password
 84:   }
 85: 
 86:   type = "Opaque"
 87: 
 88:   lifecycle {
 89:     # Ignore changes to labels/annotations that might be modified by ArgoCD, Helm, or other controllers
 90:     # This prevents Terraform from trying to recreate the secret if it's modified externally
 91:     ignore_changes = [
 92:       metadata[0].labels,
 93:       metadata[0].annotations,
 94:     ]
 95:     # Create before destroy to avoid downtime if secret needs to be recreated
 96:     create_before_destroy = true
 97:   }
 98: 
 99:   depends_on = [kubernetes_namespace.openldap]
100: }

102: # Helm release for OpenLDAP Stack HA (vendored chart for osixia/openldap)
103: resource "helm_release" "openldap" {
104:   name  = var.helm_release_name
105:   chart = "${path.module}/../../charts/openldap-stack-ha"
106:

108:   create_namespace = false

110:   atomic          = var.helm_atomic
111:   cleanup_on_fail = var.helm_atomic
112:   recreate_pods   = true
113:   force_update    = true
114:   wait            = true

117:   timeout         = var.helm_timeout

120:   values = [local.openldap_values]

122:   depends_on = [
123:     kubernetes_namespace.openldap,
124:     kubernetes_secret.openldap_passwords,
125:   ]
126: }

128: # Create Network Policies for secure internal cluster communication
129: # Generic policies: Any service can communicate with any service, but only on secure ports
130: module "network_policies" {
131:   source = "../network-policies"
132: 
133:   count = var.enable_network_policies ? 1 : 0
134: 
135:   namespace = var.namespace
136: 
137:   depends_on = [helm_release.openldap]
138: }
139: 
140: # Get Ingress resources created by Helm chart to extract ALB DNS names
141: data "kubernetes_ingress_v1" "phpldapadmin" {
142:   metadata {
143:     name      = "${var.helm_release_name}-phpldapadmin"
144:     namespace = var.namespace
145:   }
```

```hcl
272: ##################### Backend namespace and LDAP admin secret
273: # Backend pod expects secret "ldap-admin-secret" with key LDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD in its namespace.
274: # We create the namespace so Terraform owns it; we create the secret when openldap_admin_password is set.
275: # IMPORTANT: The password is read from the OpenLDAP secret in the ldap namespace to ensure consistency.
276: # This prevents password mismatches between OpenLDAP deployment and backend application.
277: resource "kubernetes_namespace" "backend_app" {
278:   count = var.enable_argocd_apps && var.argocd_app_backend_path != null ? 1 : 0
279: 
280:   metadata {
281:     name = var.argocd_app_backend_namespace
282:     labels = {
283:       "app.kubernetes.io/managed-by" = "terraform"
284:     }
285:   }
286: }
287: 
288: # Read OpenLDAP admin password from the OpenLDAP secret in ldap namespace
289: # This ensures the backend uses the same password as OpenLDAP was initialized with
290: #
291: # IMPORTANT: Cross-namespace secret reading works because:
292: # 1. Terraform Kubernetes provider uses the Kubernetes API (not pod-to-pod communication)
293: # 2. Network policies only affect pod-to-pod traffic, not API calls
294: # 3. The provider authenticates via EKS cluster auth (exec plugin with get-eks-token.sh)
295: #    which typically grants cluster-admin permissions, allowing secret reads from any namespace
296: #
297: # If the secret doesn't exist or cannot be read, we fall back to var.openldap_admin_password
298: # This fallback is useful during initial deployment when OpenLDAP may not be deployed yet
299: # When using openldap_secret_name: deploy application_infra (OpenLDAP) before application
300: # to avoid apply failure (data source will error if the secret does not exist yet).
301: data "kubernetes_secret" "openldap_admin" {
302:   count = var.enable_argocd_apps && var.argocd_app_backend_path != null && var.openldap_secret_name != "" && var.openldap_namespace != "" ? 1 : 0
303: 
304:   metadata {
305:     name      = var.openldap_secret_name
306:     namespace = var.openldap_namespace
307:   }
308: }
309: 
310: locals {
311:   # Use password from OpenLDAP secret if available, otherwise fall back to variable
312:   # This ensures consistency: if OpenLDAP secret exists and was successfully read, use it; otherwise use provided variable
313:   #
314:   # Behavior:
315:   # - If openldap_secret_name is empty: Uses var.openldap_admin_password (data source not created)
316:   # - If data source is created but secret doesn't exist: Terraform will error (enforces deployment order)
317:   # - If data source succeeds: Uses password from secret (ensures consistency)
318:   # - If data source count is 0: Falls back to var.openldap_admin_password
319:   #
320:   # This approach ensures that once OpenLDAP is deployed, the backend always uses the same password,
321:   # preventing password mismatches like the one that caused the admin-seed-job to fail.
322:   #
323:   # SECURITY NOTE: This local value contains a sensitive password. It is:
324:   # - Derived from var.openldap_admin_password (marked sensitive = true) OR from a Kubernetes secret
325:   # - Only used internally in kubernetes_secret resource (never exposed in outputs)
326:   # - Terraform will mask it in plan/apply logs when derived from sensitive variable
327:   # - Never output or logged - only used to create the Kubernetes secret resource
328:   # - The kubernetes_secret resource handles the data securely (base64 encoding, encrypted at rest in etcd)
329:   #
330:   # Note: The kubernetes_secret data source's `data` attribute returns decoded (plain text) values,
331:   # not base64-encoded. We use nonsensitive() to unwrap the sensitive value so it can be used
332:   # in the kubernetes_secret resource. The resulting password is still secure because it's only
333:   # used internally in the kubernetes_secret resource and never exposed in outputs.
334:   ldap_admin_password = length(data.kubernetes_secret.openldap_admin) > 0 && try(data.kubernetes_secret.openldap_admin[0].data["LDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD"], null) != null ? (
335:     nonsensitive(data.kubernetes_secret.openldap_admin[0].data["LDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD"])
336:   ) : var.openldap_admin_password
337: }
338: 
339: resource "kubernetes_secret" "ldap_admin" {
340:   count = var.enable_argocd_apps && var.argocd_app_backend_path != null && local.ldap_admin_password != "" ? 1 : 0
341: 
342:   metadata {
343:     name      = "ldap-admin-secret"
344:     namespace = kubernetes_namespace.backend_app[0].metadata[0].name
345:     labels = {
346:       "app.kubernetes.io/name"       = "ldap-2fa-backend"
347:       "app.kubernetes.io/managed-by" = "terraform"
348:     }
349:   }
350: 
351:   data = {
352:     "LDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD" = local.ldap_admin_password
353:   }
354: 
355:   type = "Opaque"
356: 
357:   depends_on = [
358:     kubernetes_namespace.backend_app,
359:     data.kubernetes_secret.openldap_admin,
360:   ]
361: }

416: ##################### First admin user seed (optional)
417: # When all admin_seed_* variables are set, create a secret and a one-time Job that
418: # seeds the first admin user (same username/password as LDAP admin) with email/phone
419: # pre-verified. Values must be set via TF_VAR_admin_seed_* (e.g. from GitHub Secrets);
420: # never hard-code in tfvars.
421: # admin_seed_enabled also requires local.ldap_admin_password != "" so the job is only
422: # created when ldap-admin-secret exists (avoids referencing kubernetes_secret.ldap_admin[0]
423: # when count = 0, e.g. when OpenLDAP secret exists but has empty LDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD).
424: locals {
425:   admin_seed_enabled = var.enable_argocd_apps && var.argocd_app_backend_path != null && var.enable_postgresql && local.ldap_admin_password != "" && var.openldap_admin_password != "" && var.admin_seed_username != "" && var.admin_seed_email != "" && var.admin_seed_first_name != "" && var.admin_seed_last_name != "" && var.admin_seed_phone_country_code != "" && var.admin_seed_phone_number != ""
426: }

434:     labels = {
435:       "app.kubernetes.io/name"       = "ldap-2fa-backend"
436:       "app.kubernetes.io/managed-by" = "terraform"
437:     }
438:   }
439: 
440:   data = {
441:     "ADMIN_SEED_USERNAME"           = var.admin_seed_username
442:     "ADMIN_SEED_EMAIL"              = var.admin_seed_email
443:     "ADMIN_SEED_FIRST_NAME"         = var.admin_seed_first_name
444:     "ADMIN_SEED_LAST_NAME"          = var.admin_seed_last_name
445:     "ADMIN_SEED_PHONE_COUNTRY_CODE" = var.admin_seed_phone_country_code
446:     "ADMIN_SEED_PHONE_NUMBER"       = var.admin_seed_phone_number
447:   }
448: 
449:   type = "Opaque"
450: 
451:   depends_on = [kubernetes_namespace.backend_app]

454: resource "kubernetes_job" "admin_seed" {
455:   count = local.admin_seed_enabled ? 1 : 0
456: 
457:   # Do not block Terraform apply on job completion. The job runs asynchronously and
458:   # retries (backoff_limit = 10) until DB/LDAP are ready; in CI the apply would
459:   # otherwise time out or fail if the seed takes longer than the provider timeout.
460:   wait_for_completion = false
461: 
462:   # Ensure backend_image_tag is set before creating the job
463:   lifecycle {
464:     precondition {
465:       condition     = var.backend_image_tag != ""
466:       error_message = "backend_image_tag must be set for admin-seed-job. Run 'Backend Build and Push' workflow first, or set TF_VAR_backend_image_tag to the tag from backend/helm/ldap-2fa-backend/values.yaml (e.g., 'ldap-2fa-backend-<sha>-<run_id>')."
467:     }
468:   }
469: 
470:   metadata {
471:     name      = "admin-seed-job"
472:     namespace = kubernetes_namespace.backend_app[0].metadata[0].name
473:     labels = {
474:       "app.kubernetes.io/name"       = "ldap-2fa-backend"
475:       "app.kubernetes.io/managed-by" = "terraform"
476:     }
477:   }
478: 
479:   spec {
480:     ttl_seconds_after_finished = 86400 # Keep for 24h for debugging; then cleanup
481:     backoff_limit              = 10    # Retry until DB/LDAP are ready
482: 
483:     template {
484:       metadata {
485:         labels = {
486:           "app.kubernetes.io/name" = "admin-seed"
487:         }
488:       }
489:       spec {
490:         restart_policy = "OnFailure"
491:         container {
492:           name    = "seed"
493:           image   = "${local.ecr_registry}/${local.ecr_repository}:${var.backend_image_tag}"
494:           command = ["python", "-m", "app.seed_admin"]
495:           env_from {
496:             secret_ref {
497:               name = kubernetes_secret.admin_seed[0].metadata[0].name
498:             }
499:           }
500:           env_from {
501:             secret_ref {
502:               name = kubernetes_secret.ldap_admin[0].metadata[0].name
503:             }
504:           }
505:           env {
506:             name  = "DATABASE_HOST"
507:             value = "postgresql.${var.postgresql_namespace}.svc.cluster.local"
508:           }
509:           env {
510:             name  = "DATABASE_PORT"
511:             value = "5432"
512:           }
513:           env {
514:             name  = "DATABASE_USER"
515:             value = var.postgresql_database_username
516:           }
517:           env {
518:             name  = "DATABASE_NAME"
519:             value = var.postgresql_database_name
520:           }
521:           env {
522:             name = "DATABASE_PASSWORD"
523:             value_from {
524:               secret_key_ref {
525:                 name = kubernetes_secret.postgresql_secret_backend_namespace[0].metadata[0].name
526:                 key  = "password"
527:               }
528:             }
529:           }
530:           env {
531:             name  = "LDAP_HOST"
532:             value = local.ldap_host
533:           }
534:           env {
535:             name  = "LDAP_PORT"
536:             value = "389"
537:           }
538:           env {
539:             name  = "LDAP_BASE_DN"
540:             value = local.ldap_base_dn
541:           }
542:           env {
543:             name  = "LDAP_ADMIN_DN"
544:             value = local.ldap_admin_dn
545:           }
546:           env {
547:             name  = "LDAP_ADMIN_GROUP_DN"
548:             value = local.ldap_admin_group_dn
549:           }
550:           env {
551:             name  = "LDAP_USER_SEARCH_BASE"
552:             value = local.ldap_user_search_base
553:           }
554:           env {
555:             name  = "LDAP_GROUP_SEARCH_BASE"
556:             value = local.ldap_group_search_base
557:           }
558:           # Must match OpenLDAP StatefulSet replica count (application_infra helm replicaCount, default 3)
559:           # so seed_admin.py can target each pod for multi-master replication seeding.
560:           env {
561:             name  = "LDAP_REPLICA_COUNT"
562:             value = tostring(var.ldap_replica_count)
563:           }
564:           # Headless service host for StatefulSet pod DNS addressing.
565:           # Pod DNS: {pod}-{i}.{headless-svc}.{ns}.svc.cluster.local
566:           env {
567:             name  = "LDAP_HEADLESS_HOST"
568:             value = local.ldap_headless_host
569:           }
570:         }
571:       }
572:     }
573:   }
574: 
575:   depends_on = [
576:     kubernetes_secret.admin_seed,
577:     kubernetes_secret.ldap_admin,
578:     kubernetes_secret.postgresql_secret_backend_namespace,
579:   ]
580: }
```

```javascript
  95:     /**
  96:      * Fetch app config from backend (isActive, mode). On failure assume active so
  97:      * backend can return 503 if really down.
  98:      */
  99:     async fetchAppConfig() {
 100:         try {
 101:             this.appConfig = await API.getAppConfig();
 102:         } catch (_) {
 103:             this.appConfig = { isActive: true, mode: 'full' };
 104:         }
 105:     },
 106:     /**
 107:      * Apply app config to UI: show banner and disable login/signup when isActive false.
 108:      */
 109:     applyAppConfigUI() {
 110:         const banner = document.getElementById('app-config-banner');
 111:         const loginSubmit = document.querySelector('#login-form button[type="submit"]');
 112:         const signupSubmit = document.querySelector('#signup-form button[type="submit"]');
 113:         const active = this.appConfig && (this.appConfig.isActive ?? this.appConfig.is_active) !== false;
 114:         if (banner) {
 115:             if (active) {
 116:                 banner.classList.add('hidden');
 117:             } else {
 118:                 banner.classList.remove('hidden');
 119:             }
 120:         }
 121:         if (loginSubmit) {
 122:             loginSubmit.disabled = !active;
 123:         }
 124:         if (signupSubmit) {
 125:             signupSubmit.disabled = !active;
 126:         }
 127:     },
 128:     /**
 129:      * Restore logged-in state from persisted JWT. Token is in localStorage (API.tokenKey);
 130:      * we decode payload to get username/is_admin and set App.session, then show app view.
 131:      * Expired tokens are cleared. User-level disabled/revoked is enforced by the backend
 132:      * (401/403 on subsequent API calls).
 133:      */
 134:     checkSession() {
 135:         const token = API.getToken();
 136:         if (token) {
 137:             try {
 138:                 // Decode JWT payload (without verification)
 139:                 const payload = JSON.parse(atob(token.split('.')[1]));
 140:                 // Check if token is expired
 141:                 if (payload.exp * 1000 < Date.now()) {
 142:                     API.clearToken();
 143:                     return;
 144:                 }
 145:                 // Restore session
 146:                 this.session = {
 147:                     username: payload.username,
 148:                     isAdmin: payload.is_admin,
 149:                     token: token,
 150:                 };
 151:                 this.showLoggedInState();
 152:             } catch (e) {
 153:                 API.clearToken();
 154:             }
 155:         }
 156:     },
 157:     /**
 158:      * Show logged in state with top bar and app view
 159:      */
 160:     showLoggedInState() {
 161:         // Show top bar
 162:         document.getElementById('top-bar').classList.remove('hidden');
 163:         document.getElementById('user-display-name').textContent = this.session.username;
 164:         // Show admin menu items if admin
 165:         if (this.session.isAdmin) {
 166:             document.getElementById('admin-menu-items').classList.remove('hidden');
 167:         }
 168:         // Switch to app view: hide auth view, show app view
 169:         const authView = document.getElementById('auth-view');
 170:         const appView = document.getElementById('app-view');
 171:         if (authView) authView.classList.add('hidden');
 172:         if (appView) appView.classList.remove('hidden');
 173:         // Show profile section (only app-view sections are toggled)
 174:         this.showSection('profile');
 175:         // Adjust container for logged in state
 176:         document.getElementById('main-container').classList.add('logged-in');
 177:     },
 178:     /**
 179:      * Show logged out state
 180:      */
 181:     showLoggedOutState() {
 182:         // Hide top bar
 183:         document.getElementById('top-bar').classList.add('hidden');
 184:         document.getElementById('admin-menu-items').classList.add('hidden');
 185:         // Switch to auth view: show auth view, hide app view
 186:         const authView = document.getElementById('auth-view');
 187:         const appView = document.getElementById('app-view');
 188:         const mfaPage = document.getElementById('mfa-page');
 189:         if (appView) appView.classList.add('hidden');
 190:         if (authView) authView.classList.remove('hidden');
 191:         if (mfaPage) mfaPage.classList.add('hidden');
 192:         // Show login tab and reset auth tab state
 193:         const authTabContents = document.querySelectorAll('#auth-view .tab-content');
 194:         authTabContents.forEach(el => {
 195:             el.classList.remove('active');
 196:             el.classList.add('hidden');
 197:         });
 198:         const loginTab = document.getElementById('login-tab');
 199:         if (loginTab) {
 200:             loginTab.classList.add('active');
 201:             loginTab.classList.remove('hidden');
 202:         }
 203:         // Reset login view: show form, hide MFA step panel
 204:         const loginForm = document.getElementById('login-form');
 205:         if (loginForm) loginForm.classList.remove('hidden');
 206:         this.loginChallenge = null;
 207:         // Adjust container
 208:         document.getElementById('main-container').classList.remove('logged-in');
 209:         // Clear session
 210:         this.session = null;
 211:         API.clearToken();
 212:     },
 213:     /**
 214:      * Show a specific section
 215:      */
 216:     showSection(section) {
 217:         this.hideAllSections();
 218:         let sectionEl = null;
 219:         switch (section) {
 220:             case 'profile':
 221:                 sectionEl = document.getElementById('profile-section');
 222:                 if (sectionEl) {
 223:                     sectionEl.classList.remove('hidden');
 224:                     sectionEl.classList.add('active');
 225:                 }
 226:                 this.loadProfile();
 227:                 break;
 228:             case 'admin-users':
 229:                 sectionEl = document.getElementById('admin-users-section');
 230:                 if (sectionEl) {
 231:                     sectionEl.classList.remove('hidden');
 232:                     sectionEl.classList.add('active');
 233:                 }
 234:                 this.loadAdminUsers();
 235:                 break;
 236:             case 'admin-groups':
 237:                 sectionEl = document.getElementById('admin-groups-section');
 238:                 if (sectionEl) {
 239:                     sectionEl.classList.remove('hidden');
 240:                     sectionEl.classList.add('active');
 241:                 }
 242:                 this.loadAdminGroups();
 243:                 break;
 244:         }
 245:     },
 246:     /**
 247:      * Hide all app-view sections (profile, admin-users, admin-groups only).
 248:      * Only targets top-level sections, not inner .tab-content (e.g. Personal Details /
 249:      * Security tabs inside profile), so the default profile tab stays visible when shown.
 250:      */
 251:     hideAllSections() {
 252:         const appView = document.getElementById('app-view');
 253:         if (!appView) return;
 254:         appView.querySelectorAll(':scope > section.tab-content').forEach(el => {
 255:             el.classList.remove('active');
 256:             el.classList.add('hidden');
 257:         });
 258:     },
 259:     /**

 262:     setupTopBar() {

 268:             e.stopPropagation();
```
