 335:     /**
 336:      * Check for email verification token in URL
 337:      */
 338:     async checkEmailVerificationToken() {
 339:         const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
 340:         const token = urlParams.get('token');
 341:         const username = urlParams.get('username');
 342:         if (token && username) {
 343:             try {
 344:                 const response = await API.verifyEmail(username, token);
 345:                 this.showStatus('Email verified! You can now click Save again to confirm your profile.', 'success');
 346:                 window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
 347:                 if (this.currentUser && this.currentUser.username === username) {
 348:                     this.updateVerificationStatus(response.profile_status);
 349:                 }
 350:                 if (this.session && this.session.username === username) {
 351:                     await this.loadProfile();
 352:                 }
 353:             } catch (error) {
 354:                 this.showStatus(error.message, 'error');
 355:             }
 356:         }
 357:     },
 358:     /**
 359:      * Check for reset password link in hash (#reset-password?token=...&username=...)
 360:      */
 361:     checkResetPasswordToken() {
 362:         const hash = window.location.hash.slice(1) || '';
 363:         if (!hash.startsWith('reset-password')) return;
 364:         const q = hash.indexOf('?');
 365:         const params = q >= 0 ? new URLSearchParams(hash.substring(q + 1)) : new URLSearchParams();
 366:         const token = params.get('token');
 367:         const username = params.get('username');
 368:         if (!token || !username) return;
 369:         document.getElementById('reset-password-token').value = token;
 370:         document.getElementById('reset-password-username').value = username;
 371:         document.getElementById('auth-header').classList.add('hidden');
 372:         document.getElementById('auth-tabs').classList.add('hidden');
 373:         document.getElementById('login-tab').classList.add('hidden');
 374:         document.getElementById('signup-tab').classList.add('hidden');
 375:         document.getElementById('reset-password-section').classList.remove('hidden');
 376:         document.getElementById('reset-password-section').classList.add('active');
 377:     },
 378:     /**
 379:      * Setup forgot password link and panel
 380:      */
 381:     setupForgotPassword() {
 382:         const link = document.getElementById('login-forgot-password');
 383:         const backBtn = document.getElementById('forgot-password-back-btn');
 384:         const loginForm = document.getElementById('login-form');
 385:         const forgotPanel = document.getElementById('forgot-password-panel');
 386:         const form = document.getElementById('forgot-password-form');
 387:         const resultContainer = document.getElementById('forgot-password-result');
 388:     if (!link || !forgotPanel || !form) return;
 389:         link.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
 390:             e.preventDefault();
 391:             loginForm.classList.add('hidden');
 392:             document.getElementById('mfa-page').classList.add('hidden');
 393:             document.getElementById('login-result').classList.add('hidden');
 394:             forgotPanel.classList.remove('hidden');
 395:             resultContainer.classList.add('hidden');
 396:         });
 397:         backBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
 398:             forgotPanel.classList.add('hidden');
 399:             loginForm.classList.remove('hidden');
 400:             resultContainer.classList.add('hidden');
 401:         });
 402:         // Form submission handled by handleForgotPasswordSubmit via onsubmit
 403:     },
 404:     async doForgotPasswordSubmit() {
 405:         const form = document.getElementById('forgot-password-form');
 406:         const resultContainer = document.getElementById('forgot-password-result');
 407:         if (!form || !resultContainer) return;
 408:         const submitBtn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
 409:         const email = form.querySelector('#forgot-password-email').value.trim();
 410:         if (!email) return;
 411:         submitBtn.classList.add('loading');
 412:         submitBtn.disabled = true;
 413:         resultContainer.classList.add('hidden');
 414:         try {
 415:             await API.forgotPassword(email);
 416:             resultContainer.innerHTML = `
 417:                 <h3>✓ Check your email</h3>
 418:                 <p>If an account exists with this email, you will receive a password reset link shortly.</p>
 419:             `;
 420:             resultContainer.className = 'result-container success';
 421:             resultContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
 422:         } catch (error) {
 423:             resultContainer.innerHTML = `
 424:                 <h3>❌ Error</h3>
 425:                 <p>${escapeHtml(error.message)}</p>
 426:             `;
 427:             resultContainer.className = 'result-container error';
 428:             resultContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
 429:         } finally {
 430:             submitBtn.classList.remove('loading');
 431:             submitBtn.disabled = false;
 432:         }
 433:     },
 434:     /**
 435:      * Setup reset password form (from email link)
 436:      */
 437:     setupResetPasswordForm() {
 438:         // Form submission handled by handleResetPasswordSubmit via onsubmit
 439:     },
 440:     async doResetPasswordSubmit() {
 441:         const form = document.getElementById('reset-password-form');
 442:         const resultContainer = document.getElementById('reset-password-result');
 443:         if (!form) return;
 444:         const submitBtn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
 445:         const token = document.getElementById('reset-password-token').value;
 446:         const username = document.getElementById('reset-password-username').value;
 447:         const newPassword = form.querySelector('#reset-new-password').value;
 448:         const confirmPassword = form.querySelector('#reset-confirm-password').value;
 449:         if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) {
 450:             resultContainer.innerHTML = '<h3>❌ Passwords do not match</h3>';
 451:             resultContainer.className = 'result-container error';
 452:             resultContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
 453:             return;
 454:         }
 455:         if (newPassword.length < 8) {
 456:             resultContainer.innerHTML = '<h3>❌ Password must be at least 8 characters</h3>';
 457:             resultContainer.className = 'result-container error';
 458:             resultContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
 459:             return;
 460:         }
 461:         submitBtn.classList.add('loading');
 462:         submitBtn.disabled = true;
 463:         resultContainer.classList.add('hidden');
 464:         try {
 465:             await API.resetPassword(token, username, newPassword, confirmPassword);
 466:             resultContainer.innerHTML = `
 467:                 <h3>✓ Password reset successfully</h3>
 468:                 <p>You can now log in with your new password.</p>
 469:             `;
 470:             resultContainer.className = 'result-container success';
 471:             resultContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
 472:             window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname + window.location.search);
 473:             this.showStatus('Password reset successfully. You can now log in.', 'success');
 474:             setTimeout(() => {
 475:                 document.getElementById('reset-password-section').classList.add('hidden');
 476:                 this.showLoggedOutState();
 477:             }, 2000);
 478:         } catch (error) {
 479:             resultContainer.innerHTML = `
 480:                 <h3>❌ Reset failed</h3>
 481:                 <p>${escapeHtml(error.message)}</p>
 482:             `;
 483:             resultContainer.className = 'result-container error';
 484:             resultContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
 485:         } finally {
 486:             submitBtn.classList.remove('loading');
 487:             submitBtn.disabled = false;
 488:         }
 489:     },
 490:     /**

 493:     setupTabs() {
 494:         const tabButtons = document.querySelectorAll('#auth-view .tab-btn');
 495:         const tabContents = document.querySelectorAll('#auth-view .tab-content');
 496:         tabButtons.forEach(button => {

 498:                 const targetTab = button.dataset.tab;

 500:                 tabButtons.forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));

 503:                 tabContents.forEach(content => {

 506:                     if (content.id === `${targetTab}-tab`) {
 507:                         content.classList.add('active');
 508:                         content.classList.remove('hidden');
 509:                     }
 510:                 });
 511:                 // Clear previous results
 512:                 this.clearResults();
 513:             });
 514:         });

 516:     /**
 517:      * Setup login form (handled via onsubmit handler)
 518:      */
 519:     setupLoginForm() {
 520:         // Form submission handled by handleLoginFormSubmit via onsubmit
 521:     },
 522:     /**
 523:      * Login form submit logic (called from handleLoginFormSubmit)
 524:      */
 525:     async doLoginFormSubmit() {
 526:         const form = document.getElementById('login-form');
 527:         const resultContainer = document.getElementById('login-result');
 528:         if (!form || !resultContainer) return;
 529:         const submitBtn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
 530:         const username = form.querySelector('#login-username').value.trim();
 531:         const password = form.querySelector('#login-password').value;
 532:         const rememberMe = form.querySelector('#login-remember-me')?.checked ?? false;
 533:         submitBtn.classList.add('loading');
 534:         submitBtn.disabled = true;
 535:         resultContainer.classList.add('hidden');
 536:         try {
 537:             const response = await API.loginStart(username, password, rememberMe);
 538:             this.loginChallenge = {
 539:                 challenge_token: response.challenge_token,
 540:                 totp_enrolled: response.totp_enrolled,
 541:                 sms_available: response.sms_available,
 542:                 sms_enrolled: response.sms_enrolled ?? false,
 543:             };
 544:             form.classList.add('hidden');
 545:             this.showMfaStepPanel();
 546:         } catch (error) {
 547:             const message = (error && error.message) || 'Login failed. Please try again.';
 548:             resultContainer.innerHTML = `
 549:                 <h3>❌ Login Failed</h3>
 550:                 <p>${escapeHtml(message)}</p>
 551:             `;
 552:             resultContainer.className = 'result-container error';
 553:             resultContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
 554:             this.showStatus(message, 'error');
 555:         } finally {
 556:             submitBtn.classList.remove('loading');
 557:             submitBtn.disabled = false;
 558:         }
 559:     },
 560:     /**
 561:      * Show 2FA page (method selection / enrollment / authentication).
 562:      * User may have multiple methods enrolled; they choose which to use this login.
 563:      */
 564:     showMfaStepPanel() {
 565:         const mfaPage = document.getElementById('mfa-page');
 566:         const totpOption = document.getElementById('mfa-step-totp-option');
 567:         const smsOption = document.getElementById('mfa-step-sms-option');
 568:         const totpHint = document.getElementById('mfa-step-totp-hint');
 569:         const smsHint = document.getElementById('mfa-step-sms-hint');
 570:         if (!this.loginChallenge || !mfaPage) return;
 571:         totpOption.classList.remove('disabled');
 572:         totpOption.querySelector('input').disabled = false;
 573:         totpHint.textContent = this.loginChallenge.totp_enrolled
 574:             ? 'Enter code from your app'
 575:             : 'Set up Authenticator app (one-time)';
 576:         if (this.loginChallenge.sms_available) {
 577:             smsOption.classList.remove('disabled');
 578:             smsOption.querySelector('input').disabled = false;
 579:             if (smsHint) {
 580:                 smsHint.textContent = this.loginChallenge.sms_enrolled
 581:                     ? 'Enter code sent to your phone'
 582:                     : 'Set up SMS (one-time)';
 583:             }
 584:         } else {
 585:             smsOption.classList.add('disabled');
 586:             smsOption.querySelector('input').disabled = true;
 587:             // Hint left as-is (e.g. "SMS not available" from updateSmsOptions if disabled)
 588:         }
 589:         this.updateMfaStepMethodVisibility();
 590:         // Switch to 2FA page: hide login/signup tabs and content, show mfa-page
 591:         document.getElementById('auth-tabs').classList.add('hidden');
 592:         document.querySelectorAll('#auth-view .tab-content').forEach(el => {
 593:             el.classList.remove('active');
 594:             el.classList.add('hidden');
 595:         });
 596:         mfaPage.classList.remove('hidden');
 597:     },
 598:     /**
 599:      * Update MFA step UI based on selected method (TOTP vs SMS)
 600:      */
 601:     updateMfaStepMethodVisibility() {
 602:         const method = document.querySelector('input[name="mfa_step_method"]:checked')?.value || 'totp';
 603:         const totpSetup = document.getElementById('mfa-step-totp-setup');
 604:         const smsSend = document.getElementById('mfa-step-sms-send');
 605:         const smsStatus = document.getElementById('mfa-step-sms-status');
 606:         totpSetup.classList.add('hidden');
 607:         smsSend.classList.add('hidden');
 608:         smsStatus.classList.add('hidden');
 609:         if (method === 'totp') {
 610:             if (!this.loginChallenge.totp_enrolled) {
 611:                 totpSetup.classList.remove('hidden');
 612:                 this.fetchTotpSetupIfNeeded();
 613:             }
 614:         } else {
 615:             smsSend.classList.remove('hidden');
 616:         }
 617:     },
 618:     /**
 619:      * Fetch TOTP setup (QR + secret) when user selects TOTP and is not enrolled
 620:      */
 621:     async fetchTotpSetupIfNeeded() {
 622:         if (!this.loginChallenge || this.loginChallenge.totp_enrolled) return;
 623:         if (document.getElementById('mfa-step-secret').textContent) return; // already fetched
 624:         const qrDiv = document.getElementById('mfa-step-qr');
 625:         const secretEl = document.getElementById('mfa-step-secret');
 626:         const setupErrorEl = document.getElementById('mfa-step-totp-setup-error');
 627:         setupErrorEl.classList.add('hidden');
 628:         setupErrorEl.textContent = '';
 629:         try {
 630:             const response = await API.loginTotpSetup(this.loginChallenge.challenge_token);
 631:             qrDiv.innerHTML = '';
 632:             if (typeof QRCode !== 'undefined') {
 633:                 const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
 634:                 qrDiv.appendChild(canvas);
 635:                 await QRCode.toCanvas(canvas, response.otpauth_uri, {
 636:                     width: 200,
 637:                     margin: 2,
 638:                     color: { dark: '#1e293b', light: '#ffffff' },
 639:                 });
 640:             }
 641:             secretEl.textContent = response.secret;
 642:         } catch (error) {
 643:             const isUnauthorized = error.statusCode === 401;
 644:             const message = isUnauthorized
 645:                 ? 'Your login session expired or is invalid. Please click Back and sign in again.'
 646:                 : (error.message || 'Failed to load setup.');
 647:             setupErrorEl.textContent = message;
 648:             setupErrorEl.classList.remove('hidden');
 649:             this.showStatus(message, 'error');
 650:         }
 651:     },
 652:     /**
 653:      * Setup MFA page (method selector, verify, back, copy secret, send SMS)
 654:      */
 655:     setupMfaStepPanel() {
 656:         const mfaPage = document.getElementById('mfa-page');
 657:         const backBtn = document.getElementById('mfa-step-back-btn');

 756:     setupSignupForm() {

 759:     async doSignupFormSubmit() {

 768:         if (password !== confirmPassword) {
 769:             this.showStatus('Passwords do not match', 'error');

 772:         const userData = {
 773:             username: form.querySelector('#signup-username').value.trim().toLowerCase(),
 774:             email: form.querySelector('#signup-email').value.trim().toLowerCase(),
 775:             firstName: form.querySelector('#signup-firstname').value.trim(),
 776:             lastName: form.querySelector('#signup-lastname').value.trim(),
 777:             phoneCountryCode: form.querySelector('#signup-country-code').value,
 778:             phoneNumber: form.querySelector('#signup-phone').value.trim(),
 779:             password: password,
 780:         };
 781:         submitBtn.classList.add('loading');
 782:         submitBtn.disabled = true;

 784:         if (verificationPanel) verificationPanel.classList.add('hidden');

 786:             const response = await API.signup(userData);
 787:             this.currentUser = {
 788:                 username: userData.username,
 789:                 email: userData.email,
 790:             };
 791:             // Show verification panel
 792:             form.classList.add('hidden');
 793:             if (verificationPanel) verificationPanel.classList.remove('hidden');
 794:             // Update verification hints
 795:             if (response.email_verification_sent) {
 796:                 const hint = document.getElementById('email-verify-hint');
 797:                 if (hint) hint.textContent = `Check ${userData.email} for verification link`;
 798:             }

 802:                     `Enter code sent to ${userData.phoneCountryCode}${userData.phoneNumber}`;
 803:             }

 805:         } catch (error) {
 806:             resultContainer.innerHTML = `

 811:             resultContainer.classList.remove('hidden');

 883:     /**

 890:             document.getElementById('phone-verify-status').textContent = '✅';

 898:     /**
 899:      * Start countdown for resend buttons
 900:      */
 901:     startResendCountdown(button, seconds) {
 902:         let remaining = seconds;
 903:         button.disabled = true;
 904:         const interval = setInterval(() => {
 905:             remaining--;
 906:             button.textContent = `Resend (${remaining}s)`;
 907:             if (remaining <= 0) {
 908:                 clearInterval(interval);
 909:                 button.textContent = 'Resend';
 910:                 button.disabled = false;
 911:             }
 912:         }, 1000);
 913:     },

 915:      * Start countdown for SMS resend button
 916:      */
 917:     startSmsCountdown(button, seconds) {
 918:         let remaining = seconds;
 919:         button.disabled = true;
 920:         const interval = setInterval(() => {
 921:             remaining--;
 922:             button.textContent = `Resend (${remaining}s)`;
 923:             if (remaining <= 0) {
 924:                 clearInterval(interval);
 925:                 button.textContent = 'Send SMS';
 926:                 button.disabled = false;
 927:             }
 928:         }, 1000);
 929:     },
 930:     /**
 931:      * Setup copy secret button (MFA step TOTP setup)
 932:      */
 933:     setupCopySecret() {
 934:         const copyBtn = document.getElementById('mfa-step-copy-secret');
 935:         const secretCode = document.getElementById('mfa-step-secret');
 936:         if (!copyBtn || !secretCode) return;
 937:         copyBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
 938:             const secret = secretCode.textContent;
 939:             if (!secret) return;
 940:             try {
 941:                 await navigator.clipboard.writeText(secret);
 942:                 this.showStatus('Secret copied to clipboard!', 'success');
 943:                 const originalText = copyBtn.textContent;
 944:                 copyBtn.textContent = 'Copied!';
 945:                 setTimeout(() => { copyBtn.textContent = originalText; }, 2000);
 946:             } catch (err) {
 947:                 const textArea = document.createElement('textarea');
 948:                 textArea.value = secret;
 949:                 document.body.appendChild(textArea);
 950:                 textArea.select();
 951:                 document.execCommand('copy');
 952:                 document.body.removeChild(textArea);
 953:                 this.showStatus('Secret copied to clipboard!', 'success');
 954:             }
 955:         });
 956:     },
 957:     /**
 958:      * Populate country code dropdowns from COUNTRY_CODES (country-codes.js).
 959:      * Ensures profile and signup phone selects show all countries with flags.
 960:      */
 961:     populateCountryCodeSelects() {
 962:         if (typeof window.COUNTRY_CODES === 'undefined' || !Array.isArray(window.COUNTRY_CODES)) {
 963:             return;
 964:         }
 965:         const list = window.COUNTRY_CODES.slice()
 966:             .filter((c) => c.dial_code && (c.flag != null && c.flag !== ''))
 967:             .sort((a, b) => (a.name || '').localeCompare(b.name || ''));
 968:         const addOptions = (selectEl) => {
 969:             if (!selectEl) return;
 970:             const placeholder = selectEl.querySelector('option[value=""]');
 971:             selectEl.innerHTML = '';
 972:             if (placeholder) {
 973:                 selectEl.appendChild(placeholder);
 974:             } else {
 975:                 const empty = document.createElement('option');
 976:                 empty.value = '';
 977:                 empty.textContent = 'Country code';
 978:                 selectEl.appendChild(empty);
 979:             }
 980:             list.forEach((c) => {
 981:                 const opt = document.createElement('option');
 982:                 opt.value = c.dial_code;
 983:                 opt.textContent = c.flag + ' ' + c.dial_code;
 984:                 selectEl.appendChild(opt);
 985:             });
 986:         };
 987:         addOptions(document.getElementById('profile-country-code'));
 988:         addOptions(document.getElementById('signup-country-code'));
 989:         this.makeCountryCodeSearchable('profile-country-code');
 990:         this.makeCountryCodeSearchable('signup-country-code');
 991:     },
 992:     /**
 993:      * Convert a country code select into a searchable dropdown.
 994:      * Keeps the original select in DOM (hidden) for form submission.
 995:      */
 996:     makeCountryCodeSearchable(selectId) {
 997:         const select = document.getElementById(selectId);
 998:         if (!select || typeof window.COUNTRY_CODES === 'undefined') return;
 999:         const list = window.COUNTRY_CODES.slice()
1000:             .filter((c) => c.dial_code && (c.flag != null && c.flag !== ''))
1001:             .sort((a, b) => (a.name || '').localeCompare(b.name || ''));
1002:         const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
1003:         wrapper.className = 'country-code-search-wrapper';
1004:         const trigger = document.createElement('button');
1005:         trigger.type = 'button';
1006:         trigger.className = 'country-code-trigger';
1007:         trigger.setAttribute('aria-haspopup', 'listbox');
1008:         trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
1009:         const selectedOpt = select.options[select.selectedIndex];
1010:         trigger.textContent = selectedOpt ? selectedOpt.textContent : 'Country code';
1011:         const dropdown = document.createElement('div');
1012:         dropdown.className = 'country-code-dropdown';
1013:         dropdown.setAttribute('role', 'listbox');
1014:         const searchInput = document.createElement('input');
1015:         searchInput.type = 'text';
1016:         searchInput.className = 'country-code-search';
1017:         searchInput.placeholder = 'Search country or code...';
1018:         searchInput.setAttribute('autocomplete', 'off');
1019:         const optionsContainer = document.createElement('div');
1020:         optionsContainer.className = 'country-code-options';
1021:         list.forEach((c) => {
1022:             const item = document.createElement('div');
1023:             item.className = 'country-code-option';
1024:             item.setAttribute('role', 'option');
1025:             item.dataset.value = c.dial_code;
1026:             item.dataset.search = (c.name + ' ' + c.dial_code).toLowerCase();
1027:             item.textContent = c.flag + ' ' + c.dial_code + ' ' + c.name;
1028:             optionsContainer.appendChild(item);
1029:         });
1030:         dropdown.appendChild(searchInput);
1031:         dropdown.appendChild(optionsContainer);
1032:         select.parentNode.insertBefore(wrapper, select);
1033:         wrapper.appendChild(select);
1034:         wrapper.appendChild(trigger);
1035:         wrapper.appendChild(dropdown);
1036:         select.classList.add('country-code-select-hidden');
1037:         const updateTrigger = () => {
1038:             const opt = select.options[select.selectedIndex];
1039:             trigger.textContent = opt ? opt.textContent : 'Country code';
1040:         };
1041:         const closeDropdown = () => {
1042:             dropdown.classList.remove('open');
1043:             trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
1044:             searchInput.value = '';
1045:             list.forEach((c, i) => {
1046:                 optionsContainer.children[i].classList.remove('hidden');
1047:             });
1048:         };
1049:         const filterOptions = (q) => {
1050:             const lower = q.trim().toLowerCase();
1051:             Array.from(optionsContainer.children).forEach((el) => {
1052:                 el.classList.toggle('hidden', lower && !el.dataset.search.includes(lower));
1053:             });
1054:         };
1055:         trigger.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
1056:             e.preventDefault();
1057:             const isOpen = dropdown.classList.toggle('open');
1058:             trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
1059:             if (isOpen) {
1060:                 searchInput.focus();
1061:                 filterOptions(searchInput.value);
1062:             }
1063:         });
1064:         searchInput.addEventListener('input', () => filterOptions(searchInput.value));
1065:         searchInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
1066:             if (e.key === 'Escape') {
1067:                 closeDropdown();
1068:                 trigger.focus();
1069:             }
1070:         });
1071:         optionsContainer.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
1072:             const item = e.target.closest('.country-code-option');
1073:             if (!item || item.classList.contains('hidden')) return;
1074:             select.value = item.dataset.value;
1075:             updateTrigger();
1076:             closeDropdown();
1077:         });
1078:         document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
1079:             if (dropdown.classList.contains('open') && !wrapper.contains(e.target)) {
1080:                 closeDropdown();
1081:             }
1082:         });
1083:         this.updateCountryCodeTrigger = this.updateCountryCodeTrigger || {};
1084:         this.updateCountryCodeTrigger[selectId] = updateTrigger;
1085:     },
1086:     /**
1087:      * Update the visible trigger text for a country code select (e.g. after loadProfile).
1088:      */
1089:     updateCountryCodeTriggerText(selectId) {
1090:         const fn = this.updateCountryCodeTrigger && this.updateCountryCodeTrigger[selectId];
1091:         if (typeof fn === 'function') fn();
1092:     },
1093:     /**
1094:      * Setup profile functionality
1095:      */
1096:     toggleProfilePasswordFields(enabled) {
1097:         const fields = document.querySelectorAll('.profile-password-fields input');
1098:         fields.forEach((el) => {
1099:             el.disabled = !enabled;
1100:         });

1102:     setupProfile() {

1108:                 this.toggleProfilePasswordFields(changePwdCheckbox.checked);
1109:             });
1110:             this.toggleProfilePasswordFields(changePwdCheckbox.checked);
1111:         }
1112:         // Form submission handled by handleProfileFormSubmit via onsubmit
1113:     },
1114:     async doProfileFormSubmit() {
1115:         const form = document.getElementById('profile-form');
1116:         if (!form || !this.session) return;
1117:         const submitBtn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
1118:         const errorEl = document.getElementById('profile-password-error');
1119:         const changePwdCheckbox = document.getElementById('profile-change-password-checkbox');
1120:         const wantToChangePwd = changePwdCheckbox?.checked ?? false;
1121:         const currentPwd = document.getElementById('profile-current-password')?.value;
1122:         const newPwd = document.getElementById('profile-new-password')?.value;
1123:         const confirmPwd = document.getElementById('profile-confirm-password')?.value;
1124:         if (errorEl) {
1125:             errorEl.textContent = '';
1126:             errorEl.classList.add('hidden');
1127:         }
1128:         if (wantToChangePwd && (currentPwd || newPwd || confirmPwd)) {
1129:             if (!currentPwd?.trim()) {
1130:                 this.showStatus('Enter your current password to change it.', 'error');
1131:                 if (errorEl) {
1132:                     errorEl.textContent = 'Enter your current password.';
1133:                     errorEl.classList.remove('hidden');
1134:                     errorEl.classList.add('form-error');
1135:                 }
1136:                 return;
1137:             }
1138:             if (!newPwd?.trim()) {
1139:                 this.showStatus('Enter a new password.', 'error');
1140:                 if (errorEl) {
1141:                     errorEl.textContent = 'Enter a new password.';
1142:                     errorEl.classList.remove('hidden');
1143:                     errorEl.classList.add('form-error');
1144:                 }
1145:                 return;
1146:             }
1147:             if (newPwd.length < 8) {
1148:                 this.showStatus('New password must be at least 8 characters.', 'error');
1149:                 if (errorEl) {
1150:                     errorEl.textContent = 'New password must be at least 8 characters.';
1151:                     errorEl.classList.remove('hidden');
1152:                     errorEl.classList.add('form-error');
1153:                 }
1154:                 return;
1155:             }
1156:             if (newPwd !== confirmPwd) {
1157:                 this.showStatus('New password and confirmation do not match.', 'error');
1158:                 if (errorEl) {
1159:                     errorEl.textContent = 'New password and confirmation do not match.';
1160:                     errorEl.classList.remove('hidden');
1161:                     errorEl.classList.add('form-error');
1162:                 }
1163:                 return;
1164:             }
1165:         }
1166:         submitBtn.classList.add('loading');
1167:         submitBtn.disabled = true;
1168:         const email = document.getElementById('profile-email').value.trim();
1169:         const phoneCountryCode = document.getElementById('profile-country-code').value;
1170:         const phoneNumber = document.getElementById('profile-phone').value.trim();
1171:         try {
1172:             const profile = await API.getProfile(this.session.username);
1173:             const emailChanged = email && email.toLowerCase() !== (profile.email || '').toLowerCase();
1174:             const phoneChanged =
1175:                 (phoneCountryCode !== (profile.phone_country_code || '')) ||
1176:                 (phoneNumber !== (profile.phone_number || ''));
1177:             const needEmailVerify = emailChanged && profile.email_verified;
1178:             const needPhoneVerify = phoneChanged && profile.phone_verified;
1179:             if (needEmailVerify || needPhoneVerify) {
1180:                 if (needEmailVerify) {
1181:                     await API.requestEmailChange(email);
1182:                 }
1183:                 if (needPhoneVerify) {
1184:                     await API.requestPhoneChange(phoneCountryCode, phoneNumber);
1185:                     this.pendingVerifyPhone = true;
1186:                 }
1187:                 const parts = [];
1188:                 if (needEmailVerify) parts.push('email (click the link we sent)');
1189:                 if (needPhoneVerify) parts.push('phone (enter the code below)');
1190:                 this.showStatus(
1191:                     'Verification sent. Please verify your new ' + parts.join(' and ') + ', then click Save again.',
1192:                     'success',
1193:                 );
1194:                 await this.loadProfile();
1195:                 submitBtn.classList.remove('loading');
1196:                 submitBtn.disabled = false;
1197:                 return;
1198:             }
1199:             const updates = {};
1200:             const firstName = document.getElementById('profile-firstname').value.trim();
1201:             const lastName = document.getElementById('profile-lastname').value.trim();
1202:             if (firstName) updates.first_name = firstName;
1203:             if (lastName) updates.last_name = lastName;
1204:             updates.email = email;
1205:             updates.phone_country_code = phoneCountryCode;
1206:             updates.phone_number = phoneNumber;
1207:             if (wantToChangePwd && currentPwd && newPwd && confirmPwd) {
1208:                 updates.current_password = currentPwd;
1209:                 updates.new_password = newPwd;
1210:                 updates.confirm_password = confirmPwd;
1211:             }
1212:             await API.updateProfile(this.session.username, updates);
1213:             this.showStatus('Profile updated successfully', 'success');
1214:             if (wantToChangePwd && (currentPwd || newPwd || confirmPwd)) {
1215:                 document.getElementById('profile-current-password').value = '';
1216:                 document.getElementById('profile-new-password').value = '';
1217:                 document.getElementById('profile-confirm-password').value = '';
1218:                 const cb = document.getElementById('profile-change-password-checkbox');
1219:                 if (cb) cb.checked = false;
1220:                 this.toggleProfilePasswordFields(false);
1221:             }
1222:             await this.loadProfile();
1223:         } catch (error) {
1224:             this.showStatus(error.message, 'error');
1225:         } finally {
1226:             submitBtn.classList.remove('loading');
1227:             submitBtn.disabled = false;
1228:         }
1229:     },
1230:     /**
1231:      * Setup profile tab navigation (Personal Details | Security).
1232:      */
1233:     setupProfileTabs() {
1234:         const container = document.getElementById('profile-section');
1235:         if (!container) return;
1236:         const tabButtons = container.querySelectorAll('#profile-tabs .tab-btn');
1237:         const tabContents = container.querySelectorAll('.profile-tab-content');
1238:         tabButtons.forEach(button => {
1239:             button.addEventListener('click', () => {
1240:                 const targetTab = button.dataset.tab;
1241:                 tabButtons.forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
1242:                 button.classList.add('active');
1243:                 tabContents.forEach(content => {
1244:                     content.classList.remove('active');
1245:                     content.classList.add('hidden');
1246:                     if (content.id === `profile-${targetTab}-tab`) {
1247:                         content.classList.add('active');
1248:                         content.classList.remove('hidden');
1249:                     }
1250:                 });
1251:             });
1252:         });
1253:     },
1254:     /**
1255:      * Load profile data
1256:      */
1257:     async loadProfile() {
1258:         if (!this.session) return;
1259:         try {
1260:             const profile = await API.getProfile(this.session.username);
1261:             document.getElementById('profile-username').value = profile.username;
1262:             document.getElementById('profile-firstname').value = profile.first_name;
1263:             document.getElementById('profile-lastname').value = profile.last_name;
1264:             document.getElementById('profile-email').value = profile.email;
1265:             const countrySelect = document.getElementById('profile-country-code');
1266:             const code = profile.phone_country_code || '';
1267:             countrySelect.value = code;
1268:             if (code && countrySelect.value !== code) {
1269:                 const opt = document.createElement('option');
1270:                 opt.value = code;
1271:                 opt.textContent = code;
1272:                 countrySelect.appendChild(opt);
1273:                 countrySelect.value = code;
1274:             }
1275:             this.updateCountryCodeTriggerText('profile-country-code');
1276:             document.getElementById('profile-phone').value = profile.phone_number;
1277:             document.getElementById('profile-status').value = profile.status.toUpperCase();
1278:             // 2FA methods list and add buttons
1279:             this.renderProfileMfaMethods(profile);
1280:             // Email and phone are always editable on profile; changing requires re-verification after save
1281:             const emailInput = document.getElementById('profile-email');
1282:             const phoneInput = document.getElementById('profile-phone');
1283:             const countryCodeSelect = document.getElementById('profile-country-code');
1284:             emailInput.readOnly = false;
1285:             emailInput.classList.remove('readonly-input');
1286:             phoneInput.readOnly = false;
1287:             phoneInput.classList.remove('readonly-input');
1288:             countryCodeSelect.disabled = false;
1289:             const wrapper = countryCodeSelect.closest('.country-code-search-wrapper');
1290:             if (wrapper) {
1291:                 const trigger = wrapper.querySelector('.country-code-trigger');
1292:                 if (trigger) trigger.disabled = false;
1293:             }
1294:             document.getElementById('profile-email-hint').textContent =
1295:                 'Changing email will require verification after saving.';
1296:             document.getElementById('profile-phone-hint').textContent =
1297:                 'Changing phone will require verification after saving.';
1298:             // Show or hide profile verification block (when logged in, email or phone unverified)
1299:             this.updateProfileVerificationBlock(profile);
1300:             // 2FA methods list is rendered in renderProfileMfaMethods(profile) above
1301:             // Display groups
1302:             const groupsContainer = document.getElementById('profile-groups');
1303:             if (profile.groups && profile.groups.length > 0) {
1304:                 groupsContainer.innerHTML = profile.groups.map(g =>
1305:                     `<span class="group-badge">${escapeHtml(g.name)}</span>`
1306:                 ).join('');
1307:             } else {
1308:                 groupsContainer.innerHTML = '<span class="no-groups">No groups assigned</span>';
1309:             }
1310:         } catch (error) {
1311:             this.showStatus('Failed to load profile', 'error');
1312:         }
1313:     },
1314:     /**
1315:      * Show or hide the profile verification block and wire buttons (when email or phone unverified).
1316:      */
1317:     updateProfileVerificationBlock(profile) {
1318:         const block = document.getElementById('profile-verification-block');
1319:         const emailRow = document.getElementById('profile-verify-email-row');
1320:         const phoneRow = document.getElementById('profile-verify-phone-row');
1321:         if (!block || !emailRow || !phoneRow) return;
1322:         const needEmail = !profile.email_verified;
1323:         const needPhone = !profile.phone_verified || this.pendingVerifyPhone;
1324:         if (needEmail || needPhone) {
1325:             block.classList.remove('hidden');
1326:             emailRow.classList.toggle('hidden', !needEmail);
1327:             phoneRow.classList.toggle('hidden', !needPhone);
1328:         } else {
1329:             block.classList.add('hidden');
1330:         }
1331:     },
1332:     /**
1333:      * Render the 2FA methods list and toggle Add TOTP / Add SMS visibility.
1334:      */
1335:     renderProfileMfaMethods(profile) {
1336:         const listEl = document.getElementById('profile-mfa-methods-list');
1337:         const addTotpBtn = document.getElementById('profile-mfa-add-totp-btn');
1338:         const addSmsBtn = document.getElementById('profile-mfa-add-sms-btn');
1339:         const totpSetupEl = document.getElementById('profile-mfa-totp-setup');
1340:         if (!listEl || !addTotpBtn || !addSmsBtn) return;
1341:         const methods = profile.mfa_methods || [];
1342:         const hasTotp = methods.some(m => m.method === 'totp');
1343:         const hasSms = methods.some(m => m.method === 'sms');
1344:         const canRemove = methods.length > 1;
1345:         listEl.innerHTML = '';
1346:         methods.forEach(m => {
1347:             const label = m.method === 'totp'
1348:                 ? 'Authenticator app (TOTP)'
1349:                 : `SMS${m.phone_number ? ` (${m.phone_number})` : ''}`;
1350:             const item = document.createElement('div');
1351:             item.className = 'profile-mfa-method-item';
1352:             item.innerHTML = `
1353:                 <span class="profile-mfa-method-label">${escapeHtml(label)}</span>
1354:                 <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary btn-small profile-mfa-remove-btn"
1355:                     data-method="${escapeHtml(m.method)}" ${canRemove ? '' : 'disabled'}
1356:                     title="${canRemove ? 'Remove this method' : 'At least one method must remain'}">
1357:                     Remove
1358:                 </button>
1359:             `;
1360:             listEl.appendChild(item);
1361:         });
1362:         if (methods.length === 0) {
1363:             listEl.innerHTML = '<p class="form-hint">No 2FA methods yet. Add one below.</p>';
1364:         }
1365:         addTotpBtn.classList.toggle('hidden', hasTotp);
1366:         addSmsBtn.classList.toggle('hidden', !this.smsEnabled || hasSms);
1367:         if (totpSetupEl) totpSetupEl.classList.add('hidden');
1368:     },
1369:     /**
1370:      * Setup profile 2FA section: Add TOTP, Add SMS, Remove, TOTP setup panel (Copy, Done).
1371:      */
1372:     setupProfileMfaSection() {
1373:         const addTotpBtn = document.getElementById('profile-mfa-add-totp-btn');
1374:         const addSmsBtn = document.getElementById('profile-mfa-add-sms-btn');
1375:         const listEl = document.getElementById('profile-mfa-methods-list');
1376:         const totpSetupEl = document.getElementById('profile-mfa-totp-setup');
1377:         const totpSecretInput = document.getElementById('profile-mfa-totp-secret');
1378:         const totpCopyBtn = document.getElementById('profile-mfa-totp-copy-btn');
1379:         const totpDoneBtn = document.getElementById('profile-mfa-totp-done-btn');
1380:         const totpQrEl = document.getElementById('profile-mfa-totp-qr');
1381:         if (!addTotpBtn || !addSmsBtn || !listEl) return;
1382:         addTotpBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
1383:             if (!this.session) return;
1384:             addTotpBtn.disabled = true;
1385:             try {
1386:                 const res = await API.addProfileMfaMethod(this.session.username, { mfa_method: 'totp' });
1387:                 totpSecretInput.value = res.secret || '';
1388:                 totpQrEl.innerHTML = '';
1389:                 if (typeof QRCode !== 'undefined' && res.otpauth_uri) {
1390:                     const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
1391:                     totpQrEl.appendChild(canvas);
1392:                     await QRCode.toCanvas(canvas, res.otpauth_uri, { width: 180 });
1393:                 }
1394:                 if (totpSetupEl) totpSetupEl.classList.remove('hidden');
1395:                 this.showStatus('Scan the QR code with your app, then click Done.', 'success');
1396:             } catch (e) {
1397:                 this.showStatus(e.message || 'Failed to add Authenticator app', 'error');
1398:             } finally {
1399:                 addTotpBtn.disabled = false;
1400:             }
1401:         });
1402:         addSmsBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
1403:             if (!this.session) return;
1404:             addSmsBtn.disabled = true;
1405:             try {
1406:                 await API.addProfileMfaMethod(this.session.username, { mfa_method: 'sms' });
1407:                 this.showStatus('SMS 2FA added. Codes will be sent to your profile phone.', 'success');
1408:                 await this.loadProfile();
1409:             } catch (e) {
1410:                 this.showStatus(e.message || 'Failed to add SMS', 'error');
1411:             } finally {
1412:                 addSmsBtn.disabled = false;
1413:             }
1414:         });
1415:         listEl.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
1416:             const btn = e.target.closest('.profile-mfa-remove-btn');
1417:             if (!btn || btn.disabled || !this.session) return;
1418:             const method = btn.getAttribute('data-method');
1419:             if (!method) return;
1420:             btn.disabled = true;
1421:             try {
1422:                 await API.removeProfileMfaMethod(this.session.username, method);
1423:                 this.showStatus('2FA method removed.', 'success');
1424:                 await this.loadProfile();
1425:             } catch (err) {
1426:                 this.showStatus(err.message || 'Failed to remove method', 'error');
1427:                 btn.disabled = false;
1428:             }
1429:         });
1430:         if (totpCopyBtn && totpSecretInput) {
1431:             totpCopyBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
1432:                 totpSecretInput.select();
1433:                 document.execCommand('copy');
1434:                 this.showStatus('Secret copied to clipboard', 'success');
1435:             });
1436:         }
1437:         if (totpDoneBtn && totpSetupEl) {
1438:             totpDoneBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
1439:                 totpSetupEl.classList.add('hidden');
1440:                 totpQrEl.innerHTML = '';
1441:                 totpSecretInput.value = '';
1442:                 this.loadProfile();
1443:             });
1444:         }
1445:     },
1446:     /**
1447:      * Setup profile verification buttons (resend email, resend phone, verify phone code).
1448:      */
1449:     setupProfileVerification() {
1450:         const resendEmailBtn = document.getElementById('profile-resend-email-btn');
1451:         const resendPhoneBtn = document.getElementById('profile-resend-phone-btn');
1452:         const verifyPhoneBtn = document.getElementById('profile-verify-phone-btn');
1453:         const codeInput = document.getElementById('profile-phone-code');
1454:         if (!resendEmailBtn || !resendPhoneBtn || !verifyPhoneBtn || !codeInput) return;
1455:         resendEmailBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
1456:             if (!this.session) return;
1457:             resendEmailBtn.disabled = true;
1458:             try {
1459:                 await API.resendVerification(this.session.username, 'email');
1460:                 this.showStatus('Verification email sent', 'success');
1461:             } catch (e) {
1462:                 this.showStatus(e.message || 'Failed to send', 'error');
1463:             } finally {
1464:                 resendEmailBtn.disabled = false;
1465:             }
1466:         });
1467:         resendPhoneBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
1468:             if (!this.session) return;
1469:             resendPhoneBtn.disabled = true;
1470:             try {
1471:                 await API.resendVerification(this.session.username, 'phone');
1472:                 this.showStatus('Verification code sent', 'success');
1473:             } catch (e) {
1474:                 this.showStatus(e.message || 'Failed to send', 'error');
1475:             } finally {
1476:                 resendPhoneBtn.disabled = false;
1477:             }
1478:         });
1479:         verifyPhoneBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
1480:             if (!this.session) return;
1481:             const code = (codeInput.value || '').trim();
1482:             if (!code) {
1483:                 this.showStatus('Enter the 6-digit code', 'error');
1484:                 return;
1485:             }
1486:             verifyPhoneBtn.disabled = true;
1487:             try {
1488:                 await API.verifyPhone(this.session.username, code);
1489:                 this.pendingVerifyPhone = false;
1490:                 this.showStatus('Phone verified! Click Save again to confirm your profile.', 'success');
1491:                 codeInput.value = '';
1492:                 await this.loadProfile();
1493:             } catch (e) {
1494:                 this.showStatus(e.message || 'Invalid code', 'error');
1495:             } finally {
1496:                 verifyPhoneBtn.disabled = false;
1497:             }
1498:         });
1499:     },
1500:     /**
1501:      * Setup admin users functionality
1502:      */
1503:     setupAdminUsers() {
1504:         const searchInput = document.getElementById('users-search');
1505:         const statusFilter = document.getElementById('users-status-filter');
1506:         const groupFilter = document.getElementById('users-group-filter');
1507:         const refreshBtn = document.getElementById('users-refresh-btn');
1508:         if (!searchInput || !statusFilter || !groupFilter || !refreshBtn) return;
1509:         // Search
1510:         let searchTimeout;
1511:         searchInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
1512:             clearTimeout(searchTimeout);
1513:             searchTimeout = setTimeout(() => this.loadAdminUsers(), 300);
1514:         });
1515:         // Filters
1516:         statusFilter.addEventListener('change', () => this.loadAdminUsers());
1517:         groupFilter.addEventListener('change', () => this.loadAdminUsers());
1518:         // Refresh
1519:         refreshBtn.addEventListener('click', () => this.loadAdminUsers());
1520:         // Sortable headers
1521:         document.querySelectorAll('#users-table th.sortable').forEach(th => {
1522:             th.addEventListener('click', () => {
1523:                 const field = th.dataset.sort;
1524:                 if (this.sortState.field === field) {
1525:                     this.sortState.order = this.sortState.order === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
1526:                 } else {
1527:                     this.sortState.field = field;
1528:                     this.sortState.order = 'asc';
1529:                 }
1530:                 this.updateSortIndicators('users-table');
1531:                 this.loadAdminUsers();
1532:             });
1533:         });
1534:     },
1535:     /**
1536:      * Load admin users list
1537:      */
1538:     async loadAdminUsers() {
1539:         if (!this.session || !this.session.isAdmin) return;
1540:         const tableBody = document.getElementById('users-table-body');
1541:         const loading = document.getElementById('users-loading');
1542:         const empty = document.getElementById('users-empty');
1543:         loading.classList.remove('hidden');
1544:         empty.classList.add('hidden');
1545:         tableBody.innerHTML = '';
1546:         try {
1547:             const params = {
1548:                 status_filter: document.getElementById('users-status-filter').value || undefined,
1549:                 group_filter: document.getElementById('users-group-filter').value || undefined,
1550:                 search: document.getElementById('users-search').value || undefined,
1551:                 sort_by: this.sortState.field,
1552:                 sort_order: this.sortState.order,
1553:             };
1554:             const response = await API.adminListUsersEnhanced(params);
1555:             this.users = response.users;
1556:             // Also load groups for filter dropdown
1557:             await this.loadGroupsForFilter();
1558:             if (response.users.length === 0) {
1559:                 empty.classList.remove('hidden');
1560:             } else {
1561:                 tableBody.innerHTML = response.users.map(user => `
1562:                     <tr>
1563:                         <td>${escapeHtml(user.first_name)} ${escapeHtml(user.last_name)}</td>
1564:                         <td>${escapeHtml(user.username)}</td>
1565:                         <td>${escapeHtml(user.email)}</td>
1566:                         <td><span class="status-badge status-${escapeHtml(user.status)}">${escapeHtml(user.status.toUpperCase())}</span></td>
1567:                         <td>${user.groups.map(g => `<span class="group-badge-small">${escapeHtml(g.name)}</span>`).join(' ') || '-'}</td>
1568:                         <td>${new Date(user.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</td>
1569:                         <td class="action-buttons">
1570:                             ${user.status === 'complete' ? `
1571:                                 <button class="btn btn-primary btn-xs" onclick="App.showApproveModal('${escapeHtml(user.id)}', '${escapeHtml(user.username)}')">Approve</button>
1572:                                 <button class="btn btn-danger btn-xs" onclick="App.confirmAction('Reject this user?', () => App.rejectUser('${escapeHtml(user.id)}'))">Reject</button>
1573:                             ` : ''}
1574:                             ${user.status === 'active' ? `
1575:                                 <button class="btn btn-danger btn-xs" onclick="App.confirmAction('Revoke this user?', () => App.revokeUser('${escapeHtml(user.id)}'))">Revoke</button>
1576:                             ` : ''}
1577:                         </td>
1578:                     </tr>
1579:                 `).join('');
1580:             }
1581:         } catch (error) {
1582:             this.showStatus(error.message, 'error');
1583:         } finally {
1584:             loading.classList.add('hidden');
1585:         }
1586:     },
1587:     /**
1588:      * Load groups for filter dropdown
1589:      */
1590:     async loadGroupsForFilter() {
1591:         try {
1592:             const response = await API.listGroups();
1593:             this.groups = response.groups;
1594:             const filterSelect = document.getElementById('users-group-filter');
1595:             const currentValue = filterSelect.value;
1596:             // Keep first option, update rest
1597:             filterSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">All Groups</option>' +
1598:                 response.groups.map(g => `<option value="${escapeHtml(g.id)}">${escapeHtml(g.name)}</option>`).join('');
1599:             filterSelect.value = currentValue;
1600:         } catch (error) {
1601:             console.warn('Could not load groups for filter', error);
1602:         }
1603:     },
1604:     /**
1605:      * Setup admin groups functionality
1606:      */
1607:     setupAdminGroups() {

1609:         const createBtn = document.getElementById('create-group-btn');

1619:         // Sortable headers

1622:                 const field = th.dataset.sort;
1623:                 if (this.sortState.field === field) {
1624:                     this.sortState.order = this.sortState.order === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
1625:                 } else {
1626:                     this.sortState.field = field;
1627:                     this.sortState.order = 'asc';

1634:     /**
1635:      * Load admin groups list
1636:      */
1637:     async loadAdminGroups() {

1639:         const tableBody = document.getElementById('groups-table-body');

1643:         empty.classList.add('hidden');

1655:             } else {
1656:                 tableBody.innerHTML = response.groups.map(group => `
1657:                     <tr>
1658:                         <td><strong>${escapeHtml(group.name)}</strong></td>
1659:                         <td>${escapeHtml(group.description || '-')}</td>
1660:                         <td>
1661:                             <a href="#" onclick="App.showGroupMembers('${escapeHtml(group.id)}', '${escapeHtml(group.name)}'); return false;">

1666:                         <td class="action-buttons">

1668:                             <button class="btn btn-danger btn-xs" onclick="App.confirmAction('Delete this group?', () => App.deleteGroup('${escapeHtml(group.id)}'))">Delete</button>
1669:                         </td>
1670:                     </tr>
1671:                 `).join('');
1672:             }

1675:         } finally {

1677:         }
1678:     },
1679:     /**
1680:      * Update sort indicators in table headers
1681:      */
1682:     updateSortIndicators(tableId) {
1683:         document.querySelectorAll(`#${tableId} th.sortable`).forEach(th => {
1684:             th.classList.remove('sort-asc', 'sort-desc');
1685:             if (th.dataset.sort === this.sortState.field) {
1686:                 th.classList.add(`sort-${this.sortState.order}`);
1687:             }
1688:         });
1689:     },
1690:     /**
1691:      * Setup modals
1692:      */
1693:     setupModals() {
1694:         const overlay = document.getElementById('modal-overlay');
1695:         // Close buttons
1696:         document.querySelectorAll('[data-close-modal]').forEach(btn => {
1697:             btn.addEventListener('click', () => this.closeModals());
1698:         });
1699:         // Close on overlay click
1700:         overlay.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
1701:             if (e.target === overlay) {
1702:                 this.closeModals();
1703:             }
1704:         });

1708:         if (approveForm) {

1710:             approveForm.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {

1728:     async showGroupModal(groupId = null) {

1732:         const descInput = document.getElementById('group-description');

1735:             try {

1746:             nameInput.value = '';
1747:             descInput.value = '';
1748:             delete modal.dataset.groupId;

1751:         modal.classList.remove('hidden');
1752:         nameInput.focus();
1753:     },

1757:     async doGroupModalFormSubmit() {

1763:     async saveGroup() {
1764:         const modal = document.getElementById('group-modal');

1766:         const name = document.getElementById('group-name').value.trim();
1767:         const description = document.getElementById('group-description').value.trim();
1768:         if (!name) {
1769:             this.showStatus('Group name is required', 'error');
1770:             return;

1772:         try {
1773:             if (groupId) {

1775:                 this.showStatus('Group updated successfully', 'success');

1780:             this.closeModals();

1782:         } catch (error) {
1783:             this.showStatus(error.message, 'error');
1784:         }
1785:     },

1789:     async deleteGroup(groupId) {

1795:             this.showStatus(error.message, 'error');
1796:         }
1797:     },

1801:     async showGroupMembers(groupId, groupName) {

1813:             } else {

1818:                     </div>

1821:         } catch (error) {

1823:         }
1824:     },

1828:     async showApproveModal(userId, username) {

1845:                         <input type="checkbox" name="approve_group" value="${escapeHtml(g.id)}">
1846:                         <span>${escapeHtml(g.name)}</span>
1847:                     </label>
1848:                 `).join('');
1849:             }
1850:         } catch (error) {
1851:             groupsList.innerHTML = `<div class="error-message">${escapeHtml(error.message)}</div>`;
1852:         }
1853:     },
1854:     /**
1855:      * Approve modal form submit (called from handleApproveModalFormSubmit)
1856:      */
1857:     async doApproveModalFormSubmit() {
1858:         await this.approveUser();
1859:     },
1860:     /**
1861:      * Approve user (from modal)
1862:      */
1863:     async approveUser() {
1864:         const modal = document.getElementById('approve-modal');
1865:         const userId = modal.dataset.userId;
1866:         const selectedGroups = Array.from(
1867:             document.querySelectorAll('input[name="approve_group"]:checked')
1868:         ).map(cb => cb.value);
1869:         if (selectedGroups.length === 0) {
1870:             this.showStatus('Please select at least one group', 'error');
1871:             return;
1872:         }
1873:         try {
1874:             // Activate user with group assignment (uses JWT authentication)
1875:             await API.adminActivateUser(userId, selectedGroups);
1876:             this.showStatus('User activated and assigned to groups successfully', 'success');
1877:             this.closeModals();
1878:             this.loadAdminUsers();
1879:         } catch (error) {
1880:             this.showStatus(error.message, 'error');
1881:         }
1882:     },

1886:     async rejectUser(userId) {

1889:             this.showStatus('User rejected successfully', 'success');
1890:             this.loadAdminUsers();
1891:         } catch (error) {
1892:             this.showStatus(error.message, 'error');
1893:         }
1894:     },
1895:     /**
1896:      * Revoke user
1897:      */
1898:     async revokeUser(userId) {
1899:         try {
1900:             await API.revokeUser(userId);
1901:             this.showStatus('User revoked successfully', 'success');
1902:             this.loadAdminUsers();
1903:         } catch (error) {
1904:             this.showStatus(error.message, 'error');
1905:         }
1906:     },
1907:     /**
1908:      * Show confirmation dialog
1909:      */
1910:     confirmAction(message, callback) {
1911:         const modal = document.getElementById('confirm-modal');
1912:         const messageEl = document.getElementById('confirm-modal-message');
1913:         const okBtn = document.getElementById('confirm-modal-ok');
1914:         messageEl.textContent = message;
1915:         // Remove old event listener
1916:         const newOkBtn = okBtn.cloneNode(true);
1917:         okBtn.parentNode.replaceChild(newOkBtn, okBtn);
1918:         newOkBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
1919:             this.closeModals();
1920:             callback();
1921:         });
1922:         document.getElementById('modal-overlay').classList.remove('hidden');
1923:         modal.classList.remove('hidden');
1924:     },
1925:     /**
1926:      * Show status message
1927:      * @param {string} message - Message to display
1928:      * @param {string} type - Message type (success, error, warning)
1929:      */
1930:     showStatus(message, type = 'success') {
1931:         const statusEl = document.getElementById('status-message');
1932:         statusEl.textContent = message;
1933:         statusEl.className = `status-message ${type}`;
1934:         statusEl.classList.remove('hidden');
1935:         setTimeout(() => {
1936:             statusEl.classList.add('hidden');
1937:         }, 4000);
1938:     },

 164:     <!-- Project Overview -->
 165:     <section id="overview">
 166:         <h2>Project Overview</h2>
 167:         <div class="card">
 168:             <p>This project deploys a complete LDAP authentication solution with two-factor authentication (2FA), self-service password management, and GitOps capabilities on Amazon EKS using Terraform.</p>
 169:         </div>
 170:         <h3 id="core-infrastructure">Core Infrastructure</h3>
 171:         <div class="card">
 172:             <ul>
 173:                 <li><strong>EKS Cluster</strong> (Auto Mode) with IRSA for secure pod-to-AWS-service authentication</li>
 174:                 <li><strong>VPC</strong> with public/private subnets and VPC endpoints for private AWS service access</li>
 175:                 <li><strong>Application Load Balancer (ALB)</strong> via EKS Auto Mode for internet-facing access</li>
 176:                 <li><strong>Route53 DNS</strong> integration for domain management</li>
 177:                 <li><strong>ACM Certificates</strong> for HTTPS/TLS termination</li>
 178:             </ul>
 179:         </div>
 180:         <h3 id="ldap-stack">LDAP Stack</h3>
 181:         <div class="card">
 182:             <ul>
 183:                 <li><strong>OpenLDAP Stack</strong> with high availability and multi-master replication</li>
 184:                 <li><strong>PhpLdapAdmin</strong> web interface for LDAP administration</li>
 185:                 <li><strong>LTB-passwd</strong> self-service password management UI</li>
 186:             </ul>
 187:         </div>
 188:         <h3 id="2fa-application">2FA Application</h3>
 189:         <div class="card">
 190:             <ul>
 191:                 <li><strong>Full-stack 2FA application</strong> with Python FastAPI backend and static HTML/JS/CSS frontend
 192:                     <ul>
 193:                         <li><strong>Backend:</strong> <a href="https://github.com/talorlik/ldap-2fa-on-k8s/blob/main/application/backend/README.md">Comprehensive FastAPI backend API</a> with LDAP integration, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS SES/SNS, and complete documentation</li>
 194:                         <li><strong>Frontend:</strong> <a href="https://github.com/talorlik/ldap-2fa-on-k8s/blob/main/application/frontend/README.md">Modern SPA frontend</a> with vanilla JavaScript, responsive design, and full feature documentation</li>
 195:                     </ul>
 196:                 </li>
 197:                 <li><strong>Dual MFA methods</strong>: TOTP (authenticator apps) and SMS (AWS SNS)</li>
 198:                 <li><strong>LDAP integration</strong> for centralized user authentication</li>
 199:                 <li><strong>Self-service user registration</strong> with email/phone verification and profile state management</li>
 200:                 <li><strong>Admin dashboard</strong> for user management, group CRUD operations, and approval workflows</li>
 201:                 <li><strong>User profile management</strong> with email change (verification link), phone change (SMS code), and password change for authenticated users</li>
 202:                 <li><strong>Interactive API documentation</strong> via Swagger UI and ReDoc (always enabled)</li>
 203:             </ul>
 204:         </div>
 205:         <h3 id="supporting-infrastructure">Supporting Infrastructure</h3>
 206:         <div class="card">
 207:             <ul>
 208:                 <li><strong>PostgreSQL</strong> (Bitnami Helm chart, ECR images) for user registration data and email verification token storage with persistent EBS-backed storage</li>
 209:                 <li><strong>Redis</strong> (Bitnami Helm chart) for SMS OTP code and login challenge storage with TTL-based automatic expiration and shared state across replicas (required; no in-memory fallback)</li>
 210:                 <li><strong>AWS SES</strong> for email verification and notifications with IRSA-based access (no hardcoded credentials)</li>
 211:                 <li><strong>AWS SNS</strong> for SMS-based 2FA verification (optional, requires SNS VPC endpoint enabled in backend infrastructure)</li>
 212:             </ul>
 213:         </div>
 214:         <h3 id="devops-security">DevOps & Security</h3>
 215:         <div class="card">
 216:             <ul>
 217:                 <li><strong>ArgoCD</strong> (AWS EKS managed service) for GitOps deployments with AWS Identity Center authentication</li>
 218:                 <li><strong>Network Policies</strong> for securing pod-to-pod communication with cross-namespace support</li>
 219:                 <li><strong>IRSA</strong> (IAM Roles for Service Accounts) for secure AWS API access from pods without credentials</li>
 220:                 <li><strong>VPC Endpoints</strong> for private AWS service access (SSM, STS, SNS) without internet exposure</li>
 221:                 <li><strong>Multi-Account Architecture</strong> with separated state storage and deployment accounts</li>
 222:                 <li><strong>S3 File-Based Locking</strong> for Terraform state management (migrated from DynamoDB)</li>
 223:             </ul>
 224:         </div>
 225:         <h3 id="key-features">Key Features</h3>
 226:         <div class="card">
 227:             <ul>
 228:                 <li><strong>EKS Auto Mode</strong>: Simplified cluster management with automatic load balancer provisioning and built-in EBS CSI driver</li>
 229:                 <li><strong>Two-Factor Authentication</strong>: Full-stack 2FA application with dual MFA methods (TOTP and SMS)</li>
 230:                 <li><strong>Self-Service User Registration</strong>: Email and phone verification with profile state management (PENDING → COMPLETE → ACTIVE)</li>
 231:                 <li><strong>Admin Dashboard</strong>: User management, group CRUD operations, approval workflows, and user profile management</li>
 232:                 <li><strong>IRSA Integration</strong>: Secure AWS API access from pods without hardcoded credentials via OIDC</li>
 233:                 <li><strong>High Availability</strong>: Multi-master OpenLDAP replication with persistent storage</li>
 234:                 <li><strong>GitOps Ready</strong>: ArgoCD (AWS managed service) for declarative, Git-driven deployments</li>
 235:                 <li><strong>Multi-Account Architecture</strong>: Separation of state storage (Account A) and resource deployment (Account B) for enhanced security</li>
 236:                 <li><strong>API Documentation</strong>: Interactive Swagger UI and ReDoc always available at <code>/api/docs</code> and <code>/api/redoc</code> (always enabled, not just in debug mode)</li>
 237:                 <li><strong>Secrets Management</strong>: Passwords managed via GitHub repository secrets (for CI/CD) or AWS Secrets Manager (for local deployment) with automated retrieval</li>
 238:                 <li><strong>Public ACM Certificates</strong>: Uses public ACM certificates (Amazon-issued) with DNS validation for browser-trusted certificates (no security warnings)</li>
 239:                 <li><strong>Route53 Record Module</strong>: Dedicated module for Route53 A (alias) records with cross-account support and ALB zone_id mapping</li>
 240:                 <li><strong>Automated Configuration Management</strong>: ECR repository name automatically saved to GitHub variables during backend infrastructure provisioning (eliminates manual configuration steps)</li>
 241:                 <li><strong>ArgoCD Status Validation</strong>: Automatic validation that ArgoCD capability is "ACTIVE" before deploying applications (prevents deployment failures due to incomplete ArgoCD setup)</li>
 242:                 <li><strong>Role Assumption Script</strong>: Convenient <code>scripts/assume-github-role.sh</code> script for switching between AWS account roles (State, Development, Production) when working in the terminal</li>
 243:                 <li><strong>Unique Build Image Tags</strong>: Backend and frontend build workflows use commit SHA plus run ID for image tags (<code>&lt;name&gt;-&lt;sha&gt;-&lt;run_id&gt;</code>), push only that tag to ECR (no <code>:latest</code>), and update Helm values; application provisioning reads tags from Helm values</li>
 244:                 <li><strong>ArgoCD Access Entry</strong>: ArgoCD Capability uses EKS Access Policy association for cluster admin permissions, ensuring reliable GitOps sync across namespaces and cluster-scoped resources</li>
 245:             </ul>
 246:         </div>
 247:     </section>
 248:     <!-- Getting Started -->
 249:     <section id="getting-started">
 250:         <h2>Getting Started</h2>
 251:         <h3 id="prerequisites">Prerequisites</h3>
 252:         <div class="card">
 253:             <ul>
 254:                 <li><strong>Two AWS Accounts minimum</strong> — split architecture. Quick reference:
 255:                     <table class="account-split-table">
 256:                         <thead><tr><th>Resource</th><th>Account A (State)</th><th>Account B (Deployment)</th></tr></thead>
 257:                         <tbody>
 258:                             <tr><td>Terraform state (S3)</td><td>✓</td><td></td></tr>
 259:                             <tr><td>AWS Secrets Manager (github-role, tf-vars, external-id)</td><td>✓</td><td></td></tr>
 260:                             <tr><td>Route53 Hosted Zone</td><td>✓</td><td></td></tr>
 261:                             <tr><td>Route53 DNS records (incl. ACM validation CNAMEs)</td><td>✓</td><td></td></tr>
 262:                             <tr><td>ACM Certificate (requested, validated, stored)</td><td></td><td>✓ (each dev/prod)</td></tr>
 263:                             <tr><td>SMS Sender ID (when using SMS 2FA)</td><td></td><td>✓ (each dev/prod)</td></tr>
 264:                             <tr><td>EKS, VPC, ALB, ECR, application resources</td><td></td><td>✓</td></tr>
 265:                         </tbody>
 266:                     </table>
 267:                     <p class="card-note"><strong>Account A</strong> holds state, secrets, and DNS. <strong>Account B</strong> holds infrastructure and ACM certificates (ALB and certificate must be in the same account).</p>
 268:                 </li>
 269:                 <li><strong>GitHub Account</strong> and repository fork: <a href="https://github.com/talorlik/ldap-2fa-on-k8s.git" target="_blank">ldap-2fa-on-k8s</a></li>
 270:                 <li><strong>AWS SSO/OIDC</strong> configured (see <a href="https://github.com/talorlik/ldap-2fa-on-k8s/blob/main/README.md#github-repository-configuration">GitHub Repository Configuration</a>)</li>
 271:                 <li><strong>Domain and DNS (Account A)</strong>: Route53 hosted zone for your domain must exist in the State Account. All DNS records (including ACM validation CNAMEs) are created here.</li>
 272:                 <li><strong>ACM certificates (Account B)</strong>: Request a public ACM certificate in each Deployment Account. Validation uses CNAME records in Account A's Route53. Certificate must be in <code>ISSUED</code> status and in the same region as the EKS cluster. See <a href="https://github.com/talorlik/ldap-2fa-on-k8s/blob/main/docs/auxiliary/application_infra/guides/CROSS_ACCOUNT_ACCESS.md#public-acm-certificate-setup-and-dns-validation">Public ACM Certificate Setup and DNS Validation</a> for step-by-step AWS CLI commands.</li>
 273:                 <li><strong>SMS (Account B, when using SMS 2FA)</strong>: (1) <strong>SMS Sandbox</strong>: New SNS accounts are in the SMS sandbox. Add and verify destination phone numbers in SNS Console &gt; Text messaging (SMS) &gt; Sandbox destination phone numbers, or request <strong>Exit SMS Sandbox</strong> for production. See <a href="https://github.com/talorlik/ldap-2fa-on-k8s/blob/main/docs/auxiliary/application_infra/guides/SMS_SANDBOX.md">SMS Sandbox</a>. (2) <strong>Sender ID</strong>: Request an SMS Sender ID in AWS End User Messaging per deployment account and share with SNS. See <a href="https://github.com/talorlik/ldap-2fa-on-k8s/blob/main/docs/auxiliary/application_infra/guides/SMS_SENDER_ID_SETUP.md">SMS Sender ID Setup</a>.</li>
 274:                 <li><strong>GitHub Secrets and Variables</strong> configured (see <a href="https://github.com/talorlik/ldap-2fa-on-k8s/blob/main/docs/auxiliary/reference/SECRETS_REQUIREMENTS.md">Secrets Requirements</a> for complete details):
 275:                     <ul>
 276:                         <li><strong>Required Secrets:</strong>
 277:                             <ul>
 278:                                 <li><code>AWS_STATE_ACCOUNT_ROLE_ARN</code></li>
 279:                                 <li><code>AWS_PRODUCTION_ACCOUNT_ROLE_ARN</code></li>
 280:                                 <li><code>AWS_DEVELOPMENT_ACCOUNT_ROLE_ARN</code></li>
 281:                                 <li><code>AWS_ASSUME_EXTERNAL_ID</code></li>
 282:                                 <li><code>TF_VAR_OPENLDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD</code></li>
 283:                                 <li><code>TF_VAR_OPENLDAP_CONFIG_PASSWORD</code></li>
 284:                                 <li><code>TF_VAR_REDIS_PASSWORD</code></li>
 285:                                 <li><code>TF_VAR_POSTGRESQL_PASSWORD</code></li>
 286:                                 <li><code>GH_TOKEN</code></li>
 287:                             </ul>
 288:                         </li>
 289:                         <li><strong>Optional (first admin user seed):</strong> When all are set, a one-time Job seeds the first admin so they can log into the 2FA app with the same username/password as LDAP. Set in GitHub Secrets or AWS <code>tf-vars</code>: <code>ADMIN_SEED_USERNAME</code>, <code>ADMIN_SEED_EMAIL</code>, <code>ADMIN_SEED_FIRST_NAME</code>, <code>ADMIN_SEED_LAST_NAME</code>, <code>ADMIN_SEED_PHONE_COUNTRY_CODE</code>, <code>ADMIN_SEED_PHONE_NUMBER</code>. See <a href="https://github.com/talorlik/ldap-2fa-on-k8s/blob/main/docs/auxiliary/reference/SECRETS_REQUIREMENTS.md">Secrets Requirements</a>.</li>
 290:                         <li><strong>Required Variables:</strong>
 291:                             <ul>
 292:                                 <li><code>AWS_REGION</code></li>
 293:                                 <li><code>BACKEND_PREFIX</code></li>
 294:                                 <li><code>APPLICATION_INFRA_PREFIX</code> - State file key prefix for application infrastructure (value: <code>application_infra_state/terraform.tfstate</code>)</li>
 295:                                 <li><code>APPLICATION_PREFIX</code> - State file key prefix for application (value: <code>application_state/terraform.tfstate</code>)</li>
 296:                             </ul>
 297:                         </li>
 298:                         <li><strong>Auto-generated Variables:</strong> (set automatically by workflows/scripts)
 299:                             <ul>
 300:                                 <li><code>BACKEND_BUCKET_NAME</code> - Set by Terraform backend state provisioning</li>
 301:                                 <li><code>ECR_REPOSITORY_NAME</code> - Automatically set by backend infrastructure provisioning (eliminates manual configuration; retrieved from Terraform outputs and saved to GitHub repository variables)</li>
 302:                             </ul>
 303:                         </li>
 304:                     </ul>
